paper.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
paper.abstract: Recent advances in foundation models have enabled AI scientists to automate increasingly complete research workflows, from hypothesis generation and code execution to manuscript preparation. Yet workflow coverage alone does not provide access to the full evidence on which scientific discovery depends. Existing systems typically reason over text, code, labels, or precomputed summaries, leaving scientifically decisive spatial, temporal, cross-channel, and procedural relations unavailable to the ag

summary.core_problem: 现有AI科学家仅基于文本、代码或预计算摘要推理，无法获取科学发现关键的空间、时间、跨通道、流程关系等原始证据信息。
summary.importance: 系统创新，提出端到端全模态全学科AI科学家系统，实现从原始异质证据到研究产出的完整自动化流程。
summary.technical_approach: 1）感知层处理异质原始多模态科学证据；2）三个自主智能体（构思、实验、写作）在确定性pipeline中协同，实现观测驱动的全流程决策；3）通过代码执行新颖性筛选、统计显著性检验、主张校验三类检查，保障研究质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露完整实验细节，未明确所用基座模型、测试学科范围、自动化成功率与人工对比结果。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括新加坡国立大学、牛津大学，暂无公开知名核心作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI scientists only reason over text, code, or precomputed summaries, failing to access raw evidence information critical to scientific discovery such as spatial, temporal, cross-channel, and procedural relations.
summary_en.importance: System innovation that proposes an end-to-end omni-modal omni-discipline AI scientist system, realizing the full automated workflow from raw heterogeneous evidence to research outputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) A perception layer processes heterogeneous raw multimodal scientific evidence; 2) Three autonomous agents (ideation, experiment, writeup) collaborate within a deterministic pipeline to enable observation-driven full-process decision-making; 3) Three types of checks (novelty screening, statistical significance testing, claim verification) are executed via code to ensure research quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is truncated; full experimental details including base model used, tested discipline scope, automation success rate and human comparison results are not disclosed.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include National University of Singapore and University of Oxford; no publicly well-known core authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 作为科学Agent的系统架构参考，仅看模块划分图即可，无预训练相关核心insight。
recommendation.en: Use as a system architecture reference for scientific agents; only the module division diagram is needed, no core pretraining insights.

paper.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
paper.abstract: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot. In this work, we propose InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework that treats visual resolution as an adaptive reasoning-time resource. InSight-doc starts from low resolution and selectively zooms into high-resolution regions for finer evidence, without relying on any external retriever. To train such an agent, we construct an active-perception corpus o

summary.core_problem: 长文档视觉理解需要在高分辨率多页上推理，全分辨率输入既昂贵又易导致context rot，而外部检索方案依赖额外索引。
summary.importance: 把视觉分辨率视作推理时可自适应分配的资源，用SFT+RL训练主动感知Agent，在长文档上同时降延迟和幻觉，属于多模态推理时计算分配方向的小案例。
summary.technical_approach: Agent从低分辨率开始，按策略选择性放大高分辨率区域取证；构造17.9K条SFT（含region-level zoom轨迹）+19.2K条hard RL样例，以SFT+RL训练8B模型，不依赖外部检索器。
summary.experiments: InSight-doc-8B在文档VQA基准上比基线高4.3–16.4 accuracy；长文档上幻觉降低40%+，推理延迟降低41%–68%且保持精度领先。
summary.authors_note: HKUST团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Long visual-document understanding requires high-resolution multi-page reasoning, but full-resolution inputs are expensive, induce context rot, and retrieval-based approaches rely on external indexes.
summary_en.importance: Frames visual resolution as an adaptive inference-time resource and trains an active-perception agent via SFT+RL, reducing latency and hallucination on long documents; a small data point for inference-time compute allocation in multimodal settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: The agent starts at low resolution and selectively zooms into regions; an active-perception corpus of 17.9K SFT examples with zoom trajectories plus 19.2K hard RL examples trains an 8B model with no external retriever.
summary_en.experiments: InSight-doc-8B outperforms baselines by 4.3–16.4 accuracy points on document VQA; on long documents, hallucination drops >40% and latency 41%–68% while retaining accuracy gains.
summary_en.authors_note: HKUST team.

recommendation.zh: 视觉文档的test-time compute分配小实验，RL训练zoom策略的工程实现可看一眼，但对通用预训练无直接动作。
recommendation.en: A small visual-document test-time-compute case; glance at the zoom-policy SFT+RL pipeline, but no direct action for general pretrain.

paper.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
paper.abstract: After an older adult misses a medication dose, a software agent can send another reminder and an embodied agent can bring the medication. Yet neither explains whether the person forgot, is confused, has side effects, or deliberately refused, nor what support is appropriate. This reveals a structural gap in Agentic AI: Digital Agents primarily transform software states, while Embodied Agents transform physical states; neither makes a person's evolving state and agency the primary object of modeli

summary.core_problem: 现有数字Agent仅处理软件状态、具身Agent仅处理物理状态，均未将人的动态状态与主体性作为建模、干预和评估的核心对象。
summary.importance: 范式创新，首次提出以人为中心的ComBodied Agent范式，统一个人助理、健康Agent、AI伴侣等碎片化能力的闭环框架。
summary.technical_approach: 构建事件驱动的多模态感知→人类状态轨迹建模→多渠道（软件/传感器/机器人/人工服务）干预→评估的闭环，将各类工具作为行动通道而非最终目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体量化实验与benchmark结果，核心工作聚焦于范式定义与框架设计。
summary.authors_note: 含知名NLP/Agent研究者Lei Li，摘要未明确标注所属机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing digital agents only manipulate software states and embodied agents only alter physical states, neither models, intervenes on, nor evaluates humans' evolving states and agency as the primary object.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation; first proposes the human-centric ComBodied Agents framework, unifying fragmented capabilities across personal assistants, health agents and AI companions into a closed loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a closed loop of event-based multimodal perception → human state trajectory modeling → multi-channel (software/sensors/robots/human services) intervention → evaluation, treating tools as action channels rather than end goals.
summary_en.experiments: No quantitative benchmark results are reported in the abstract; the work focuses on paradigm definition and framework design.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Lei Li, a well-known NLP and agent researcher; institutional affiliations are not explicitly stated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 通用Agent范式的概念性拓展，与基座预训练无直接关联，作为领域方向备查即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Conceptual expansion of general agent paradigms, no direct relevance to foundation pretraining; keep as literature reference, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Reading is not Reasoning: Bridging the Agentic Policy Gap in Vision-Text Compression
paper.abstract: Multi-step language-model agents repeatedly process growing interaction histories, leading to substantial context costs. Vision--text compression reduces these costs by rendering history as images, but the resulting modality shift creates a marked capability gap. Through controlled evaluations of history recovery, matched-state decisions, and complete trajectories, we show that this gap cannot be explained by OCR quality alone. Visual-history agents exhibit systematic drift in action selection,

summary.core_problem: 将多步Agent的交互历史渲染为图像（视觉-文本压缩）以降低上下文成本时，会导致严重的Agent策略能力下降（Agentic Policy Gap），且这种下降不能仅用OCR质量来解释。
summary.importance: 揭示了VLM在处理长视觉历史时存在的系统性策略漂移问题，并提出了一种跨模态自蒸馏方法来弥合这一差距，对多模态Agent的上下文管理有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 通过控制实验证明了视觉历史Agent在动作选择、查询构建等方面存在系统性漂移。提出CAPS（跨模态Agent策略自蒸馏）框架，利用同一模型较强的文本历史策略来监督其视觉历史策略，包含离线轨迹自蒸馏和在线策略自蒸馏两个阶段。
summary.experiments: 在历史恢复、匹配状态决策和完整轨迹上进行了评估，证明了CAPS能有效将文本策略的行为转移到视觉历史输入上。
summary.authors_note: 华为诺亚方舟实验室与北大、北邮等机构合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Rendering interaction history as images (vision-text compression) to reduce context costs in multi-step agents leads to a severe agentic policy gap, which cannot be explained by OCR quality alone.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the systematic policy drift in VLMs when processing long visual histories and proposes a cross-modal self-distillation method to bridge this gap, inspiring context management for multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Demonstrated through controlled experiments that visual-history agents exhibit systematic drift in action selection, query formulation, etc. Proposed CAPS (Cross-modal Agentic Policy Self-distillation), using the model's stronger text-history policy to supervise its visual-history counterpart, including offline trajectory and online policy self-distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on history recovery, matched-state decisions, and complete trajectories, proving CAPS effectively transfers text-policy behavior to visual-history inputs.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, Peking University, BUPT, etc.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了把Agent历史转成图片输入时VLM存在的策略漂移（不仅是OCR问题），并用文本策略蒸馏视觉策略，做多模态长上下文/Agent的值得看实验分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals policy drift in VLMs when converting agent history to images (beyond OCR issues) and distills text policy to visual policy; worth reading for multimodal long-context/agent researchers.

paper.title: ToolVision: Learning When and How to Use Visual Tools with Capability-Aligned Supervision
paper.abstract: Thinking with images allows a multimodal model to compensate for limited perception by invoking visual tools through code. Yet the prevailing SFT-then-RL recipe creates a different supervision misalignment at each stage. SFT is expected to teach how to use tools, but trajectories from stronger teachers may succeed through perceptual capabilities that a smaller student cannot reliably reproduce or exploit, causing the student to imitate tool-call patterns without learning how to make them useful.

summary.core_problem: 多模态模型在 SFT-then-RL 流程中学习视觉工具调用时，SFT 阶段存在能力不对齐、RL 阶段 outcome reward 抑制工具使用的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：把'何时用工具'和'如何用工具'的监督信号分别在 SFT/RL 阶段对齐到学生模型能力。
summary.technical_approach: SFT 阶段用多 agent 搜索候选轨迹，由含学生规模模型的委员会按 stepwise evidence gain 打分剪枝；RL 阶段设计 capability-aligned reward，区分有效但无用的工具调用与真正带来证据增益的调用。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出具体模型规模、baseline 与数字，仅描述方法框架。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Linfeng Zhang（上海 AI Lab/通用方向），但需以论文正文为准。

summary_en.core_problem: In SFT-then-RL training of multimodal tool-using agents, SFT trajectories come from stronger teachers whose perception the student cannot reproduce, while outcome-only RL rewards either suppress tool use or reward ineffective calls.
summary_en.importance: Method contribution: capability-aligned supervision that separately addresses 'how' (SFT) and 'when' (RL) to use visual tools.
summary_en.technical_approach: SFT uses a multi-agent trajectory search with a committee including student-scale models scoring stepwise evidence gain; RL uses a shaped reward that distinguishes evidence-gaining tool calls from valid-but-useless ones.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract gives no model sizes, baselines, or quantitative results; framework-level description only.

recommendation.zh: 思路对 post-train 有启发：SFT 数据应按学生能力过滤而非照搬强教师轨迹；但摘要无实验，先看 reward 设计一节即可。
recommendation.en: The 'student-capability-aligned SFT filtering' idea is worth borrowing for post-training; skip until §reward design, no numbers in abstract.

paper.title: Capek 0.5: An Execution-Centric Vision-Language Model for Embodied Intelligence
paper.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly serving as the reasoning core of embodied agents. Robot execution is inherently iterative: each action reshapes the scene and physical state, continually renewing what must be perceived, reasoned about, and verified. Meeting these demands requires complementary capabilities that differ in supervision signals, prediction formats, and verification criteria. Existing approaches typically develop these capabilities against isolated, task-specific objectives, l

summary.core_problem: 研究 embodied VLM 如何围绕机器人执行过程组织能力，而不是把空间、时间、动作和验证能力分散训练在孤立任务目标上。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 embodied VLM 训练组织方式和能力 taxonomy。它对多模态 agent 的数据/任务编排有参考，但更偏机器人执行，不是通用 VLM 预训练范式或视觉 tokenizer 工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Capek 0.5，按 execution-centric capability taxonomy 组织模型能力。taxonomy 包含四类：Spatial Reasoning、Temporal Understanding、Action Guidance、State Verification。每类能力围绕执行过程中的功能角色定义，而不是按数据集或下游任务定义。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供完整实验细节；可确认论文面向 embodied intelligence，并强调多种能力具有不同监督信号、预测格式和验证标准。模型规模、训练数据、baseline、benchmark 和提升幅度在给定摘要中不可见。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how an embodied VLM should organize capabilities around the robot execution process rather than training spatial, temporal, action, and verification skills as isolated task objectives.
summary_en.importance: This is a capability-taxonomy and training-organization contribution for embodied VLMs. It is relevant to multimodal-agent data and task composition, but remains closer to robotic execution than to general VLM pretraining or visual tokenization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Capek 0.5 is built around an execution-centric capability taxonomy. The taxonomy groups embodied capabilities into Spatial Reasoning, Temporal Understanding, Action Guidance, and State Verification, based on functional roles during execution rather than datasets or downstream tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include full experimental details. It establishes the embodied setting and the need to handle different supervision signals, prediction formats, and verification criteria, but omits model scale, training data, baselines, benchmark names, and numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 embodied VLM 数据编排案例可留档；若没有大规模训练细节，taxonomy 本身对 pretrain 的信息量有限。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an embodied-VLM data-organization reference; without large-scale training details, the taxonomy alone carries limited pretraining signal.

paper.title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Deploying autonomous multimodal agents in continuous, real-world environments requires them to ingest unbounded audio-visual streams and maintain hour-scale memory. However, current evaluations predominantly rely on brief clips and multiple-choice formats. This design allows minimal baselines that process only the last four frames to match or surpass complex streaming models, while answer options also expose language shortcuts. We introduce StreamArena, a benchmark for hour-scale, interactive st

summary.core_problem: 现有流式视频理解评测依赖短片段和多选题，导致仅处理最后几帧的简单基线即可匹敌复杂流式模型，且选项暴露语言捷径。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献（StreamArena），面向小时级交互式流式视频理解，触及长时序多模态 agent 评测中的核心张力。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 243 个平均 88.8 分钟的长视频与 3,646 个开放式问答对，评测实时感知、历史回溯、主动交互与多模态工具调用；设计开放式协议避免选项捷径。
summary.experiments: 跨系统评测揭示连续交互与长时序多模态理解之间的张力：仅保留近期帧的方法无法恢复远期事件，而将过去内容压缩为文本的方法丢失感知细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 HKUST、小红书、HKU、CUHK；Jiaya Jia 团队在计算机视觉与多模态领域有长期积累。

summary_en.core_problem: Current streaming video understanding evaluations rely on short clips and multiple-choice formats, allowing trivial baselines that process only the last few frames to match complex streaming models while answer options leak language shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution (StreamArena) targeting hour-scale interactive streaming video understanding, surfacing a core tension in long-horizon multimodal agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 243 full-length videos averaging 88.8 minutes with 3,646 open-ended QA pairs evaluating real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool use; open-ended protocol avoids option shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: Cross-system evaluation exposes a tension between continuous interaction and long-horizon multimodal comprehension: recent-frame-only methods cannot recover distant events, while text-compression methods lose perceptual detail.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from HKUST, Xiaohongshu, HKU, CUHK; Jiaya Jia's group has a long track record in computer vision and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 长时序多模态 agent 评测设计有参考价值，尤其'最后四帧基线匹敌复杂模型'的观察；但与预训练直接关联弱，看 §4 评测协议和张力分析即可。
recommendation.en: The long-horizon multimodal agent eval design is informative, especially the 'last-four-frames baseline matches complex models' observation; weak direct link to pretraining. Read §4 eval protocol and tension analysis only.
