paper.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
paper.abstract: Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools. However, we find that simply increasing the number of multimodal environments does not always benefit. We further analyze the limitations in current multimodal environment distributions through a series of experiments. Based on these findings, we study how to build more effective training environment distributions from two dimensions: **diversity** and **difficulty structure**. For diversity, we propose **Ability

summary.core_problem: 多模态智能体训练中，单纯扩大环境池规模无法稳定提升性能，甚至会因环境冗余、能力冲突和难度结构不合理导致性能下降；现有环境分布设计只关注单个环境的可执行性和奖励可靠性，未从多样性与难度结构两个维度系统优化训练分布。
summary.importance: 将预训练数据分布设计的思路迁移到多模态智能体的环境分布设计，明确了「环境规模≠训练收益」的关键判断，对后续基于动态环境的多模态基座训练、课程学习设计和数据/环境筛选策略有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从多样性和难度结构两个维度重构环境分布：1) 多样性方面提出 Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)，不使用任务描述等表层信号度量多样性，而是从智能体轨迹中分解出可复用的原子能力，为每个环境构建元能力画像；选择环境时最大化元能力覆盖度，同时通过画像相似度去重、基于梯度机制分析降低优化冲突。2) 难度结构方面提出 Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC)，针对多模态智能体视觉状态提取和世界建模两个核心瓶颈，设计两层难度课程：外层逐步移除提供文本辅助信息的训练支架（harness weakening），内层在每个支架阶段按状态规模做常规课程学习；相比仅按状态规模定义难度的文本智能体方案，更贴合多模态场景的能力瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 基于已有工作构建统一的 200 个多模态环境池。控制实验显示：在固定计算预算下，增加环境类型数量不会单调提升性能，部分规模下性能反而下降；同一环境集合的多模态版本比文本-符号版本表现出更强的负迁移和梯度冲突。AES 选出的环境子集在使用更少环境的情况下超过全环境池训练的效果；HDC 相比直接训练和仅按规模的课程学习训练更稳定、性能更好；AES+HDC 在不同设置下平均相对收益为 143.2%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 2 节的控制实验分析（环境规模非单调收益、多模态 vs 文本-符号的对比），理解问题本身比方法更关键；第 3 节 AES 的元能力画像构建和梯度冲突分析部分，第 4 节 HDC 的两层课程设计逻辑；附录 B 的实验设置细节。泛读为主，预计 40-60 分钟，核心是吸收「环境分布设计的两个维度」这一分析框架。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal agent training, simply scaling up the environment pool does not reliably improve performance, and can even degrade it due to environment redundancy, ability conflicts, and poorly structured difficulty schedules. Existing environment distribution designs only focus on per-environment executability and reward reliability, without systematically optimizing the training distribution along diversity and difficulty-structure dimensions.
summary_en.importance: This work transfers the design principles of pretraining data distribution to environment distribution for multimodal agents, and establishes the key observation that environment scale does not equal training gain. It provides direct reference for future multimodal foundation training on dynamic environments, curriculum design, and data/environment selection strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The environment distribution is redesigned along two axes: (1) For diversity, Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES) avoids surface-level diversity signals such as task descriptions. Instead, it decomposes agent trajectories into reusable atomic abilities and builds a meta-ability profile for each environment. Environment selection maximizes meta-ability coverage, removes redundancy via profile similarity, and mitigates optimization conflicts through mechanistic gradient analysis. (2) For difficulty structure, Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC) targets the two unique bottlenecks of multimodal agents — visual state extraction and world modeling — with a two-level curriculum: the outer level progressively removes textual training scaffolds (harness weakening), and the inner level applies conventional state-scale curriculum within each harness stage. This design is better aligned with multimodal ability bottlenecks than text-agent schedules that define difficulty purely by state scale.
summary_en.experiments: A unified pool of 200 multimodal environments is built from prior work. Controlled experiments show that under fixed compute budget, increasing the number of environment types does not monotonically improve performance, and performance drops at certain scales. The multimodal version of the same environment set exhibits stronger negative transfer and gradient conflicts than its text-symbolic counterpart. The AES-selected subset outperforms training on the full pool while using fewer environments. HDC yields more stable training and better results than both direct training and scale-only curriculum. AES+HDC achieves an average relative gain of 143.2% across settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for controlled analyses (non-monotonic gain with environment scale, multimodal vs text-symbolic comparison) — understanding the problem is more critical than the method itself. Then read Section 3 for AES meta-ability profiling and gradient conflict analysis, and Section 4 for the two-level HDC design. Appendix B contains detailed experimental settings. Skim-level reading, 40-60 minutes; the main takeaway is the two-dimension framework for environment distribution design.

recommendation.zh: 指出了Agent训练中无脑堆环境数量的局限性，提出的基于能力感知和难度分级的课程学习策略对构建高质量Agent训练数据有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Points out the limitations of mindlessly scaling environments in agent training; the proposed curriculum learning strategies based on ability awareness and difficulty grading are valuable for constructing high-quality agent training data.

paper.title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
paper.abstract: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. To address thes

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态深度研究Agent仅支持静态图像输入，无法适配连续视频流场景下的长时序多跳推理需求，且存在模态偏见（偏好文本搜索、回避视觉工具调用）和参数知识泄露（依赖内部记忆而非真实工具执行）两个核心瓶颈，同时缺乏适配该场景的训练数据构造管线和严格的评测基准。
summary.importance: 为视频类多模态基座的对齐训练提供了任务设计与数据构造的参考：感知-探索解耦的阶段式工具解锁机制可迁移至多模态Agent的后训练流程，用于缓解模态偏见；针对模态偏见、参数知识泄露的量化诊断方法，可用于通用多模态模型的对齐效果校验；强制双模态依赖的基准构造思路，也能避免评测被模型参数记忆污染。
summary.technical_approach: 将视频建模为关键实体轨迹的时序组合，设计Select_Keyframe（时序选帧）、Crop_Search（空间裁剪搜索）两类定制视觉工具，搭配标准网页搜索工具构成完整动作空间；采用解耦的感知-探索管线加阶段式工具解锁机制，强制Agent先完成跨帧视觉定位再执行网页检索，从训练流程上纠正模态偏见；训练采用两阶段管线：先监督微调，后接GRPO强化学习；同时搭建人机协同标注的VideoDR-Bench，共200个实例，每个问题都必须同时调用视觉搜索与外部知识推理才能解决，从根源上避免参数知识泄露；配套数据引擎产出30K视频定位QA对与7K人工校验的决策轨迹。
summary.experiments: 35B参数模型（Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B）在VideoDR-Bench上准确率达64.0%，超过Claude-4.5-Sonnet的59.0%；30B参数变体准确率59.3%，与专有闭源基线持平；前置诊断实验显示，现有开源模型单任务平均仅调用0.10次视觉工具，同期文本搜索调用达1.27次，GPT-5在几乎零工具调用的情况下仍能达到57%准确率，直接验证了模态偏见与参数知识泄露问题的存在。
summary.reading_guide: 先浏览Introduction部分的两个瓶颈诊断实验（模态偏见、参数知识泄露的量化统计），再查看Method章节的阶段式工具解锁机制与数据引擎构造逻辑，最后扫读VideoDR-Bench的标注规则与准入标准，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal deep research agents only accept static image inputs, failing to support long-horizon multi-hop reasoning in continuous video stream scenarios. They also face two critical bottlenecks: modality bias (preferring textual search over visual tool invocations) and parametric knowledge leakage (relying on internal memory instead of genuine tool execution), alongside a lack of suitable training data pipelines and rigorous evaluation benchmarks for this setting.
summary_en.importance: It provides practical references for alignment training of video-focused multimodal base models: the decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking can be transferred to post-training workflows of multimodal agents to mitigate modality bias; the quantitative diagnostic methods for modality bias and knowledge leakage are applicable to alignment validation of general multimodal models; the benchmark construction logic that enforces cross-modal dependency also prevents evaluation contamination from model parametric memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: Video is modeled as a temporal composition of key entity trajectories. Two custom visual tools, Select_Keyframe for temporal frame selection and Crop_Search for spatial cropped visual search, are added to the action space alongside standard web search tools. A decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking is implemented to force agents to complete cross-frame visual grounding before web retrieval, correcting modality bias through training workflow design. Training follows a two-stage recipe: supervised fine-tuning first, then Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) reinforcement learning. A human-AI collaborative benchmark VideoDR-Bench with 200 instances is built, where every question provably requires both visual search and external knowledge reasoning to eliminate parametric knowledge leakage. The supporting data engine produces 30K video-grounded QA pairs and 7K human-validated decision trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The 35B parameter model (Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B) reaches 64.0% accuracy on VideoDR-Bench, outperforming Claude-4.5-Sonnet which scores 59.0%; the 30B parameter variant achieves 59.3% accuracy, matching proprietary closed-source baselines. Pre-diagnostic experiments show existing open-source models invoke visual tools only 0.10 times per task on average, compared to 1.27 textual search calls, while GPT-5 attains 57% accuracy with nearly zero tool invocations, directly validating the existence of modality bias and parametric knowledge leakage.
summary_en.reading_guide: First review the quantitative diagnostic experiments for the two bottlenecks (modality bias, parametric knowledge leakage) in the Introduction, then check the stage-wise tool unlocking mechanism and data engine design logic in the Method section, and finally skim the annotation protocol and admission criteria of VideoDR-Bench. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态智能体从静态图扩展到视频流的代表性工作，GRPO训练策略和阶段工具解锁设计对多模态后训练有参考价值，重点看方法部分。
recommendation.en: Representative work extending multimodal agents from static images to video streams; the GRPO training strategy and stage-wise tool unlocking design offer reference for multimodal post-training, focus on the method section.

paper.title: DeepVoyager-VL: Incentivizing Vision-in-the-Loop Search for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced visual understanding and reasoning, yet their static parametric knowledge limits their ability to address knowledge-intensive and dynamically evolving open-world problems. To move beyond this limitation, multimodal deep search has emerged as a key direction for open-world information access, evolving from single-turn factual retrieval toward long-horizon, multi-turn search guided by visual evidence. However, existing methods typically confin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模态 agent 在开放世界长时程搜索中，视觉信息只出现在输入或答案阶段、无法持续驱动中间检索与推理的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 框架加训练数据合成。它对预训练本身不是直接推进，但对“视觉证据如何进入长时程决策闭环”有一定方法论价值，尤其适合关注 post-train 与 agent 反馈如何反哺多模态基座的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DeepVoyager-VL，一个 vision-in-the-loop 的长时程 multimodal deep-search 框架。核心包括：构建 multimodal event graph 来驱动数据合成，生成需要多轮交互和视觉证据持续参与的问题；在 agent 过程中让视觉证据不仅用于初始理解和最终回答，还参与中间检索、状态更新和后续搜索决策。方法重点在于把视觉观察纳入 search trajectory，而不是做静态 VQA。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验关注 long-horizon multimodal search，比较对象应是只在输入/输出阶段使用视觉的现有多模态搜索或检索增强方法。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度，因此目前更适合把它看成 agent 设计与数据构造工作，而非可直接迁移到预训练 recipe 的结论。
summary.authors_note: 从作者名单看是较大团队协作，含 Bowen Zhou、Bo Li 等名字，但仅凭当前信息无法稳妥确认具体机构归属。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper addresses the limitation that multimodal agents use vision only at the input or answer stage, rather than letting visual evidence drive intermediate retrieval and reasoning in long-horizon open-world search.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an agent framework plus training-data synthesis. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant if you care about how visual evidence should enter long-horizon decision loops and how post-training/agent signals may feed back into multimodal foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DeepVoyager-VL, a vision-in-the-loop framework for long-horizon multimodal deep search. The key components are: a multimodal event graph for data synthesis, producing problems that require multi-turn interaction with persistent visual grounding; and an agent design where visual evidence participates not only in initial understanding and final answering, but also in intermediate retrieval, state updates, and subsequent search decisions. The emphasis is on integrating vision into the search trajectory rather than treating it as static VQA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests experiments on long-horizon multimodal search, likely comparing against methods that use vision only at the input/output stage. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains, so this currently reads more as an agent/data-construction paper than a result that can be directly transferred into pretraining recipes.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list suggests a large collaborative team and includes names such as Bowen Zhou and Bo Li, but the exact institutional affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态 agent 反馈怎样形成新的训练信号，可以看它的数据合成和 search loop 设计；否则这更像应用型 agent，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Read it only if you care about how multimodal agent trajectories become new training signals; otherwise this is closer to an application-oriented agent paper than a foundation-model result.

paper.title: ViSAGE: Constructing Self-Correcting Memories for Long-Form Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents operating in long-horizon environments must build and continually update multimedia memories to support entity-consistent, temporally grounded reasoning. However, existing agentic memory approaches often discard fine-grained dentity cues under aggressive compression and segment-wise processing. They also rely heavily on vector similarity retrieval, which can surface semantically related yet identity-mismatched evidence, leading to entity confusion, error propagation, and halluc

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频理解中多模态 agent 记忆压缩后丢失细粒度实体线索、检索时发生身份混淆并导致幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 agent 记忆方法创新。它关注 long-horizon multimodal memory 的实体一致性，对通用 agent 记忆和视频推理有参考意义，但不是预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ViSAGE，一个自校正、实体中心的多模态记忆框架。它通过长时间跨度的跨模态绑定固定实体身份；用双向记忆 refinement 将延迟出现的身份线索向历史记录回传，并改善未来检索；再用多 agent cross-verification 根据 identity-evidence alignment 检查检索证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 或具体提升。实验应评估长视频理解中的实体一致性、检索证据质量和问答幻觉率，但具体数值无法从给定信息确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets entity confusion in long-form video understanding, where compressed multimodal memories lose fine-grained identity cues and retrieval returns semantically related but identity-mismatched evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal-agent memory method. It is relevant to long-horizon agent memory and video reasoning, but it does not directly contribute to pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViSAGE builds self-correcting, entity-centric multimodal memories. It anchors identity through cross-modal binding over long temporal ranges, applies bidirectional memory refinement to propagate delayed identity evidence backward and forward, and uses multi-agent cross-verification to assess retrieved evidence under an identity-evidence alignment criterion.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation axes are entity consistency, retrieval evidence quality, and hallucination reduction in long-form video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent memory 的可用设计，不是预训练论文；只看实体绑定和反向修正机制，别被 video setting 带偏。
recommendation.en: This is a usable agent-memory design, not a pretraining paper; skim the entity binding and backward-refinement mechanism without over-indexing on the video setting.

paper.title: Beyond Retrieval: Analytic Memory for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term multimodal memory must support not only retrieving relevant information but also computing over observations accumulated across interactions. Existing systems largely emphasize \emph{retrieval memory}, organizing interaction histories through summaries and indexes to return query-relevant information at multiple granularities, from high-level abstractions to underlying records. In this paper, we formulate \emph{analytic memory} as a complementary abstraction that organizes recurring mu

summary.core_problem: 解决长期多模态 agent memory 只会检索相关历史、难以对跨交互观测做过滤、聚合、排序和时间比较的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory 抽象与系统方法。它把 memory 从 retrieval-only 扩展到 analytic memory，对长期交互 agent 的状态表示有一定方法参考，但不是基座预训练或通用表示学习工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaMM，同时支持 retrieval memory 和 analytic memory。系统从对话、图像和上下文元数据中抽取带 provenance 的 attribute-value observations，自动发现反复出现的字段结构，并物化成可查询结构；推理时由 memory-aware planner 将用户问题分解为检索和分析操作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、任务设置、baseline 或提升幅度。可确认的是实验应比较仅检索记忆系统与 AdaMM 在多模态长期记忆查询、聚合分析和时间比较任务上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation that long-term multimodal agent memory mainly retrieves relevant history but cannot compute over accumulated observations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory abstraction and system method. It expands memory from retrieval-only access to analytic operations, which is relevant to long-horizon agents but not directly to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaMM supports both retrieval memory and analytic memory. It extracts provenance-linked attribute-value observations from dialogue, images, and contextual metadata, discovers recurring field structures, materializes them for analytical access, and uses a memory-aware planner to decompose queries into retrieval and analytic operations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation likely compares retrieval-only memory against AdaMM on multimodal long-term memory queries requiring filtering, aggregation, ranking, and temporal comparison.

recommendation.zh: 概念上比又一个向量库记忆强；看 memory schema 自动发现即可，别把它当模型记忆机制证据。
recommendation.en: Conceptually better than another vector-store memory paper; inspect the schema discovery piece, but do not treat it as evidence about model-internal memory.

paper.title: Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
paper.abstract: We introduce State Transition Pretraining (STP) as a new scaling axis for GUI agents. During the STP stage, we continually pretrain a unified multimodal model on visual state transitions by jointly optimizing inverse dynamics (predicting actions from state changes) and forward dynamics (predicting next states from current states and actions). This optimization equips the model with better action-grounded visual representations and an internal world model of GUI dynamics. When subsequently fine-t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注 GUI agent 的一个老问题：高质量任务轨迹贵、RL 交互训练重，而直接用 instruction-conditioned trajectory fine-tuning 又把视觉定位、界面动态理解、动作语义和任务规划全压进一个 next-action objective 里，导致数据效率和优化都不理想。作者要解决的是，能不能在不依赖额外任务级标注的前提下，先用更便宜、更容易扩展的 state transition 数据，把 GUI 交互里最基础的 action-grounded visual representation 和局部 dynamics 先学出来，再去做任务轨迹微调。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性不算最高，因为它主要是 GUI agent 训练范式，而不是通用 LLM 预训练。但它有两个值得注意的点。第一，它把“状态转移建模”明确当成一个独立于 trajectory SFT 的 scaling axis，这个思路和语言模型里把局部结构学习与高层任务对齐解耦是相通的。第二，它采用 unified multimodal model 同时做 image-text-to-image 的 forward dynamics 和 image-image-to-text 的 inverse dynamics，这种把生成式 world modeling 与 action recovery 结合的预训练方式，对多模态 agent pretraining 有启发。若从更广义的 pretrain/post-train 接口看，这篇论文提供了一个例子：先用廉价、局部、密集监督学环境动力学，再用稀缺、长程、任务级数据学规划。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 State Transition Pretraining，简称 STP。训练样本是单步转移三元组 (s_t, a_t, s_{t+1})，可以从已有轨迹切出来，也可以在交互环境中自动收集。STP 有两个联合目标。其一是 forward dynamics：输入当前界面状态和动作，预测下一界面状态，相当于 image-text-to-image 建模。作者希望模型借此形成 GUI dynamics 的内部表征，知道点击、输入、滚动之后界面会怎么变。其二是 inverse dynamics：输入前后两个截图，预测中间发生的动作，相当于 image-image-to-text 建模。这个目标迫使模型关注真正发生交互的位置和变化区域，从而学到更细粒度、与动作相关的视觉特征。论文的一个关键选择是使用 unified multimodal model 作为 backbone，而不是把视觉编码、动作分类、状态预测拆成多个专用模块。这样 forward 和 inverse 两个目标可以在统一 token 空间里共享表示，也更容易无缝衔接后续 trajectory fine-tuning。作者强调 STP 不是替代任务微调，而是提供更好的初始化。与直接 trajectory SFT 相比，它把局部可学习结构单独拿出来，减少 instruction-following、planning、grounding、dynamics 几种能力在同一损失里互相干扰。消融部分还表明，forward 和 inverse 是互补的：只做其中一个都有收益，但联合训练最好；另外，transition 按完整轨迹采样还是按独立 step 采样，效果接近，说明收益主要来自状态转移监督本身，而不是序列组织方式。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖桌面和移动端 GUI benchmark。桌面端在 AgentNetBench 上，在相同 trajectory fine-tuning 配置下，加入 STP 后平均 success rate 提升 2.3% 到 6.2%，coordinate success rate 提升 1.6% 到 6.8%，提升幅度会随 fine-tuning data split 而变化。移动端在 AndroidControl 上，step success rate 提升 0.9%，coordinate prediction accuracy 提升 1.3%；在 GUIOdyssey 上，step success rate 提升 0.6%，coordinate prediction accuracy 提升 1.6%。论文还给出优化层面的证据：Figure 1 左图显示 STP 初始化能改善后续 trajectory fine-tuning 的 cross-entropy loss 曲线，说明它不只是多看了些数据，而是让优化更顺。可扩展性实验有两条。第一，在固定 fine-tuning 数据时，增加 transition pretraining 数据会稳定提升下游表现，说明 STP 确实是一条可扩展的数据轴。第二，在固定 STP 设置时，把 trajectory fine-tuning 数据从 2K 扩到 18K，STP 仍持续优于 fine-tune-only baseline，说明收益不是简单的数据重复曝光，而是来自 forward/inverse dynamics 提供的结构化监督。对预训练研究者来说，这组结果最有价值的不是绝对分数，而是“便宜的局部转移监督可以持续改善昂贵的任务级训练”这个趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先读 Introduction 里对 direct trajectory fine-tuning 两个瓶颈的拆解：数据稀缺和目标耦合。然后直接看 STP 方法部分，重点理解为什么 forward dynamics 和 inverse dynamics 要一起做，而不是只做 action prediction。接着看主结果表和 Figure 1 左图，确认它既带来最终指标提升，也改善优化过程。最后看 scalability 和 ablation：这两部分决定它是不是一个真正独立的 scaling axis，而不只是额外预训练带来的偶然增益。若只是泛读，30 分钟左右足够。最值得留意的点有三个：统一多模态 backbone 的训练接口、forward/inverse 的互补性、以及 step-level transition 数据是否能替代部分昂贵轨迹监督。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a bottleneck in GUI-agent training: instruction-conditioned trajectory fine-tuning is expensive to scale and mixes several hard subproblems into one next-action objective. A model must learn visual grounding, local GUI dynamics, action semantics, and task planning all at once, while high-quality trajectory data remains costly. The paper asks whether a cheaper and denser supervision source—single-step visual state transitions—can be used as a separate pretraining stage to learn action-grounded representations and local environment dynamics before task-level fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: This is not core LLM pretraining in the narrow text-only sense, but it is relevant as a multimodal pretraining recipe for agents. The main idea is to treat state-transition modeling as an additional scaling axis, separate from trajectory supervision. That is useful beyond GUI control: it is an example of decoupling local environment modeling from high-level instruction following. The paper is also interesting because it uses a unified multimodal model to jointly learn forward dynamics and inverse dynamics, combining world-model-like prediction with action recovery. For researchers thinking about pretrain-to-post-train interfaces, the message is clear: dense, local, annotation-light supervision can improve the efficiency of later training on sparse, long-horizon, task-labeled trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is State Transition Pretraining, or STP. Training data consists of step-level tuples (s_t, a_t, s_{t+1}), which can be extracted from existing trajectories or collected automatically from interactive environments. STP jointly optimizes two objectives. Forward dynamics predicts the next GUI state from the current state and action, effectively an image-text-to-image task. This is meant to build an internal model of how GUI states change under actions such as click, type, or scroll. Inverse dynamics predicts the action from consecutive screenshots, an image-image-to-text task. This forces the model to identify what changed, where the interaction occurred, and which visual details are action-relevant. A notable design choice is the use of a unified multimodal model rather than separate modules for perception, action classification, and state prediction. That allows both objectives to share a common tokenized interface and makes the pretrained model easier to transfer into downstream trajectory fine-tuning. The paper positions STP as initialization rather than replacement: it removes some of the burden from trajectory SFT by learning local structure first. The ablations suggest that forward and inverse dynamics provide complementary signals, and that the gains are not sensitive to whether transitions are sampled as full trajectories or as independent steps.
summary_en.experiments: The main results cover both desktop and mobile GUI benchmarks. On AgentNetBench, under matched trajectory fine-tuning settings, STP improves average success rate by 2.3% to 6.2% and coordinate success rate by 1.6% to 6.8%, depending on the fine-tuning split. On AndroidControl, it improves step success rate by 0.9% and coordinate prediction accuracy by 1.3%. On GUIOdyssey, it improves step success rate by 0.6% and coordinate prediction accuracy by 1.6%. The paper also provides optimization evidence: the left panel of Figure 1 shows better cross-entropy behavior during downstream trajectory fine-tuning when initialized with STP. The scalability results are important. With fine-tuning data fixed, increasing transition-pretraining data steadily improves downstream performance. With STP fixed, scaling trajectory fine-tuning data from 2K to 18K still leaves STP ahead of the fine-tune-only baseline. That suggests the gains are not just due to extra data exposure, but to the structure of the forward and inverse dynamics objectives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the motivation section that explains why direct trajectory fine-tuning is data-hungry and optimization-heavy. Then read the STP method carefully, especially the rationale for combining forward and inverse dynamics instead of using only action prediction. After that, inspect the main benchmark tables and the optimization plot in Figure 1. Those establish both end performance gains and easier downstream training. If time permits, read the scalability and ablation sections, since they determine whether STP is a real scaling axis or just a one-off pretraining trick. A useful skim should take around 30 minutes. The most informative details are the unified multimodal training interface, the complementarity between forward and inverse objectives, and the evidence that step-level transition data can substitute for part of the expensive task-level supervision.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 STP loss 和 data scaling 图；它把 GUI agent 的瓶颈从指令轨迹转向状态动力学，值得内部复现小版。
recommendation.en: Read the STP losses and data-scaling plots; it reframes GUI-agent scaling around state dynamics rather than instruction trajectories.

paper.title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
paper.abstract: Creative AI is moving from single-step asset generation toward long-horizon multimodal production. Although recent generative models can synthesize high-quality images, videos, audio clips, UI elements, storyboards, slides, and other creative assets, real-world creative work requires more than isolated prompt-output interactions. It involves references, drafts, alternatives, edits, failed attempts, version relations, tool actions, evaluation signals, and human feedback, which together form an ev

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态创意生成系统多基于提示/聊天/节点式工作流，丢弃中间上下文、依赖线性对话或需手动指定流程，无法支撑长周期创意项目的演化状态管理。
summary.importance: 系统创新，首次提出面向画布原生的多模态创意Agent开源研究框架，支持Agent上下文表示、工具选择、工件修订、故障恢复等行为的可解释研究。
summary.technical_approach: 设计画布原生的开源harness架构，统一管理创意项目中的参考素材、草稿、版本、工具动作、评估信号等演化状态，支持Agent与多模态生成工具的交互闭环。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提及具体模型参数量、量化基线与效果对比，主要为系统架构与开源资产发布。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal creative generation systems rely on prompt/chat/node-based workflows, discard intermediate context, depend on linear conversations, or require manually specified pipelines, failing to support evolving state management for long-horizon creative projects.
summary_en.importance: System innovation; the first open-source canvas-native harness for studying multimodal creative agents, enabling interpretable research on agent context representation, tool selection, artifact revision, and failure recovery.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a canvas-native open-source harness architecture that unifies management of evolving project states including references, drafts, versions, tool actions, and evaluation signals, supporting closed-loop interaction between agents and multimodal generation tools.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model parameters, baselines, or quantitative performance comparisons are mentioned in the abstract; the work primarily releases system architecture and open-source assets.

recommendation.zh: 创意Agent方向的开源脚手架，对预训练研究员无直接方法论价值，仅作为Agent研究生态的背景信息备查。
recommendation.en: Open-source scaffold for creative agents, with no direct methodological value for pretraining researchers; only serves as background reference for the agent research ecosystem.

paper.title: OmniReasoner: Thinking with Long Audio-Video via Native Tool Use
paper.abstract: Long audio-video reasoning is difficult for omnimodal LLMs because the decisive evidence is often sparse, cross-modal, and too expensive to preserve with uniformly high-fidelity inputs. We introduce OmniReasoner, a tool-use post-training framework for Thinking with Long Audio-Video: omni-modal LLMs learn, via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, to decide whether and where to call a zoom-in tool before answering. OmniReasoner first builds a low-cost global preview of the full strea

summary.core_problem: 长音视频问答中，关键证据往往稀疏且跨模态，直接把全量高保真音视频塞进 omnimodal LLM 成本过高，也容易淹没有效信息。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态工具使用与后训练方法。它把长音视频理解从“固定采样后直接回答”改成“先低成本全局预览，再按需调用局部高保真检查工具”，对长上下文多模态系统有一定方法参考。
summary.technical_approach: OmniReasoner 通过 SFT 和 RL 训练模型决定是否调用 zoom-in tool，以及调用哪个时间区间。系统先构建稀疏全局预览，模型在需要时给出时间段参数，工具返回更密集的局部音视频片段。TimeAnchor 用时间锚而不是采样帧号表达工具参数，保证不同采样粒度之间的时间引用一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节和数值。可确认的实验方向是长音视频推理任务，对比不使用 zoom-in 工具或固定粒度输入的 omnimodal LLM，并评估 SFT/RL 后模型选择工具调用位置和最终回答的效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Long audio-video QA is hard because decisive evidence is sparse, cross-modal, and too expensive to preserve with uniformly high-fidelity inputs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal tool-use post-training framework. It reframes long audio-video reasoning as low-cost global preview plus selective high-fidelity local inspection, which is relevant to long-context multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniReasoner trains an omnimodal LLM with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to decide whether to call a zoom-in tool and which temporal interval to inspect. The model first sees a sparse global preview, then requests a denser local clip when needed. TimeAnchor represents tool arguments in time rather than frame indices, keeping references consistent across sampling granularities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full quantitative details. The implied evaluation compares tool-using long audio-video reasoning against fixed-input or no-tool baselines, measuring both tool localization and final answer quality.

recommendation.zh: 长视频工具调用的 setup 有现实感，但离预训练方法较远；只看 TimeAnchor 和 RL 工具调用设计即可。
recommendation.en: The long-video tool-use setup is practical but not a pretraining result; skim TimeAnchor and the RL tool-calling formulation only.

paper.title: Do Agents Dream of False Memories? Black-box Visual Attacks on Long-term Memory in Multimodal AI Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal AI agents increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory to ground generation in past visual and textual episodes. We show that unconditional trust in visual data creates a critical vulnerability. We propose Lucid, a black-box adversarial framework that compromises multimodal memory pipelines under a strictly image-bounded threat model, requiring no access to the target MLLM, target retrieval encoder, or the text channel. Lucid crafts imperceptible perturbations to enable two distin

summary.core_problem: 依赖长期视觉-文本记忆的多模态AI Agent存在未被充分研究的黑盒视觉对抗攻击漏洞，攻击者可在不接触模型与文本通道的情况下篡改记忆内容。
summary.importance: 安全范式创新：首次提出严格图像受限威胁模型下的多模态长期记忆黑盒攻击框架，覆盖记忆投毒与记忆注入两种失效模式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Lucid黑盒对抗框架，仅对输入图像添加不可感知扰动，无需访问目标MLLM、检索编码器或文本通道；根据历史上下文是否存在分别实现记忆投毒（上下文内替换+文本强化）与记忆注入（无上下文植入攻击者指定叙事）。
summary.experiments: 在典型多模态Agent记忆流水线上验证两种攻击模式的可靠性，可稳定篡改视觉回忆并引导Agent生成攻击者指定内容。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自加州大学欧文分校，Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque为安全与系统领域资深研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal AI agents relying on persistent long-term visual-textual memory have understudied vulnerabilities: attackers can tamper with memory via black-box visual-only perturbations without accessing the model or text channel.
summary_en.importance: Security paradigm innovation: the first black-box adversarial framework for multimodal long-term memory under a strictly image-bounded threat model, covering both memory poisoning and memory injection failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Lucid, a black-box adversarial framework that adds imperceptible perturbations only to input images, requiring no access to the target MLLM, retrieval encoder, or text channel. It implements two modes: memory poisoning (in-context replacement reinforced by prior textual context) and memory injection (out-of-context implantation of attacker-chosen narratives).
summary_en.experiments: Validate both attack modes on typical multimodal agent memory pipelines, showing reliable corruption of visual recall and consistent steering of agent outputs toward attacker-specified narratives.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from University of California, Irvine; Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque is a senior researcher in security and systems.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态Agent安全的弱信号参考，仅需了解攻击威胁模型设定，无需深入方法细节。
recommendation.en: Use as a weak signal for multimodal agent safety; only the threat model setup is worth knowing, no need to dive into method details.

paper.title: TopoAgent: A Self-Evolving Topological Agent for Multimodal Scientific Reasoning
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general tasks, rigorous scientific reasoning remains challenging due to the limitations of monolithic, linear planning. Such sequential designs often suffer from visual-semantic misalignment, long-context hallucinations, and brittle execution under fixed task granularity. We propose TopoAgent, a self-evolving topological framework that replaces linear trajectories with dynamic, state-isolated graph evolution. TopoAgent first employs a front

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型的科学推理采用单一线性规划范式，存在视觉-语义错位、长上下文幻觉、固定任务粒度下执行脆弱等问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于拓扑图的自进化agent推理框架，替代传统线性推理轨迹
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过前端分解器将复杂多模态查询拆解为具备视觉接地的原子任务，按任务依赖关系构建有向无环图（DAG）以实现严格的上下文隔离，避免无关历史噪声干扰；进一步引入自适应原子裂变机制，当工具能力触达边界时，运行时动态将瓶颈节点拆分为更细粒度的子原子任务
summary.experiments: 在数学、物理、化学等多模态科学推理任务上开展实验，摘要未明确给出具体模型参数量、基线及提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Current multimodal large models use monolithic linear planning for scientific reasoning, suffering from visual-semantic misalignment, long-context hallucination, and brittle execution under fixed task granularity
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a self-evolving topological agent framework that replaces traditional linear reasoning trajectories
summary_en.technical_approach: A front-end decomposer breaks complex multimodal queries into visually-grounded atomic tasks, which are organized into a DAG based on dependencies to enable strict context isolation and shield the reasoning engine from irrelevant historical noise; an adaptive atomic fission mechanism dynamically splits bottleneck nodes into finer-grained sub-atoms at runtime when tool capability boundaries are exceeded
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments on multimodal scientific reasoning tasks across mathematics, physics, and chemistry; no explicit model size, baselines, or improvement margins provided in abstract

recommendation.zh: 用DAG替代线性轨迹的多模态科学推理agent框架，思路有新意但属上层agent设计，与基座预训练关联较弱，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Multimodal scientific reasoning agent framework replacing linear trajectories with DAGs; novel idea but belongs to upper-layer agent design, with weak relevance to base pretraining. Abstract suffices

paper.title: SPyCE: Skill-Policy Co-evolution for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents that think with images iteratively manipulate visual evidence and invoke tools across many steps. Existing reinforcement learning methods reduce trajectories to scalar rewards, forcing the policy to discover reusable tool-use patterns from scratch on every new task; memory-based alternatives retain past experience, yet they rely on test-time retrieval, without updating the policy to absorb reusable patterns from that experience. Our key insight is that multimodal reasoning traj

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 agent 在长轨迹工具使用中，如何把 RL 产生的经验沉淀为可复用技能，而不是只依赖标量奖励或测试时检索的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 训练范式问题，不是单纯任务调参。贡献点在于把轨迹蒸馏成分层技能库，并让技能与策略共同演化，试图改善多步视觉推理中的样本效率与可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPyCE 框架，将训练轨迹提炼为两层技能：局部执行技能负责视觉操作与工具调用，高层工作流技能负责多步编排。训练过程中，策略不仅接收 RL 信号，还持续从技能库吸收可复用模式；技能库也随新轨迹更新，形成 co-evolution。核心想法介于 policy learning、trajectory distillation 和 memory augmentation 之间，但重点是把经验写回参数化策略，而不是停留在外部记忆。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点应是多模态、多步工具使用场景下，与纯 RL 和基于记忆/检索的方法比较鲁棒性与泛化。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体 benchmark，也未给出提升幅度，因此目前更适合作为训练思路参考，而不是直接采信结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学与北京邮电大学。未见可确认的业界头部实验室背景或该方向的代表性作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles how multimodal agents can internalize reusable tool-use patterns from RL trajectories, instead of relying only on scalar rewards or test-time retrieval.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-paradigm question for agents rather than a task-specific tweak. The contribution is a hierarchical skill library that co-evolves with the policy, aiming to improve sample efficiency and transfer in long-horizon visual reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPyCE distills trajectories into two levels of skills: execution skills for local visual operations and tool calls, and workflow skills for high-level orchestration. During training, the policy is updated not only from RL rewards but also from the evolving skill library; the library itself is refreshed from new trajectories. The idea sits between policy learning, trajectory distillation, and memory augmentation, with the key move being to write experience back into the policy rather than leaving it in an external store.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation likely compares against pure RL and memory/retrieval-based baselines on multimodal multi-step tool-use tasks. The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, benchmark names, or effect sizes, so the paper is more useful as a training idea than as a settled empirical result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications. No clearly identifiable top-lab affiliation or widely known author signal can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“把轨迹蒸馏成可写回策略的技能”这个接口值得记一下；先看方法图和 ablation，别急着信泛化结论。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but the idea of distilling trajectories into skills that are written back into the policy is worth noting; read the method figure and ablations first, not the headline generalization claim.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

paper.title: UNIBROWSE: A Data-to-Agent Framework for Multimodal BrowseComp
paper.abstract: Multimodal BrowseComp tasks require agents to combine perception, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning over dynamic web content, challenging their ability to handle compositional structure, open-world uncertainty, and multimodal integration across extended interactions. Crucially, real-world multimodal browsing involves three distinct information-flow patterns: text-only, image-to-text, and text-to-image, yet existing data construction methods cover only the text-only and image-to-text patterns,

summary.core_problem: UniBrowse 解决的是多模态 BrowseComp 训练数据覆盖不足的问题，尤其是现有方法偏重 text-only 和 image-to-text，缺少 text-to-image 这类先文本检索、再视觉验证或视觉定位的信息流。
summary.importance: 这篇不是基座预训练论文，主要价值在 post-train 数据合成和长程工具使用训练。对预训练研究的启发在于：复杂 agent 能力的训练信号不能只看最终 QA，对轨迹的可探索性、证据链结构、模态流向也需要显式建模。它把知识图谱的可控结构和实时网页证据结合，用来降低纯随机网页漫游的噪声，也避免只依赖静态图谱导致覆盖面窄。这个思路可迁移到更一般的 tool-use SFT/RL 数据构造：先控制任务骨架，再引入开放环境证据，最后按轨迹多样性过滤。
summary.technical_approach: UniBrowse 包含一个数据构造管线和一个由该数据训练出的多模态 browsing agent。管线从文本知识图谱出发，为 seed entity 构造连通的文本证据子图，并通过多跳关系扩展形成可组合的推理骨架。随后接入 live web retrieval，为图谱骨架补充真实网页证据，缓解纯图谱数据过于封闭的问题。任务被组织成三类信息流：text-only，即答案来自多段文本证据组合；image-to-text，即先解析图像线索，再通过文本浏览定位答案；text-to-image，即先通过文本证据确定目标，再进行图像搜索、视觉确认或视觉检索。训练数据选择上引入 exploration degree，用成功轨迹的多样性衡量样本是否提供足够的长程决策学习信号，并过滤低探索度样本。模型训练采用冷启动工具使用轨迹做 SFT，再进行 exploration-aware RL。
summary.experiments: 论文从管线生成 8K 条冷启动 tool-use trajectories 和 10K 个 QA pairs，并训练一个 35B 规模的 UniBrowse agent。实验声称该 agent 在多模态 BrowseComp benchmarks 上超过既有开源基线。提供内容中没有完整列出各 benchmark 的具体分数和消融表，但可以确认的实验主线是三部分：三种信息流覆盖带来的任务多样性，KG skeleton 加 live web retrieval 对证据可靠性和真实感的影响，以及 exploration degree 过滤对 RL 训练效率的影响。最值得关注的消融应是去掉 text-to-image、去掉 web augmentation、去掉 exploration-aware filtering 后的性能与训练效率变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 data construction pipeline 和 exploration degree 的定义，判断它是否只是启发式过滤，还是能稳定预测 RL 训练收益。Figure 2 应该能快速说明从 KG 到网页证据再到三类任务的生成流程。实验部分主要看三组消融：信息流覆盖、web retrieval 增强、exploration-aware data selection。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过 agent 部署细节；若关心 post-train 数据工程，这篇的样本选择标准值得记录。

summary_en.core_problem: UniBrowse addresses a data construction gap for multimodal BrowseComp agents: existing pipelines mostly cover text-only and image-to-text cases, while text-to-image workflows, where textual browsing determines what should later be visually searched or verified, remain underrepresented.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training data and agent-training paper rather than a base pretraining contribution. Its relevance comes from the way it structures training signals for long-horizon tool use. The paper treats browsing data not just as final QA pairs, but as trajectories with modality flow, evidence structure, and exploration diversity. The combination of a controllable knowledge-graph skeleton with live web retrieval is a useful design pattern: it avoids the narrowness of purely graph-based generation while reducing the noise of unconstrained web random walks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two parts: a data pipeline and a multimodal browsing agent trained on its output. Starting from a textual knowledge graph, UniBrowse builds connected evidence subgraphs around seed entities through multi-hop expansion. These graph-derived skeletons provide controllable reasoning paths. The pipeline then augments them with live web retrieval, adding open-web evidence and making the generated tasks closer to real browsing. It explicitly generates three information-flow patterns: text-only composition over textual evidence, image-to-text resolution from an initial visual clue into textual browsing, and text-to-image workflows where textual evidence guides later visual retrieval or verification. For data selection, the paper introduces exploration degree, a metric intended to capture the diversity of successful reasoning trajectories. Low-exploration instances are filtered out so that RL focuses on tasks with richer long-horizon decision signals. Training uses SFT on cold-start tool-use trajectories followed by exploration-aware RL.
summary_en.experiments: The pipeline produces 8K cold-start tool-use trajectories and 10K QA pairs, which are used to train a 35B-scale UniBrowse agent. The reported result is stronger performance than prior open-source baselines on multimodal BrowseComp benchmarks. The provided content does not include full numeric tables, so the most important experimental claims are structural: coverage of all three modality-flow patterns, web-augmented grounding over KG skeletons, and exploration-degree filtering for more efficient RL. The most informative ablations to inspect are removal of text-to-image data, removal of live web augmentation, and removal of exploration-aware filtering.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should be sufficient. Read the data pipeline first, especially how graph skeletons are converted into web-grounded tasks and how the three flow patterns are instantiated. Then inspect the definition of exploration degree and the filtering procedure; the key question is whether it reliably predicts useful RL signal or only acts as a coarse heuristic. Figure 2 should give the fastest view of the generation pipeline. For base-model researchers, the agent implementation details are secondary; the data selection mechanism is the part worth retaining.

recommendation.zh: 只读数据生成和 exploration degree；若指标真能预测 RL 信号质量，值得迁移到内部 agent 数据筛选。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and exploration-degree metric; if it predicts RL signal quality, it is worth porting to internal agent-data filtering.

institutions: Key Laboratory of Computational Linguistics, MOE, Peking University

paper.title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
paper.abstract: The rapid development of large language models and multimodal large language models has accelerated the emergence of proactive agents capable of operating everyday tools and assisting users in real-world environments. However, existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate such agents effectively, as they often rely on sandboxed environments and single-turn evaluation paradigms. Moreover, their scenario-based task taxonomies mix multiple model capabilities within the same task category, making it diff

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 proactive agent benchmark 过度依赖沙盒环境、单轮评测和混杂任务分类，导致难以定位 agent 失败根因的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 评测资产。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但如果你关心真实环境中的 agent 能力分解、长上下文和跨平台协作评测，这类 capability-driven benchmark 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniClawBench，一个面向真实世界 proactive agents 的能力驱动 benchmark。它围绕五类基础能力组织任务：Skill Usage、Exploration、Long-Context Reasoning、Multimodal Understanding、Cross-Platform Coordination，并设计 400 个双语真实任务，强调动态环境和更细粒度的能力归因。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示 benchmark 包含 400 个 bilingual real-world tasks，区别于以往 scenario-based taxonomies。论文的主要实验应是用若干 LLM/MLLM agents 在五类能力上做分项评测，分析不同模型在真实环境中的瓶颈。由于它是 benchmark 论文，关键不在模型规模，而在任务设计是否 clean、可复现、能否稳定区分能力短板。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港大学 MMLab。该团队在多模态与 agent 评测上有一定持续产出，但这篇更偏 benchmark 构建。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the limitations of existing proactive-agent benchmarks that rely on sandboxed environments, single-turn evaluation, and mixed task taxonomies, making failure attribution difficult.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent evaluation asset. Its direct value to pretraining researchers is limited, but it is useful if you care about capability decomposition for real-world agents, especially long-context reasoning and cross-platform coordination.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces UniClawBench, a capability-driven benchmark for proactive agents in real-world settings. It organizes tasks around five foundational capabilities: Skill Usage, Exploration, Long-Context Reasoning, Multimodal Understanding, and Cross-Platform Coordination, with 400 bilingual real-world tasks designed for dynamic environments and finer-grained diagnosis.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 400 bilingual real-world tasks and explicitly departs from prior scenario-based taxonomies. The main experiments likely evaluate multiple LLM/MLLM agents across the five capability axes to identify bottlenecks in realistic environments. As a benchmark paper, the key question is not model scale but whether the task design is clean, reproducible, and diagnostically useful.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from HKU MMLab, a group with ongoing work in multimodal systems and agent evaluation, though this paper is primarily a benchmark contribution.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent eval，可以扫一眼任务分解法；否则知道有这么个真实环境 benchmark 就够了，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent eval, skim the capability decomposition; otherwise it is enough to know this benchmark exists without reading the full paper.

paper.title: Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Generation, and Editing
paper.abstract: Recent unified multimodal models show a single architecture can jointly perform vision/language understanding and image generation/editing. However, they repeatedly feed all historical visual and textual inputs into a shared context window, limiting long-horizon multimodal dialogue due to visual token explosion and unreliable cross-turn referencing. We propose a Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent that externalizes visual information into an Episodic Visual Memory and selectively reactivates r

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理长程多模态对话里的视觉状态维护问题：统一多模态模型把历史图像和文本都塞进同一个上下文，短对话可行，但在 20 轮以上的交互中会遇到视觉 token 膨胀、早期图像引用不稳、编辑链条语义漂移等问题。论文把问题定义为跨轮视觉 episode 的检索和重激活，而不是单轮视觉理解或图像生成能力不足。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接启发不在训练目标，而在多模态 LM 的上下文组织方式。它说明 native multimodal agent 不能只依赖长上下文注意力来保存视觉状态，尤其当图像 token 成本远高于文本 token 时，外部结构化记忆和按需重注入会成为系统级建模的一部分。对做统一 VLM、AR+image generation 模型、长程多模态交互的人有参考意义；对纯文本预训练 recipe 的影响较小，因此适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把一个统一多模态模型拆成四个显式模块。Perceptual Abstraction Engine 将输入图像转成结构化视觉摘要，包括描述性 caption、属性 tag 和 compact thumbnail；Episodic Visual Memory 负责把这些视觉 episode 存在上下文之外；Cognitive Retrieval Engine 根据当前对话状态做跨模态检索，选择需要重新激活的历史视觉 episode；Multimodal Executive Controller 融合当前上下文和检索结果，自主判断任务类型，包括理解、生成、编辑、组合或普通聊天。关键取舍是不用所有历史图像常驻上下文，而是把图像变成可检索的外部状态。训练上，作者构造 Unified Scenario Engine 程序化生成多轮多模态会话，并提供 turn-level retrieval annotation；先用 SFT+RL 训练检索器，再冻结检索器优化感知抽象模块，使视觉摘要直接服务于下游检索成功，而不是只追求 caption 相似度。
summary.experiments: 论文构造 M2CA-Bench：100 个 session，每个 20 轮，共 2,000 个带标注 turn。benchmark 按时间跨度、topic shift 频率、多图交互和指代歧义划分难度，并加入高相似混淆图像和无需检索的 query，避免模型靠浅层匹配过关。文中报告 BAGEL 这类强统一模型在最难 turn 上正确检索历史视觉 episode 的比例低于 3%，说明单纯把历史视觉 token 放进长上下文不可靠。作者的 8B agent 在 20 轮英文会话上达到 91.4% retrieval accuracy，同时降低视觉 token 重复注入带来的上下文开销。消融重点在于：结构化视觉摘要优于纯文本记忆；检索器和执行控制器解耦优于单体模型；对 PAE 用 retrieval success 作为优化信号，比只优化图像描述质量更贴近长程交互目标。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 visual token explosion 和 cross-turn referencing 的错误分析，再看方法图和 PAE/EVM/CoRE/MEC 四个模块的接口定义。实验部分重点看 M2CA-Bench 的构造规则、难度分层和 hard negative 设计；这部分比最终分数更有复用价值。若关注多模态预训练，可以重点思考 PAE 输出是否应由预训练阶段学习得到，而不是在 agent 阶段用工程化摘要补上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies state maintenance in long-horizon multimodal dialogue. Unified multimodal models usually keep prior images and text in one autoregressive context. This works for short interactions, but becomes brittle when users refer to images from many turns ago, request iterative edits, or switch between understanding and generation. The failure is framed as episodic visual retrieval and reactivation, not as a single-turn perception problem.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research is about how multimodal language models should organize visual context. The paper gives a concrete case where longer context and stronger monolithic models are not enough: image tokens are expensive, and attention over a long mixed history does not reliably preserve cross-turn visual references. This is useful for researchers working on unified VLMs, native multimodal dialogue, and AR image-generation systems. It is less central for text-only pretraining recipes, so it is best treated as a skim paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system decomposes a multimodal agent into explicit cognitive components. A Perceptual Abstraction Engine converts incoming images into structured abstractions, including captions, attribute tags, and compact thumbnails. These are stored in an Episodic Visual Memory outside the dialogue context. A Cognitive Retrieval Engine selects relevant visual episodes conditioned on the current dialogue state. A Multimodal Executive Controller then combines the retrieved memory with the live context and decides whether the next step is understanding, generation, editing, composition, or ordinary chat. The important design choice is to avoid keeping all historical visual tokens in the context and instead reactivate only the needed episodes. Since existing data rarely provide turn-level supervision for visual recall, the authors build a Unified Scenario Engine to generate multi-turn sessions with retrieval annotations. Training uses a staged SFT+RL pipeline: first train the retriever, then optimize the perceptual abstraction module against a frozen retriever so that abstractions are rewarded by downstream retrieval success rather than caption similarity alone.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces M2CA-Bench with 100 sessions, 20 turns per session, and 2,000 annotated turns. Turns are stratified by temporal distance, topic shifts, multi-image interaction, and referential ambiguity. The benchmark also includes hard negatives, such as visually similar confounders and queries that require no retrieval. The paper reports that BAGEL retrieves the correct visual episode in fewer than 3% of the hardest turns, despite strong single-turn performance. The proposed 8B agent reaches 91.4% retrieval accuracy over 20-turn English sessions while reducing repeated visual-token injection. The ablations are most informative around three points: structured visual abstractions outperform text-only memory; separating retrieval from execution is useful; optimizing the abstraction module for retrieval success is better aligned with long-horizon interaction than optimizing it only for caption quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough. Read the motivation around visual-token growth and cross-turn reference failures, then inspect the architecture diagram and the interfaces among PAE, EVM, CoRE, and MEC. The benchmark construction is worth more attention than the headline score: difficulty stratification and hard-negative design are directly reusable. For multimodal pretraining work, the useful question is whether the perceptual abstraction should be learned during native pretraining instead of being added as an agent-side memory layer.

recommendation.zh: 多模态Agent的分层视觉记忆架构有参考价值，感知抽象+选择性检索的思路可迁移到多模态长上下文建模，重点看§3的记忆机制设计
recommendation.en: The hierarchical visual memory architecture for multimodal agents offers reference value; the perception-abstraction plus selective retrieval approach can be transferred to multimodal long-context modeling. Focus on §3 memory design.

paper.title: CanvasAgent: Enabling Complex Image Creation and Editing via Visual Tool Orchestration
paper.abstract: Complex image creation and editing often require more than a single generation or editing model. A user request may involve synthesizing images, localizing objects, segmenting regions, editing selected content, compositing intermediate assets, reading text, and enhancing the final result. Such tasks shift multimodal agents from perception-augmented reasoning to manipulation-centered visual creation, where tools must actively transform visual states rather than merely inspect them. However, exist

summary.core_problem: 复杂图像创建与编辑需要多工具协同执行，但现有多模态工具使用Agent多聚焦感知、搜索或窄域编辑，且缺乏大规模可执行图像创建轨迹的监督数据。
summary.importance: 方法创新与数据贡献；提出大规模复杂图像创建编辑多模态工具使用数据集CanvasCraft，以及可编排异构视觉工具的多模态Agent CanvasAgent。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含140K条全标注可执行图像创建轨迹的数据集，CanvasAgent通过多轮交互学习调度合成、分割、编辑、增强等异构视觉工具，完成复杂图像创作任务。
summary.experiments: CanvasCraft含140K全标注轨迹，CanvasAgent在复杂图像创建编辑任务上性能优于现有多模态工具使用基线模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Complex image creation and editing require coordinated use of multiple tools, but existing multimodal tool-use agents focus on perception, search, or domain-specific editing and lack large-scale supervised data for executable image creation trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation and data contribution; presents CanvasCraft, a large-scale multimodal tool-use dataset for complex image creation and editing, and CanvasAgent, a multimodal agent that orchestrates heterogeneous visual tools.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a dataset with 140K fully annotated executable image creation trajectories. CanvasAgent learns to schedule heterogeneous visual tools such as synthesis, segmentation, editing, and enhancement through multi-turn interaction.
summary_en.experiments: CanvasCraft contains 140K fully annotated trajectories. CanvasAgent outperforms existing multimodal tool-use baselines on complex image creation and editing tasks.

recommendation.zh: 多模态视觉工具编排的增量工作，数据集有一定规模，对Agent工具调用训练有微弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multimodal visual tool orchestration; dataset has decent scale, weak reference for agent tool-call training, read abstract only.

paper.title: Incentivizing Vision Language Models to Search for Long Video Question Answering
paper.abstract: We introduce VSeek, an agentic framework that transforms long-video question answering (LVQA) from a passive, single-pass perception task into a multi-turn retrieval process. VSeek utilizes a natural language-driven search to identify relevant context within long videos and is post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly formulate targeted search queries and reason over retrieved clips for LVQA. While RL post-training has revolutionized reasoning in symbolic domains such as mathemati

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频问答方法依赖单轮被动感知，难以高效定位长视频中的相关上下文，且RL训练缺乏可验证的视觉奖励信号
summary.importance: 方法创新，将长视频QA重构为多轮检索的agent任务，提出神经符号奖励机制，为多模态agent的RL训练提供新思路
summary.technical_approach: 提出VSeek agent框架，用自然语言驱动的多轮搜索定位相关视频片段；通过RL后训练联合优化查询生成与答案推理；设计神经符号奖励模块，将自然语言问题编译为时序逻辑规范，分解为原子视觉原语以验证检索相关性，提供可靠奖励
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、所用模型与数据集、对比基线及量化性能提升，详细结果需参见正文
summary.authors_note: 作者包括德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的Kristen Grauman（知名多模态与计算机视觉研究者）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-video QA methods rely on single-pass passive perception, which fails to efficiently locate relevant context in long videos, and RL training lacks verifiable visual reward signals
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: reframes long-video QA as an agentic multi-turn retrieval task and proposes a neuro-symbolic reward mechanism, offering new ideas for reward design in multimodal agent RL training
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VSeek, an agent framework that uses natural language-driven multi-turn search to locate relevant video clips; jointly optimizes query generation and answer reasoning via RL post-training; designs a neuro-symbolic reward module that compiles natural language questions into temporal logic specifications decomposed into atomic visual primitives to verify retrieval relevance and provide reliable rewards
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific experimental settings, models, datasets, baselines, or quantitative performance improvements; detailed results require reading the full paper
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Kristen Grauman (renowned researcher in multimodal learning and computer vision) from the University of Texas at Austin

recommendation.zh: 多模态agent与RL结合的任务级探索，神经符号奖励设计有一定参考性，对预训练研究员价值有限，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Task-level exploration of multimodal agent combined with RL; neuro-symbolic reward design has some reference value, limited value for pretraining researchers, just read the abstract

paper.title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
paper.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents build on vision-language models to complete user tasks end-to-end in real applications through interface actions such as tapping, swiping, text entry, and navigation. However, existing GUI agents are trained and evaluated largely on offline trajectories, simulated environments, and standardized benchmarks. These differ substantially from real applications in interface layout, interaction logic, and abnormal-state distribution, and cannot faithfully character

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI Agent 在离线轨迹和模拟环境中训练评测良好、但真实手机应用中执行稳定性不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 系统和训练评测闭环创新。它强调真实设备状态分布、异常状态、账号权限、支付认证和风控机制对 GUI Agent 的影响，这些因素通常被标准 benchmark 低估。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Xiaomi-GUI-0，一个面向真实移动环境的原生多模态 GUI Agent。核心是 real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure：以物理设备为主要交互环境，结合闭环执行、真实应用状态采样和混合基础设施来训练与评估 Agent。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型参数量、训练数据规模或量化结果。可确认评测重点从离线轨迹和模拟器转向真实设备闭环，覆盖真实应用中的布局变化、交互逻辑差异和异常状态分布。
summary.authors_note: 题名和作者列表显示这是 Xiaomi-GUI-0 技术报告，团队关注真实移动端 GUI Agent 的训练、执行和评测闭环。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between GUI agents that perform well on offline or simulated benchmarks and their poor execution stability in real mobile applications.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system and training-evaluation loop design. It emphasizes real-device state distributions, abnormal states, account permissions, payment authentication, and risk-control flows that standard GUI benchmarks often miss.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Xiaomi-GUI-0, a native multimodal GUI agent for real mobile environments. The core is a real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure, where physical devices serve as the primary interaction environment, combined with closed-loop execution, real-app state sampling, and hybrid infrastructure for training and evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training-data size, or quantitative numbers. The evaluation focus shifts from offline trajectories and simulators to real-device closed loops, covering layout variation, interaction-logic differences, and abnormal-state distributions in real applications.
summary_en.authors_note: The title and author list indicate a Xiaomi-GUI-0 technical report focused on training, execution, and evaluation loops for real mobile GUI agents.

recommendation.zh: 看真实设备闭环和异常状态分布设计；它对 pretrain 不直接，但能校正 GUI Agent benchmark 过乐观的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the real-device loop and abnormal-state distribution design; it is not pretraining work, but it corrects over-optimistic GUI-agent benchmark priors.

paper.title: SimpleSearch-VL: A Simple Recipe for Multimodal Agentic Deep Search
paper.abstract: We present SimpleSearch-VL, an efficient, reliable, and practical framework for multimodal agentic search. Its core idea is to improve the agent's own search-and-verification process rather than scaling data, tools, or auxiliary model components. For efficiency, Factorized Adaptive Rollout (FAR) improves sampling efficiency by forming more informative training groups while using redundant samples to mitigate long-tail latency and expose hard samples. For reliability, SimpleSearch-VL performs evi

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 agentic search 中搜索效率低、证据校验弱、工具链过重的问题。
summary.importance: 属于通用多模态 Agent 方法，而不是预训练论文；但它把少量监督轨迹与少量 RL 数据结合到搜索-验证闭环里，对 post-train 如何塑造工具使用与证据核验行为有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SimpleSearch-VL。核心包括：Factorized Adaptive Rollout 提高采样效率并缓解长尾延迟；在推理中显式做 evidence-verified reasoning，用 CoT 校验检索到的图文证据是否与原问题相关；保持轻量工具接口，并让 agent 自行做网页摘要，减少外部依赖。
summary.experiments: 基于 Qwen3-VL agentic baseline，在仅 5K supervised tool-interleaved trajectories 和 2K RL 数据下，8B 与 30B 版本平均分别提升 15.8 和 16.0 分。摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称与对比方法细节，但增益幅度在 agent 设定下不小。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Chunhua Shen。论文围绕 Qwen3-VL agentic baseline 展开，说明其与当前主流开源多模态基座/后训练路线有直接接口。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses inefficient search, weak evidence verification, and heavy tool dependencies in multimodal agentic search.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent paper rather than a pretraining paper, but its search-verification loop and low-data supervised+RL recipe are relevant to how post-training shapes tool use and evidence grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: SimpleSearch-VL combines Factorized Adaptive Rollout for more efficient sampling and reduced tail latency, explicit evidence-verified reasoning to validate retrieved visual/textual cues against the original context, and a lightweight tool interface with in-agent webpage self-summarization.
summary_en.experiments: Built on Qwen3-VL agentic baselines, it reports average gains of 15.8 and 16.0 points for 8B and 30B models using only 5K supervised tool-interleaved trajectories and 2K RL data. The abstract does not specify the benchmark suite.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Chunhua Shen. The work is built on Qwen3-VL agentic baselines, tying it to current open multimodal foundation-model post-training practice.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但小数据 SFT+RL 就能把多模态检索代理拉起来，值得只看 rollout 设计和证据校验那两处，别被 agent 分数本身带偏。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the low-data SFT+RL recipe is worth a look; focus on rollout design and evidence verification, not the headline agent scores.

paper.title: MemLeak: Diagnosing Information Leaks in Multimodal Agent Memory
paper.abstract: When a multimodal AI agent is asked to forget a fact, current memory systems usually delete the text entry and report success. We find that the fact can remain recoverable from retained user images, including images tagged to entirely different facts, because VLMs use implicit visual cues at inference time. We introduce the Information Provenance Graph (IPG), a taxonomy that classifies memory representations by deletion affordance. The IPG reveals that deletion fails through multiple channels. O

summary.core_problem: 多模态 agent 记忆系统在执行“事实级遗忘/删除”时存在跨表征信息残留：删除显式文本条目和直接关联的图像后，被要求遗忘的用户事实仍可通过其他留存图像中的隐式视觉线索，以及相关文本痕迹，被 VLM 推理恢复。
summary.importance: 对长期记忆系统和多模态 agent 设计有直接警示意义，尤其说明机器遗忘不能只做记录级删除，也不能只做文本审计。对预训练研究的启发在于：VLM 把视觉特征与语义知识强绑定后，“删除一个事实”变成跨模态、跨存储层的问题；未来在统一多模态建模与个人化记忆机制里，信息可追溯性和可控遗忘会成为基础能力，而不只是合规补丁。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Information Provenance Graph（IPG），把一个事实在 agent 记忆系统中的多种表征拆成节点，用有向边表示信息派生关系，并给每个节点标注 deletion affordance：可直接寻址删除（addr）、依赖来源链才能删除（link）、当前存储机制难以触及（unreach）。基于这个分解构造 MemLeak benchmark，在删除级联上逐层测量恢复率：先看显式删除后的直连 probe，再测保留相关文本时的恢复，再测保留其他关联图像时的恢复，并区分纯文本可恢复与仅视觉可恢复的泄露通道。
summary.experiments: 在 300 条评估样本上，直接探测“已支持删除”的系统，恢复率远低于 1%；但保留相关文本时，被删事实恢复率达到 18.3%；保留用户其余图像时，恢复率为 12.0%；盲基线（无图像）为 0.0%，负对照（其他用户图像）FPR 为 0.3%。其中 47% 的图像泄露无法仅靠留存文本恢复，说明视觉通道是文本审计覆盖不到的单独泄露路径。论文还测试了生产级记忆系统 Mem0，并在多种 VLM 和真实照片上验证现象稳定存在；加入语义级审计后，图像残留可降到约 2.0%，但不能完全消除。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看第 2 节 IPG 的分类法，以及实验部分对“文本通道/图像通道/组合通道”恢复率的拆解；Figure 1 给出的潜水偏好例子最直观，能快速理解为什么隐式视觉线索会让事实级删除失效。对做 agent memory、多模态对齐和个人化系统的人更值得看；若主要关心纯文本预训练本体，可只抓核心结论：跨模态表示会让删除和遗忘问题从“删记录”变成“删推断路径”。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal agent memory systems fail at fact-level forgetting: after a user requests deletion of a fact, standard systems remove the explicit text entry and directly linked images, but the fact can still be reconstructed from retained correlated text and implicit visual cues in other retained images using VLM inference.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful systems diagnosis for long-term memory and multimodal agents. The main lesson for foundation-model research is that forgetting is not equivalent to record deletion once representations become cross-modal. After pretraining, VLMs bind visual cues to semantic knowledge tightly enough that residual user data can support reconstruction of deleted facts even when no explicit trace remains. This makes provenance tracking and controllable forgetting a core design issue for unified multimodal and personalized memory systems rather than a narrow compliance feature.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Information Provenance Graph (IPG), a taxonomy that represents a single fact as a DAG over memory representations, with edges marking derivation paths and nodes labeled by deletion affordance: directly addressable (addr), deletable only if provenance links are maintained (link), or unreachable by current storage-level deletion mechanisms (unreach). Based on this decomposition, MemLeak evaluates forgetting as a deletion cascade: first probing explicitly deleted entries, then measuring recovery from retained correlated text, then from retained unrelated-but-correlated images, and finally isolating leaks recoverable only through vision.
summary_en.experiments: Across 300 evaluation examples, direct probing of deletion-capable systems yields recovery well below 1%, but retained correlated text enables 18.3% recovery and retained images enable 12.0% recovery, compared with a 0.0% blind baseline and 0.3% false-positive rate for other-user image controls. 47% of image-based leaks are not recoverable from retained text alone, showing a visually mediated leakage channel invisible to text-only auditing. The phenomenon is validated across multiple VLMs, real photographs, and a production memory system (Mem0); content-aware semantic auditing reduces the image residual to around 2.0% but does not eliminate it.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. The most useful parts are Section 2 on the IPG taxonomy and the experimental decomposition into text, image, and combined leakage channels. Figure 1 is the fastest way to grasp the core phenomenon: seemingly unrelated retained images contain enough visual cues for a VLM to reconstruct a deleted user preference. The paper is more relevant to agent memory and multimodal systems than to core pretraining mechanics; for pretraining-focused readers, the key takeaway is that cross-modal representations turn forgetting into an inference-path problem. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 设计和泄漏通道表；它会改变对“删除文本记忆就足够”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design and leakage-channel table; it weakens the default assumption that deleting text memory is enough.

paper.title: DMV-Bench: Diagnosing Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents' Visual Memory with Incidental Cue Injection
paper.abstract: Research on agent memory has matured rapidly, but almost entirely on the text side: few existing benchmarks ask, in an interactive environment, when an agent genuinely needs to remember what it saw rather than what it could write down. We introduce DMV-Bench (Code: https://github.com/yyyujintang/DMV-Bench), the first interactive benchmark for multimodal-agent visual memory. DMV-Bench is built on a controlled home-furnishing e-commerce catalogue of 1,000 product variants in which a text-leakage c

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent memory 评测主要测文本记忆，缺少能判断多模态 agent 是否真正记住视觉信息的交互式长程评测。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 和评测协议。DMV-Bench 通过控制文本泄漏，把判别信号限制在像素中，专门测 long-horizon multimodal agent 的视觉记忆能力。这对 VLM-agent 训练和记忆架构设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建一个受控的家居电商目录，包含 1,000 个产品变体。每个访问过的产品图像带有唯一预渲染的 incidental cue，agent 在连续购物会话后需要回忆带特定视觉线索的产品并导航到其 URL。论文还提出 DualMem，同时维护视觉编码和语言编码，以避免把所有记忆都压成 caption。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 DualMem 在 DMV-Bench 上优于 caption baseline 和三个近期 multimodal agent。具体 agent 名称、任务长度、成功率提升和误差分解未在摘要中给出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Dartmouth College。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the lack of interactive long-horizon benchmarks that test whether multimodal agents actually remember visual information rather than textual notes.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark and evaluation protocol. DMV-Bench controls text leakage and places the discriminative signal in pixels, making it useful for studying visual memory in VLM agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: DMV-Bench uses a controlled home-furnishing e-commerce catalog with 1,000 product variants. Each visited product image contains a unique pre-rendered incidental cue, and the agent must later recall the cued product and navigate to its URL. The paper also proposes DualMem, a memory architecture that maintains visual and verbal codes in parallel.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that DualMem outperforms a caption baseline and three recent multimodal agents on DMV-Bench. It does not provide the full task lengths, agent identities, success rates, or detailed ablations.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Dartmouth College.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 benchmark 设计，尤其是 text-leakage contract；方法部分可略读，真正有用的是视觉记忆评测构造。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design, especially the text-leakage contract; the method is secondary, the useful part is the visual-memory evaluation setup.

paper.title: ProMSA:Progressive Multimodal Search Agents for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
paper.abstract: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires models to combine image understanding with external knowledge. Most prior methods use a fixed retrieve-then-generate pipeline with a pre-selected retriever and a static top-k setting, which is not adaptive during reasoning. We propose ProMSA, a progressive multimodal search agent for KB-VQA. Given an image-question pair, the agent iteratively chooses image search, text search, or stop, under explicit tool-call budgets and with deduplica

summary.core_problem: 让多模态问答系统在知识型视觉问答中动态选择图像搜索、文本搜索或停止，而不是使用固定 top-k 的 retrieve-then-generate 流水线。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 KB-VQA 的多模态搜索 agent 和工具调用训练方法。任务场景偏应用，但显式预算、去重检索和按工具交互深度归一化的 RL 目标，对通用 tool-use agent 训练有少量可迁移信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProMSA，给定图像-问题对后迭代选择 image search、text search 或 stop，并在显式 tool-call budget 下去重检索。训练分两步：先用 rejection-sampling SFT 学会合法工具调用格式，再用 TN-GSPO 做序列级 RL，更新同时按生成长度和工具交互深度归一化，以减少长回答或多轮工具调用带来的优化偏置。
summary.experiments: 在 E-VQA 和 InfoSeek 上与强 RAG 和 agent baseline 对比，摘要称端到端准确率和检索质量均有稳定提升。未给出模型规模、训练样本量、具体提升幅度或消融细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper trains a multimodal search agent for knowledge-based VQA that dynamically chooses image search, text search, or stopping instead of using a fixed retrieve-then-generate pipeline.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a KB-VQA agent method with explicit tool budgets, retrieval deduplication, and a tool-depth-normalized RL objective. The task is application-heavy, but the optimization design has some relevance to general tool-use agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProMSA iteratively selects between image search, text search, and stop for each image-question pair under an explicit tool-call budget with deduplication. Training first uses rejection-sampling SFT to learn valid tool-use formats, then applies TN-GSPO, a sequence-level RL objective that normalizes updates by both generation length and tool-interaction depth.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on E-VQA and InfoSeek against strong RAG and agent baselines. The abstract reports consistent gains in retrieval quality and end-to-end accuracy, but does not give model scale, training data size, exact margins, or ablation results.

recommendation.zh: KB-VQA 场景偏窄；TN-GSPO 的 length/tool-depth 归一化可扫，其他部分更像常规检索 agent 组合。
recommendation.en: The KB-VQA setting is narrow; skim TN-GSPO’s length/tool-depth normalization, while the rest looks like a standard retrieval-agent composition.

paper.title: Confidence-Aware Tool Orchestration for Robust Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video reasoning language models implicitly assume that every input frame is equally reliable. This leads to what we term the Blind Trust Problem: under realistic perturbations such as motion blur, glare, or occlusion, frontier video reasoning models can suffer 15-30%p accuracy drops on real-world embodied benchmarks, while remaining unaware that their visual evidence has been degraded. To address this challenge, we propose Robust-TO, an agentic video understanding framework that explicitly integ

summary.core_problem: 解决视频推理模型在模糊、遮挡、眩光等退化帧上仍盲目信任视觉证据，导致鲁棒性显著下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献更接近通用多工具agent式视频理解，而不是预训练本身。价值在于它把“证据可靠性”显式纳入工具编排，这对多模态agent和后续训练信号设计有一点启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Robust-TO框架：先为每帧计算reliability-relevance分数，选择可信帧；再把原问题拆成子查询分发给异构视觉工具；各工具返回统一格式的证据，包括预测结果、时间定位和校准后的可靠性分数；最后在推理阶段综合这些带置信度的证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在真实世界具身视频基准上，前沿视频推理模型在扰动下会掉15-30个百分点，Robust-TO用于缓解这一问题。但未给出具体模型规模、工具集合、基准名称和提升幅度，因此目前只能把它当作agent系统思路而非扎实的基座结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tendency of video reasoning models to trust degraded frames—blurred, occluded, or glared—as if they were equally reliable, causing large robustness drops.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to a general tool-orchestrating agent for video understanding than to pretraining. Its main value is the explicit treatment of evidence reliability, which may modestly inform multimodal agent design or training-signal design, but it is far from core foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Robust-TO computes a reliability-relevance score per frame, selects trustworthy frames, decomposes the original query into sub-queries for heterogeneous visual tools, and aggregates tool outputs in a unified evidence format containing predictions, temporal grounding, and calibrated reliability scores.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that frontier video reasoning models lose 15–30 percentage points on embodied benchmarks under perturbations, and that Robust-TO mitigates this. However, it does not provide model scale, tool inventory, benchmark names, or exact gains, so this currently reads more like an agent-system idea than a clean foundation-model result.

recommendation.zh: 有一点像把 uncertainty-aware routing 搬进多模态 agent；看问题设定即可，别把它误当成预训练方法论文。
recommendation.en: This is mildly interesting as uncertainty-aware routing for multimodal agents; read the setup, but do not mistake it for a pretraining paper.

paper.title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory
paper.abstract: Long-term robot deployment requires a compact and scalable memory that preserves fine-grained visual semantics, grounds observations in space and time, and enables efficient storage and retrieval. In this paper, we propose RAVEN, an agentic memory system for long-horizon robotic question answering and navigation. RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database, and grounds retrieval in a spatial map to answer queries and navigate to goals. By operating directly on visual e

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程机器人部署中，现有记忆系统存在图像转文本损失细粒度语义、时空关联弱、检索成本高的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新（提出新型视觉时空记忆架构）、系统创新（落地真实机器人），为长时程多模态Agent的记忆设计提供新路径
summary.technical_approach: 提出RAVEN记忆系统，将带位姿、时间戳的视觉嵌入存入向量数据库，结合语义空间地图做检索锚定，直接操作视觉嵌入避免caption的信息损失，支持语义/空间/时间多维度检索
summary.experiments: 在多个模拟/真实视频QA基准上持续超过caption-based记忆系统，检索成本仅为前沿VLM的1/10；在Unitree Go1机器人上完成长时程自然语言导航的真实部署
summary.authors_note: 普林斯顿大学、宾夕法尼亚大学团队，Dhruv Shah、Antonio Loquercio为机器人与多模态Agent领域知名研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses limitations of existing memory systems for long-horizon robot deployment: lossy image-to-text captioning, weak spatio-temporal grounding, and high retrieval cost
summary_en.importance: Methodological and system innovation; proposes a novel visuo-spatio-temporal memory architecture validated on real robots, providing a new path for long-horizon multimodal agent memory design
summary_en.technical_approach: RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and timestamps in a vector database, grounds retrieval via a semantic spatial map, and operates directly on visual embeddings to avoid captioning information loss, supporting multi-dimensional semantic/spatial/temporal retrieval
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms caption-based memory systems consistently across simulated and real-world video QA benchmarks, with 10× lower retrieval cost than frontier VLMs; successfully deployed on Unitree Go1 for long-horizon natural language navigation
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Princeton University and University of Pennsylvania; Dhruv Shah and Antonio Loquercio are well-known researchers in robotics and multimodal agent systems

recommendation.zh: 机器人Agent记忆设计的增量创新，仅做多模态Agent记忆调研时可参考摘要，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Incremental innovation in robotic agent memory design; only reference the abstract for multimodal agent memory surveys, no need to read the full text
