However, existing methods face an intrinsic bottleneck due to the finite observation perspectives inherent in videos and the implicit perception of 3D scenes. In this paper, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework that assigns a Planning Agent to handle high-level viewpoint planning and supplement novel perspectives, and

summary.core_problem: 现有基于MLLM的零样本3D理解方法受限于视频观测视角有限、3D场景感知隐式的瓶颈，无法全面理解3D场景。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出协作式多智能体框架，通过规划智能体补全视角、感知智能体构建结构化认知图，实现零样本3D理解。
summary.technical_approach: 采用双智能体分工机制：1. 规划智能体分析当前认知图，确定查询相关视角并补全缺失关键视角；2. 感知智能体为不同视角的对象分配一致实例ID，整合碎片化观测到全局认知图。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据与基线对比数值，仅说明框架解决了视角有限与感知隐式的核心问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM-based zero-shot 3D understanding methods are bottlenecked by limited video observation perspectives and implicit 3D scene perception, preventing comprehensive 3D scene understanding.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a collaborative multi-agent framework with a planning agent for view supplementation and a perception agent for structured cognitive map construction, enabling zero-shot 3D understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-agent labor division: 1. Planning agent analyzes current cognitive map to identify query-relevant views and fill missing critical perspectives; 2. Perception agent assigns consistent instance IDs to objects across views, integrating fragmented observations into a global cognitive map.
summary_en.experiments: Exact model size, training data, and baseline comparison metrics not disclosed in abstract; framework is claimed to resolve limited view and implicit perception issues.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体分工的思路可做弱参考，但属于3D领域特定应用，无通用预训练相关insight，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The multi-agent labor division idea is a weak reference, but it is a 3D-specific application with no general pretrain insights; read abstract only.

paper.title: Building Agent Harnesses for Scientific Curation from Multimodal Sources
paper.abstract: Scientific discovery workflows often depend on structured curation from the literature. This is difficult for current agents because the key evidence is scattered across long text, dense tables, and figures, and the final records often require reasoning across multiple evidence fragments rather than copying a single span. We study scientific curation from multimodal sources and introduce Beaver, an agent harness that extracts structured information from scientific papers while preserving provena

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究科学论文结构化整理中的 agent harness 问题：输入不是单一文本问答，而是完整论文的正文、表格、图和目标 schema；输出也不是自然语言答案，而是可审计的结构化记录，并需要给出支持证据。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，更接近 agent 系统和长文档多模态评测。但它对大模型研究有两个启发。第一，强模型在高层元数据上表现较好，但在高价值定量字段、表格和图中仍不稳定，说明 multimodal long-context 的可靠性还不能只靠更长上下文解决。第二，论文把 harness 作为可优化对象，通过运行产物定位失败阶段，这对构造可复现实验环境、评估 agent 能力边界有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Beaver，一个面向科学整理的 agent harness。它把任务建模为 schema-conditioned extraction：给定论文文本 T(p)、表格 B(p)、图 G(p) 和字段集合 F，生成符合 schema 的表格 Ŷ，并输出 provenance artifact Ĉ，把抽取值链接回支持证据。Beaver 由三类组件组成：multimodal evidence tooling，用于访问正文、表格和图中的证据；task scaffolding，把长流程拆成可控阶段，降低一次性生成完整记录的错误率；artifact-grounded autoresearch，保留中间运行产物，并基于 evaluate-diagnose-revise 循环修改 harness。方法重点不是提出新的 base model，而是证明控制逻辑、工具接口、证据组织和失败反馈会显著影响 frontier agent 在真实整理任务上的表现。
summary.experiments: 论文构建了一个来自 PubMed 论文、带专业人工整理结果的 benchmark，强调 full-paper、多模态证据、生产式 schema 和专家参考答案。实验显示 Beaver 明显优于直接使用 frontier agent 的设置。作者还分析了典型错误：模型更容易抽取研究标题、干预、总体设计等高层信息；对数值型结果、endpoint、单位、样本量，以及需要从表格或图中读取并归一化的字段更脆弱。Table 3 报告了 provenance 相关消融，说明证据链不仅用于审计，也有助于定位 harness 失败。给定材料未提供完整数值表，因此不应只依据摘要外推具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Task 形式化，确认它与普通 document QA 的差别；再看 Figure 2 的输入输出定义和 Table 1 的 benchmark 对比，理解作者为什么认为现有评测不够。若关心 agent harness，重点看 Beaver 的三个组件和 evaluate-diagnose-revise 流程。若只关心大模型能力边界，看 Section 5/6 的错误分析即可，尤其是表格、图和定量字段的失败模式。对预训练研究员而言，不需要细读具体药物发现场景，重点是多模态长文档证据组织和可审计抽取对模型能力的要求。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies agent harness design for scientific curation from full papers. The input is not a short document or a single question, but the paper text, tables, figures, and a target schema. The output is a normalized structured table plus provenance linking extracted values to supporting evidence.
summary_en.importance: The direct contribution to pretraining is limited; the paper is closer to agent systems and multimodal long-document evaluation. Its value for foundation-model research lies in the failure analysis. Frontier agents handle high-level study metadata more reliably than quantitative attributes, while tables and figures remain brittle sources of evidence. This indicates that longer context alone does not solve scientific curation. The paper also shows that the runtime harness around a model—tools, scaffolding, artifacts, and revision loops—can be a major determinant of measured agent capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Beaver, an agent harness for schema-conditioned scientific extraction. Formally, a paper is represented by text T(p), tables B(p), figures G(p), and a canonical field set F. The system predicts a table Ŷ whose columns follow F and also produces a provenance artifact Ĉ that links extracted values to evidence in the paper. Beaver combines three components: multimodal evidence tooling for accessing text, tables, and figures; task scaffolding that decomposes long-horizon curation into controlled stages; and artifact-grounded autoresearch, where persistent run artifacts support an evaluate-diagnose-revise loop for improving the harness. The key idea is to optimize the environment and control logic around the base agent, rather than treating the model alone as the object of improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is built from a professionally curated PubMed corpus and is designed to cover full-paper curation with multimodal evidence, a production-style schema, expert references, and long-horizon extraction. The experiments report that Beaver substantially outperforms direct frontier-agent baselines. The qualitative error pattern is important: models are stronger on coarse study metadata but weaker on high-value quantitative fields, endpoint normalization, units, sample counts, and evidence that must be recovered from dense tables or figures. Table 3 includes an ablation around provenance, showing that evidence traces are useful not only for auditability but also for diagnosing harness failures. The provided content does not include the full numeric result tables, so exact gains should be read from the paper rather than inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the Introduction and Task formulation first to understand why this is not standard document QA. Figure 2 clarifies the input-output structure, and Table 1 explains the gap relative to existing benchmarks. For agent-system design, focus on the three Beaver components and the evaluate-diagnose-revise loop. For model-capability analysis, focus on Sections 5 and 6, especially the failure modes around tables, figures, and quantitative fields. A pretraining researcher can skip most domain-specific drug-discovery details and focus on what the task reveals about multimodal evidence access, long-context reliability, and auditable structured generation.

recommendation.zh: 微软的多模态科学Agent脚手架，看§3的迭代诊断修正工作流和工件化故障定位设计，对预训练多模态推理能力设计有弱参考
recommendation.en: Microsoft's multimodal scientific agent harness, read §3 iterative diagnose-revise workflow and artifact-based failure localization design for weak reference on multimodal reasoning pretraining

paper.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
paper.abstract: Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dim

summary.core_problem: 现有统一具身导航模型采用固定的观测上下文策略（如均匀帧采样、滑动历史窗口），无法在推理时被上层智能体动态重配置，既不能适配指令跟随、目标追踪、物体搜索等不同任务甚至同一任务不同阶段对视觉历史编码的差异化需求，也难以作为模块化组件嵌入长程多步的智能体导航系统。
summary.importance: 对多模态大模型预训练与下游适配的启发有三点：一是通过参数化接口结合训练时参数随机化，无需修改基座架构即可获得推理时的可配置性；二是用自然语言标签与提示前缀传递相机身份、具身类型、时序顺序等平台特定信息，新平台仅需新增提示模板即可适配，无需改动参数；三是任务特定轨迹数据与通用视觉语言推理数据共训的方式，可保留基座模型的语言理解能力。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Qwen3-VL基座构建，将所有导航任务统一为航点轨迹预测，暴露两个维度的参数化接口：一是任务模式（VLN/PointNav/ObjNav/Tracking），供上层规划器选择对应导航行为；二是可控观测参数（视觉token预算、时序衰减、各相机权重），用于控制视觉流的编码方式。训练时对所有接口参数做随机化，避免模型过拟合固定配置，无需任务特定微调即可泛化到任意推理时配置。相机身份、时序、具身类型全部通过自然语言标签与提示前缀传递，无需修改基座架构。同时设计了两层分层智能体系统：上层为Qwen3.6-Plus规划器，负责拆解复杂目标为子目标并下发带配置的导航调用；下层Qwen-RobotNav作为反应式执行器，输出高频航点预测；配合单集轨迹摘要记忆、跨集持久记忆（存储已搜索区域、候选位置等）两级记忆支持长程推理。训练数据共15.6M样本，其中85%为覆盖5类任务、多种具身形态的导航轨迹规划数据，15%为导航相关视觉语言推理数据。
summary.experiments: 提供的全文片段未包含完整的量化实验结果，仅提及训练时参数随机化可使模型无需任务特定微调即可泛化到任意推理时配置。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言部分关于固定观测策略与多样化导航任务需求不匹配的问题分析，以及参数化接口+训练时随机化的核心设计思路；浏览两层智能体的协作机制与训练数据构成；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unified embodied navigation models use fixed observation context policies (e.g., uniform frame subsampling, sliding history windows) that cannot be dynamically reconfigured by upper-layer agents at inference time. This design fails to meet the divergent visual history encoding requirements of tasks like instruction following, target tracking, and object search—even across different phases of the same episode—and prevents the model from being integrated as a modular component in long-horizon, multi-step agentic navigation systems.
summary_en.importance: This work provides three actionable insights for multimodal LLM pretraining and downstream adaptation: first, parameterized interfaces combined with training-time parameter randomization can deliver inference-time configurability without modifying the base model architecture; second, natural language tags and prompt preambles can encode platform-specific information (camera identity, embodiment type, temporal order), so new hardware platforms can be supported by adding prompt templates alone without parameter updates; third, co-training task-specific trajectory data with general vision-language reasoning data preserves the base model's language understanding capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on the Qwen3-VL backbone, Qwen-RobotNav unifies all navigation tasks as waypoint trajectory prediction and exposes a two-dimensional parameterized interface. First, task modes (VLN, PointNav, ObjNav, Tracking) allow the upper planner to select appropriate navigation behavior. Second, controllable observation parameters (visual token budget, temporal decay, per-camera importance weights) govern how the visual stream is encoded. All interface parameters are randomized during training to prevent overfitting to fixed configurations, enabling generalization to any inference-time setup without task-specific fine-tuning. Camera identity, temporal order, and embodiment type are passed entirely via natural language tags and prompt preambles, with no modifications to the base backbone architecture. A two-tier hierarchical agent system is also designed: the upper-tier Qwen3.6-Plus planner decomposes complex goals into sub-goals and dispatches configurable navigation calls, while Qwen-RobotNav acts as a reactive executor for high-frequency waypoint prediction. A two-level memory system (compact single-episode rollout summary + persistent cross-episode memory storing searched regions, candidate object locations, etc.) supports long-horizon reasoning. The training dataset totals 15.6M samples: 85% is navigation trajectory planning data across 5 task families and diverse embodiments, and 15% is navigation-related vision-language reasoning data.

summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction section first for the analysis of mismatches between fixed observation policies and diverse navigation task requirements, as well as the core design of parameterized interfaces combined with training-time randomization. Then browse the two-tier agent collaboration mechanism and training data composition. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

paper.abstract: Recent progress in foundation models has shifted toward agentic behavior involving multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, open-source efforts largely focus on text-dominant settings, leaving long-horizon multimodal tasks underexplored. This gap is evident in video tasks requiring sustained temporal understanding and iterative interaction. We present InternVideo3, a framework enhancing these capabilities via Multimodal Contextual Reasoning (MCR). MCR treats understanding as a closed-loop pro

summary.core_problem: 现有开源多模态大模型（MLLM）在图像理解和短视频问答上进展显著，但在长视频等需要持续时间理解、视觉证据定位、空间推理、迭代证据收集和工具交互的长程任务上表现不足。而Agent方向的进展主要集中在文本主导场景（代码、浏览、搜索），视觉接地的长程推理发展滞后。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发：1）提出了'agentify'基础模型的系统范式，而非仅在推理时外挂工具，这影响预训练-后训练接口设计；2）M²LA注意力设计将KV压缩融入模型架构本身，类似在架构层面做长上下文优化，对预训练架构选择有参考；3）从短到长的课程式SFT+规则RL+on-policy蒸馏的训练recipe，是后训练阶段处理长程依赖的具体工程方案，可借鉴到持续预训练设计中。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-source MLLMs perform well on image understanding and short-video QA but struggle on long-horizon tasks requiring sustained temporal understanding, visual evidence localization, spatial reasoning, iterative evidence gathering, and tool interaction. summary_en.importance: Relevant to pretraining in three ways: (1) agentification of foundation models as a training paradigm (not just inference-time tool wrapping) informs the pretrain-posttrain interface; (2) M²LA integrates KV compression into architecture design, relevant for long-context pretraining architecture choices; (3) the short-to-long curriculum SFT + rule-based RL + on-policy distillation recipe is a concrete engineering scheme for handling long-range dependencies during post-training, transferable to continued pretraining design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Multimodal Contextual Reasoning (MCR) unifies observations, instructions, reasoning traces, tool actions, feedback, and memory into a shared evolving context, framing long-video understanding as a recursive observe-reason-act-feedback-update loop. Training pipeline: continued pretraining after M²LA conversion → large-scale long-video SFT with short-to-long curriculum → rule-based RL on verifiable tasks + on-policy distillation.

We further empirically quantify the scale of this phenomenon. Over half of failing trajectories and failing tool-use actions exhibit correctable credit misassignment, demonstrating that

summary.core_problem: GRPO在工具增强型多模态搜索Agent训练中存在系统性信用错配：它将轨迹级优势均匀广播到所有token，导致失败轨迹中正确的工具调用步骤与无价值步骤受到同等惩罚。

summary.experiments: 在中等阈值(θ≈0.5)下，超过一半的失败轨迹和失败工具使用动作存在可纠正的信用错配。参数相似度与参考覆盖率单调相关。TAPO在多个多模态搜索benchmark和三种RL算法上一致提升性能，计算开销可忽略不计。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的形式化分析（将GRPO偏差分解为项I和项II）和方法部分的信用转移门控机制。实验部分关于'正确工具调用出现在失败轨迹中'的统计最有启发。预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO suffers from systematic credit misassignment in training tool-augmented multimodal search agents: its uniform broadcast of trajectory-level advantages to all tokens causes correct tool-use steps in failing trajectories to be penalized identically to valueless steps.
summary_en.importance: Offers a new perspective on credit assignment in RL training of tool-augmented models, especially search agents. For pretraining researchers, the key takeaway is that optimization flaws in the RL phase (such as GRPO's uniform credit broadcast) can systematically waste valuable training signal, and this waste exhibits exploitable structural regularities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identifies the parameter-determinism property of information-acquisition tools: similar call parameters correspond to equivalent information-acquisition actions. TAPO exploits this by constructing a counterfactual reference library from successful trajectories in the current batch, using a confidence score (parameter similarity × coverage) to gate credit transfer, and applying a conservative clamp ensuring no failing step is globally encouraged. Requires no additional models, annotation, or sampling, and integrates as a drop-in replacement for the advantage assignment step in any group-based RL algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: At moderate threshold (θ≈0.5), over half of failing trajectories and failing tool-use actions exhibit correctable credit misassignment. Parameter similarity is monotonically correlated with reference coverage. TAPO consistently improves performance across multiple multimodal search benchmarks and three RL algorithms with negligible computational overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the formal analysis in the Introduction (decomposing GRPO bias into terms I and II) and the credit transfer gating mechanism in the Method section. The statistics on correct tool calls appearing in failing trajectories are most illuminating. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

paper.title: HLL: Can Agents Cross Humanity's Last Line of Verification?

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“CAPTCHA 识别率”本身，而是更接近部署边界的问题：多模态 GUI/Web agent 能否在真实服务设置的人机验证关口前，完成一整套感知—定位—交互—验证闭环，并且不是靠偶然猜中最终答案，而是靠可被验证的、符合规则的交互过程通过检查。现有 agent benchmark 往往把验证码过滤掉，或把它当成边缘障碍；而现有 CAPTCHA 工作又常把问题收缩成静态识别或单次 pass rate。HLL 试图把“最后一道人类验证边界”单独抽出来，做成一个可控、可诊断、可复现实验环境。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对 agent 能力评测和多模态模型部署边界有直接价值。价值主要有三层。第一，它把一个过去常被 benchmark 回避、但现实系统一定会遇到的瓶颈显式化了。第二，它强调过程有效性而不是只看最终答对，这一点对今后的 agent eval 很重要，因为很多 GUI 任务都存在“结果对了但过程不可信”的问题。第三，它提供了一个较干净的 stress test，用来拆分多模态 agent 在视觉理解、空间 grounding、动作执行、状态跟踪和交互一致性上的失效来源。对做预训练的人，启发不在于“要不要训练解验证码”，而在于：当前多模态模型的能力缺口，往往不在语义识别，而在受约束交互和闭环一致性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，HLL 的核心设计是“因子化 realism”，而不是简单堆更多验证码样式。它把 CAPTCHA 任务组织成 10 个 family，并沿三条正交轴控制难度：一是任务内在难度，二是网页干扰程度，三是动态交互验证。前两者比较直观，第三点更关键：在动态设置里，系统不只检查最终提交内容是否语义正确，还通过统一 submission payload 收集结构化 telemetry，再按 family-specific 规则判断代理是否进行了足够且有效的交互。例如是否真的点击了目标区域、是否完成了拖拽轨迹、是否满足交互顺序或状态变化要求。这样一来，benchmark 不再把“答对”视为单一事件，而是把它拆成 perception、localization、grounded action、state tracking、validation consistency 几个环节。

从评测接口看，作者把 HLL 做成轻量、agent-agnostic 的环境层，目标是尽量少改动就能接到 web-agent 或 mobile-agent pipeline 上。这一点说明它更像评测基础设施，而不是某个特定模型的 showcase。论文还强调 controlled realism：不是直接抓取野生网站验证码，而是在可控环境里系统调节 clutter、页面布局干扰和验证规则，从而让失败模式可归因。这个取舍是合理的，因为真实网页虽然更“野”，但变量太多，不利于比较不同 agent 或 memory/policy 设计。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结论看，实验重点不是刷新某个单一分数，而是证明 HLL 具有区分度，并揭示前沿 agent 在更真实交互约束下会系统性退化。作者比较了不同 CAPTCHA family、不同难度档、是否存在页面干扰、以及静态验证与动态验证两种设置。主要观察是：在干净、静态、低难度条件下，一些 agent 能取得看起来还可以的通过率；但一旦加入 clutter、需要更精确的 grounded interaction，或要求提交结果与交互证据一致，性能会明显下降。论文还给出 failure taxonomy，说明失败并不都来自视觉识别错误，很多失败来自点击定位偏差、拖拽/多步操作不稳定、状态更新理解错误，以及最终答案与实际交互轨迹不一致。

就你给出的全文片段来看，具体数值、参与评测的 agent 名单、各 family 的 pass rate、以及动态验证带来的绝对降幅没有完整展开，因此不适合编造数字。精读时应重点核对实验章节中的：1）十类 CAPTCHA 的任务分布；2）clean vs cluttered、static vs dynamic 的分层结果；3）failure taxonomy 对应的定量占比；4）统一 telemetry 规则是否会对不同 family 产生评测偏置。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐行啃实现。建议先看 Introduction，把作者为何把 CAPTCHA 定义为“human-substitution boundary”这件事吃透。然后直接看 Benchmark 设计部分，重点看三条 realism 轴和 dynamic validation 的定义，这是整篇最有信息量的地方。接着看实验里的分层结果和 failure taxonomy，判断 benchmark 是否真的测到了“交互闭环”而不是换皮视觉题。最后再看环境实现和集成方式，确认它对现有 web/mobile agent pipeline 的接入成本。

如果时间只有 20–30 分钟，优先看：Figure 1/2 一类的任务示意图、benchmark protocol、dynamic telemetry 规则、主结果表、错误类型分析。真正值得深挖的问题有两个：一是过程验证如何避免把 benchmark 变成手工规则游戏；二是这种评测能否迁移到更一般的高风险 GUI 操作，而不局限于 CAPTCHA。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not really about CAPTCHA recognition in isolation. It asks a deployment-facing question: can multimodal agents cross the human-verification boundary that real services intentionally place in front of account creation, search, form submission, or transactions? The key difficulty is end-to-end interaction under constraints. An agent must perceive the challenge, localize the target region, execute grounded actions, track state changes, and satisfy validation rules. Existing agent benchmarks usually remove CAPTCHAs, while prior CAPTCHA work often reduces the problem to static recognition or pass rate. HLL turns this missing bottleneck into a controlled benchmark.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it exposes a real deployment bottleneck that many agent benchmarks sidestep. Second, it shifts evaluation from final-answer correctness to process validity. That distinction is important for multimodal agents, because a correct final answer can still come from an invalid or non-grounded interaction trace. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is not that models should be trained to solve CAPTCHAs, but that current capability gaps often lie in constrained interaction, grounding precision, and consistency between perception, action, and verification, rather than in semantic recognition alone.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central design choice is factorized realism. Instead of collecting many CAPTCHA styles and reporting one aggregate score, HLL organizes ten CAPTCHA families and varies evaluation along three orthogonal axes: intrinsic task difficulty, webpage distraction, and dynamic interaction validation. The third axis is the most interesting. In dynamic settings, the benchmark does not only check whether the submitted answer is semantically correct. It also collects structured telemetry through a unified submission payload and applies family-specific rules to verify whether the answer is supported by sufficient and valid interaction evidence. This turns evaluation into a probe of the full perception-action loop: perception, localization, grounded action, state tracking, and validation consistency.

The benchmark is implemented as a lightweight, agent-agnostic environment layer, intended to plug into both web-agent and mobile-agent pipelines with limited adaptation. That makes it closer to evaluation infrastructure than to a model-specific demo. Another good design choice is controlled realism. Rather than relying on uncontrolled wild websites, the authors vary clutter, surrounding-page distraction, and validation rules in a controlled environment, which makes failures more attributable and comparisons cleaner.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental contribution is mainly diagnostic. The paper shows that frontier agents degrade systematically once CAPTCHA solving is evaluated as a realistic interaction problem rather than a recognition problem. The comparisons span CAPTCHA families, difficulty levels, clean versus cluttered pages, and static versus dynamic validation. The main pattern is that some agents can achieve non-trivial pass rates in clean, static, easier settings, but performance drops when clutter is introduced, when precise grounded interaction is required, or when the benchmark checks consistency between the final answer and the actual interaction trace. The failure taxonomy suggests that many errors are not pure visual failures. They come from mislocalization, unstable dragging or multi-step interaction, incorrect state tracking, and mismatch between the submitted answer and the executed actions.

The full text excerpt provided here does not include the exact tables, model roster, or numerical deltas, so it would be unsafe to invent specific numbers. When reading the paper, the most important quantitative checks are: per-family pass rates, clean vs. cluttered gaps, static vs. dynamic gaps, and the distribution of failure modes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and make sure the framing is clear: CAPTCHA is treated as a human-substitution boundary, not a niche vision task. Then go straight to the benchmark section and focus on the three realism axes, especially dynamic validation and telemetry-based checking. After that, read the main results and the failure taxonomy to see whether the benchmark is really measuring closed-loop interaction rather than repackaged visual recognition. Finally, inspect the environment layer and integration details if you care about reproducibility or adoption.

If you only have 20 to 30 minutes, prioritize the task figures, the benchmark protocol, the telemetry rules, the main result tables, and the error analysis. The deeper questions worth thinking about are whether process validation can avoid becoming a brittle rule game, and whether this evaluation style can generalize beyond CAPTCHA to other high-stakes GUI interactions.

summary.core_problem: 现有工具增强多模态智能体的评测通常以基准分数提升作为工具发挥实际作用的证据，但缺乏对工具调用是否真正提供了答案必需的关键信息、是否确实扩展了智能体可解决问题范围的验证，工具调用可能仅成为形式化流程而非实际贡献推理结果。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐阶段的工具使用数据构造、奖励设计有直接参考价值，揭示了当前工具增强智能体的训练目标可能更偏向让模型学会工具调用的形式流程，而非判断何时需要工具、如何利用工具输出修正答案的核心能力，同时为工具智能体的可信评测提供了更严谨的框架。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了三类对照基线开展对比分析：第一类是原工具增强智能体的推理时无工具版本，仅屏蔽工具调用接口不修改模型权重；第二类是纯文本推理器，使用与工具增强智能体相同的源数据过滤后单独训练，训练过程不接触任何工具调用轨迹；第三类设计了仅保留工具调用格式、仅保留工具返回结果的轨迹消融实验，区分模型对工具调用协议的依赖和对工具实际输出的依赖。进一步引入样本级分解框架，将工具调用结果分为保留成功、未修复失败、有效修正、引入错误四类，结合过程级归因判断工具输出的实际贡献。
summary.experiments: 选取Thyme和DeepEyesV2两个当前表现突出的开源多模态智能体，覆盖真实世界理解、OCR、图表理解、数学推理四类基准开展测试。核心结果包括：移除工具访问后智能体的整体准确率无一致下降，生成token成本也无稳定降低；纯文本推理器的表现与工具增强版本相当，部分任务更优；仅靠工具才能解决的样本占比极小，DeepEyesV2的93.2%、Thyme的96.0%工具解决样本同样可被至少一种无工具设置解决；两个智能体均未表现出稳定的能力扩展效应，DeepEyesV2更依赖工具调用格式本身，Thyme更依赖工具返回的结果，但两种模式均未带来可解决问题集合的稳定扩大。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第1章引言中的动机案例，直观理解工具调用形式化的问题；重点看第3章的三类基线设置和消融实验设计，这是整个研究方法的核心；第4章的样本级分解和归因分析部分是核心结论的来源，可重点关注工具仅解决样本的占比统计和不同消融设置下的结果差异；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 阿里巴巴通义实验室团队，包含多名实习生和通讯作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of tool-augmented multimodal agents often treat benchmark score improvements as evidence that tools contribute to reasoning, but lack validation of whether tool calls actually provide answer-critical information or truly expand the set of problems an agent can solve. Tool calls may become procedural formalities rather than meaningful contributions to inference outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This work offers direct guidance for tool-use data construction and reward design in pretraining and alignment phases. It reveals that current training objectives for tool-augmented agents may prioritize teaching models the formal protocol of tool calling over the core capabilities of judging when tools are needed and using tool outputs to correct reasoning. It also provides a more rigorous framework for credible evaluation of tool-enabled agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three control baselines are constructed for comparative analysis: first, an inference-time tool-free version of the original tool-augmented agent, which only blocks tool call interfaces without modifying model weights; second, a pure-text reasoner trained separately on filtered data from the same source pool as the tool-augmented agent, with no exposure to tool-call trajectories during training; third, format-only and result-only trajectory ablations to separate model dependence on tool-calling protocols from dependence on actual tool execution outputs. A sample-level decomposition framework is further introduced to categorize tool call outcomes into four types: preserved successes, unrepaired failures, effective corrections, and induced errors, paired with process-level attribution to judge the actual contribution of tool outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Two high-performing open-source multimodal agents, Thyme and DeepEyesV2, are tested across four benchmark categories: real-world understanding, OCR, chart understanding, and mathematical reasoning. Key results include: removing tool access yields no consistent drop in overall accuracy and no stable reduction in generated token cost; the pure-text reasoner performs comparably to tool-augmented versions, and outperforms on some tasks; the set of problems solved only by tools is extremely small, with 93.2% of DeepEyesV2's tool-solved samples and 96.0% of Thyme's also solvable by at least one tool-free setting; neither agent exhibits stable capability expansion: DeepEyesV2 relies more on the tool-call format itself, while Thyme relies more on returned tool results, but neither pattern leads to stable growth in the set of solvable problems.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the motivating example in Section 1 to intuitively understand the problem of procedural tool use. Focus on Section 3 for the three baseline designs and ablation setups, which form the core of the research methodology. Section 4's sample-level decomposition and attribution analysis contains the core conclusions, with special attention to statistics of tool-only solved samples and results across different ablation settings. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

paper.title: Task-Focused Memorization for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents to build coherent experience, accumulate world knowledge, and achieve continual learning. However, constructing effective memory goes beyond memory module design and basic requirements such as accuracy and fidelity; the key challenge lies in determining what to memorize. Multimodal agents, such as embodied agents, continuously perceive, reason, and act in real or virtual environments, receiving an unbounded stream of multimodal observations. Fr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多模态智能体长期记忆中的“选择性写入”问题：面对连续的视频、空间、声音和交互信息，智能体不应把记忆生成当作固定摘要，而要学会根据未来任务效用决定什么内容值得存。现有多模态记忆系统多关注存储、检索、整合和纠错，记忆内容生成仍主要依赖 prompt 或模板化微调，缺少对“写什么”的显式优化。
summary.importance: 对基座和后训练研究的价值在于，它把长期记忆从外部工程模块推进到可学习策略，并把记忆质量与任务反馈连接起来。贡献不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于给出了一个可训练的 memory-writing interface：先学习通用记忆规范，再用环境任务反馈调整记忆选择。这对持续学习、长上下文压缩、多模态 agent 的在线适配都有参考意义。尤其值得注意的是，论文没有直接把所有历史压进上下文，而是学习一个低成本写入策略，符合真实部署中上下文、延迟和更新成本受限的条件。
summary.technical_approach: TaskMem 将记忆生成建模为 memorization policy。输入是流式多模态观测和近期记忆历史，输出是当前应写入长期记忆的内容。训练分两阶段。第一阶段学习“如何记忆”，通过多目标强化学习优化基础记忆质量，包括正确性、非冗余性和格式合规性。这一阶段更接近记忆写入的通用能力对齐，目标是避免 hallucination、重复写入和不可检索格式。第二阶段学习“记什么”，在真实或模拟环境中根据任务反馈进行在线优化。这里的难点是反馈稀疏、在线更新可能遗忘第一阶段能力、同时不能影响 serving。论文采用只含 2048 个参数的轻量 adapter 进行更新，并用 reward model 将稀疏任务级信号转成更密的 pairwise preference 数据。这个设计的取舍比较清楚：不动大模型主体，降低在线更新风险；不用固定摘要模板，而让策略根据任务分布改变写入偏好；不用直接依赖单次任务准确率，而通过偏好增强缓解 sparse reward。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B。作者将 VideoMME、EgoLife、EgoTempo 三个视频问答 benchmark 重构为顺序任务流：按问题类型分组，每组作为一个任务环境；视频依次输入，模型先为每个视频生成 episodic memory；问题在视频处理后才出现；回答时只能使用生成的 memory，不能访问原视频。这个设置较好地隔离了记忆写入质量，而不是测试原始视觉理解能力。结果显示，第一阶段 memory learning 相对 base model 已能提升 VQA accuracy；第二阶段在线任务对齐继续带来增益。总体相对 base model 分别在 VideoMME、EgoLife、EgoTempo 上提升 6.3%、7.0%、5.3%。从提供内容看，关键消融是 Phase One 与 Phase Two 的分离：Phase One 主要提升记忆的基础可用性，Phase Two 则让记忆内容贴合当前任务环境。
summary.reading_guide: 精读应先看方法部分中 policy formulation 和两阶段 RL objective，重点判断 reward 是否真正约束了 memory utility，而不是只奖励格式化摘要。其次看 Phase Two 的 reward model 和 pairwise preference augmentation，这是论文最有工程含义的部分：它决定了稀疏任务反馈如何变成可学习信号。实验部分建议重点看三类内容：一是 sequential VQA protocol，确认它是否避免了原视频泄漏；二是 Phase One/Phase Two 的消融，区分通用记忆质量与任务聚焦记忆的贡献；三是不同问题类型下的收益差异，这能反映策略是否真的学到了任务条件化写入。若时间有限，优先读 introduction、method 的两阶段训练、online adaptation 细节和主结果表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets selective memory writing for multimodal agents. In a continuous stream of visual, spatial, auditory, and interaction signals, an agent should not treat memory generation as generic summarization. It needs to decide which observations are worth storing because they are useful for future tasks. Existing multimodal memory systems mostly focus on storage, retrieval, consolidation, and correction, while the memory content itself is usually produced by prompting or template-based post-training.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the formulation of memory writing as a learnable policy connected to task feedback. This is not a pretraining objective paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface: long-term memory becomes an adaptive policy rather than a passive context buffer. The two-stage design is also useful for continual learning systems: first learn general memory quality constraints, then adapt the write policy to the task distribution of the deployment environment. The low-parameter online adapter is an important practical choice because full-model updates would be too expensive and could interfere with serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: TaskMem defines a memorization policy that takes streaming multimodal inputs and recent memory history, then decides what should be written into long-term memory. Training has two phases. Phase One learns how to write memory by optimizing basic quality requirements, including correctness, non-redundancy, and format compliance, formulated as a multi-objective RL problem. Phase Two learns what to write in an online environment. This stage has sparse feedback, risk of forgetting the Phase One behavior, and serving-time compute constraints. The paper addresses these issues by updating a lightweight adapter with only 2,048 parameters on top of the base MLLM, and by using a reward model to convert sparse task-level signals into denser augmented pairwise preference data. The distinction from heuristic memory generation is clear: the policy is optimized for future task utility, not just local summarization quality.
summary_en.experiments: The implementation uses Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B. The evaluation recasts VideoMME, EgoLife, and EgoTempo into sequential task streams. Video-question pairs are grouped by question type, each group is treated as an environment, and videos are processed sequentially. The agent must generate episodic memory before seeing the question. At answer time, it can only use the generated memory and cannot access the original video. This protocol directly measures memory usefulness. Phase One alone improves VQA accuracy over the base model, and Phase Two further aligns memory with the task environment. Overall gains over the base model are 6.3%, 7.0%, and 5.3% on the three benchmarks respectively.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the policy formulation and the two-stage RL setup carefully. The most useful part is how the paper separates generic memory quality from task-focused memory selection. The Phase Two reward model and pairwise preference augmentation deserve close attention because they explain how sparse online feedback is turned into trainable supervision. In the experiments, focus on the sequential VQA protocol, the Phase One versus Phase Two ablations, and results broken down by task or question type if available. A focused read should cover the introduction, method, online adaptation details, and main result tables.

recommendation.zh: 读方法设定即可：把 memory 写入当策略学习，比又加一个向量库更接近可训练 agent。

Existing benchmarks measure recall over static dialogue, collapse memory into a single end-of-task accuracy, and reduce visual observations to captions, leaving us unable to localize failures to writing, maintenance, retrieval, or use. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型能记住多少内容”，而是多模态长程 agent 在动态世界里，记忆系统到底在哪个环节失效。作者指出，现有 memory benchmark 大多把问题压缩成静态上下文里的 recall 或最终问答准确率，因此无法区分：信息有没有被写入、世界变化后有没有更新、需要时有没有被正确取回、取回后有没有真正用于决策。对带执行轨迹的 agent 来说，这个问题更尖锐，因为记忆不再只是外挂数据库，而是和策略、工具调用、环境反馈一起形成闭环。论文因此把 memory 重新定义为一个 Action–World Interaction Loop 中的四阶段生命周期：writing、maintenance、retrieval、use，并围绕这个过程做可诊断评测。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要在评测范式，而不是提出新的 memory 算法。对基座研究的意义有两层。第一，它把“长上下文/外部记忆是否有效”从单点终局指标拆成过程指标，这对分析 agent memory、长上下文建模、RAG-style memory、self-authored memory 都有帮助。第二，它把多模态证据和环境状态变化纳入 memory 评测，避免把视觉观察先压成 caption 再评估，这更接近未来原生多模态 agent 的训练与诊断需求。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这篇文章提供了一个很实用的视角：很多失败并不是存不进去，而是存了也不会用，或者世界变了但记忆没被修正。这个区分会直接影响训练信号设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者先给出一个较清晰的形式化。环境有潜在状态 z_t，agent 只能看到由 Ω 映射得到的局部 observation o_t；策略 π 基于 observation 和当前 memory state m_t 选择 action a_t；环境 ℰ 执行动作后更新状态并返回 feedback f_t。完整轨迹写成 τ=(x;η_1,...,η_T)，其中 η_t=(o_t,a_t,f_t)，再进一步切成多 session 轨迹，使得局部上下文受限，但世界状态跨 session 持续演化。这个设定很关键，因为它把“记忆”从长 prompt 内的被动保留，变成跨 session 的主动状态管理。

在这个框架下，作者定义四个可观测阶段。writing 关注系统是否把未来有用的信息写入 memory；maintenance 关注世界状态变化后，旧记忆是否被修订、删除或标记失效；retrieval 关注回答或决策时是否取回了正确证据；use 关注取回的证据是否真的支撑了最终行为，而不是只是表面命中。论文的一个设计重点，是为这四个阶段提供共享的 trajectory-level gold evidence，而不是让每个指标各自依赖不同标注口径。

基于这个定义，作者构建了 WorldMemArena。数据由 400 个长程多模态交互任务组成，覆盖两类场景。Lifelong Evolution 更像跨 session 的持续状态跟踪，强调个人信息、任务状态、偏好或环境条件的长期变化与复用；Agentic Execution 更接近真实 agent 执行，关键信息分散在 observation、action、tool feedback 和环境变化中，要求系统从执行过程里抽取可复用证据，而不是依赖整理好的叙事文本。每个 session 都标注了 gold memory points、state updates、distractors 和 answer-supporting evidence chains，因此可以分别诊断写入、维护、检索、使用四个环节。

论文还统一比较了三类 memory 范式：长上下文直接塞进 prompt 的 agent、人工设计的 memory pipeline、以及依托 agent harness 让模型自己编写和重组 memory 的系统。这个比较的重点不是谁最终分数高，而是不同范式在四阶段上的失效模式：人工系统通常结构更规整，写入和检索更可控，但适应性差；harness-based memory 更灵活，能在执行中自组织记忆，但成本更高，稳定性也更差。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见的关键信息看，评测集规模是 400 个多 session 长程任务，覆盖 Lifelong Evolution 和 Agentic Execution 两个 regime。作者在统一设置下比较了三类代表性 memory 系统，并给出四个主要经验结论。

第一，写入更多正确记忆点，并不自动带来更好的最终表现。也就是说，memory quantity 和 downstream utility 之间并不是线性关系。很多系统在 writing 指标上不差，但在 use 阶段掉得很明显，说明问题不在“有没有记住”，而在“决策时能否把证据接上”。

第二，多模态 memory 仍是明显瓶颈，尤其在需要复杂视觉推理时更突出。论文强调，若把视觉证据简化成 caption，会掩盖真实困难；在原始多模态交互里，系统更容易在写入和检索阶段丢失视觉细节，最终影响 use。

第三，不同 domain 的 memory 表现差异很大，而且在 Agentic Execution 上普遍比 Lifelong Evolution 更差。原因是后者的信息来源更分散，既包含观察，也包含动作结果、工具反馈和状态变化，memory system 需要从“过程”中抽取证据，而不是从静态文本中摘录事实。

第四，人工 memory 系统与 harness-based memory agent 呈现明显取舍：前者更结构化，但对开放环境变化不够灵活；后者更能适应复杂执行轨迹，但代价更高，且可靠性不足。摘要和正文节选里没有给出完整的数值表，因此这里不编造具体分数；精读时应重点看各阶段指标、不同任务类型分层结果，以及 error case 对四阶段失效的归因。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“问题定义—数据构造—诊断结论”三步读。

先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation。重点不是形式化本身，而是作者为什么坚持把 memory 拆成四阶段，以及为什么要用 session 化的动态世界，而不是长对话。这里决定了整篇工作的评测哲学。

然后看 benchmark 构造部分，尤其是 Lifelong Evolution 与 Agentic Execution 的差别、gold memory points / state updates / evidence chains 的标注方式。这里值得细看，因为很多 benchmark 的上限其实由标注口径决定；如果标注只覆盖显式文本事实，就很难真正测到 agent memory。

实验部分建议优先看三类 memory 范式的对比表，以及四阶段指标和最终任务成功率之间的关系。如果有图表展示 writing 与 use 的脱钩、不同模态或不同任务类型上的退化，这些是最有信息量的地方。

如果时间有限，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要把它当作 agent memory 研究的评测底座来用，建议再花时间看附录中的标注协议、任务示例和 failure case。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether an agent can retain more tokens. It asks where multimodal memory actually breaks in long-horizon interaction with a changing world. Existing memory benchmarks mostly test recall in static dialogue or collapse everything into final QA accuracy. That setup cannot tell whether useful evidence was written at all, whether stale memory was updated after the world changed, whether the right evidence was retrieved at decision time, or whether retrieved evidence was truly used. This becomes more important for execution-based agents, where memory is intertwined with policy, tool feedback, and environment transitions. The paper therefore reframes agent memory as a four-stage lifecycle inside an Action–World Interaction Loop: writing, maintenance, retrieval, and use.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation lens rather than a new memory algorithm. For foundation-model research, the value is twofold. First, it decomposes memory quality into process-level signals instead of a single end metric. That is useful for studying long-context agents, external memory systems, retrieval-augmented memory, and self-authored memory. Second, it keeps multimodal evidence and world-state evolution in the loop, instead of reducing visual observations to captions before evaluation. That makes the benchmark more relevant to native multimodal agents. For people working on the pretrain/post-train interface, the paper offers a practical diagnosis: many failures are not about failing to store information, but about failing to revise or use it when the environment changes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper starts with a clean formalization. The environment has a latent state z_t. The agent only observes partial inputs o_t through an observation mapping Ω. A policy π chooses action a_t based on the current observation and memory state m_t. The environment ℰ executes the action, updates the world, and returns feedback f_t. A full trajectory is written as τ=(x;η_1,...,η_T), where each event η_t=(o_t,a_t,f_t). The trajectory is further segmented into multiple sessions, so local context is limited while the world state persists across sessions. This is an important design choice: memory is treated as active state management across sessions, not passive retention inside one long prompt.

On top of this setup, the paper defines four observable stages. Writing asks whether future-useful information is stored. Maintenance asks whether memory is revised, deleted, or marked stale when the world changes. Retrieval asks whether the correct evidence is surfaced when answering or acting. Use asks whether the retrieved evidence actually supports the final decision rather than being superficially present. A notable design choice is that all four stages are grounded in shared trajectory-level gold evidence, which makes diagnosis more consistent.

The benchmark, WorldMemArena, contains 400 long-horizon multimodal interaction tasks spanning two regimes. Lifelong Evolution focuses on persistent personal or task states that evolve across sessions and must be tracked and reused over time. Agentic Execution is closer to realistic agent trajectories, where reusable evidence is distributed across observations, actions, tool feedback, and state changes rather than packaged as clean text narratives. Each session is annotated with gold memory points, state updates, distractors, and answer-supporting evidence chains, enabling stage-level diagnosis.

The paper then evaluates three representative memory paradigms under one setup: long-context agents that rely on prompt accumulation, manually designed memory pipelines, and harness-based memory agents that author and reorganize their own memory during execution. The comparison is useful because it exposes different failure modes rather than only ranking systems by final accuracy. Manual systems tend to be more structured and controllable, while harness-based systems are more adaptive but also more expensive and less reliable.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the benchmark contains 400 multi-session long-horizon tasks across Lifelong Evolution and Agentic Execution. The paper compares three classes of memory systems and reports four main empirical findings.

First, storing more correct memory items does not guarantee better downstream performance. Memory quantity and memory utility are clearly decoupled. Some systems do reasonably well on writing but still fail badly at use, which means the bottleneck is often decision-time integration rather than storage.

Second, multimodal memory remains a major bottleneck, especially on tasks requiring nontrivial visual reasoning. The paper explicitly argues that caption-based evaluation hides this difficulty. In native multimodal interaction, visual details are more easily lost during writing and retrieval, which then hurts use.

Third, performance varies substantially by domain and degrades on Agentic Execution relative to Lifelong Evolution. The reason is that evidence in Agentic Execution is distributed across the interaction process itself, including actions and tool feedback, not just observations. Memory systems therefore need to extract reusable evidence from trajectories rather than copy facts from text.

Fourth, manual memory systems and harness-based memory agents show a clear trade-off. Manual systems are more structured but less adaptive. Harness-based systems are more flexible in open-ended execution but remain costly and less reliable. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so it is better not to invent exact scores. The most informative parts to inspect are the stage-level metrics, the gap between writing and use, and the breakdown by task regime and modality.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: problem framing, benchmark construction, and diagnosis.

Start with the Introduction and Problem Formulation. The key point is not the notation itself, but why the authors insist on a four-stage lifecycle and a session-based dynamic world instead of long dialogue. That choice defines the benchmark’s philosophy.

Then read the benchmark construction carefully, especially the difference between Lifelong Evolution and Agentic Execution, and how gold memory points, state updates, and evidence chains are annotated. This is worth attention because the usefulness of a memory benchmark depends heavily on what is labeled as evidence.

In the experiments, prioritize the comparison across the three memory paradigms and the relationship between stage-level metrics and final task success. Any figure showing the disconnect between writing and use, or degradation by modality and task type, is likely to be the most informative.

If you only need the main idea, 25–35 minutes should be enough. If you want to reuse it as an evaluation scaffold for agent memory work, spend extra time on the annotation protocol, task examples, and failure cases in the appendix.

summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度。实验目标应是多样化图像生成挑战下的工具使用质量、生成质量和泛化表现，对比对象包括现有 agentic image generation 或 reward-based generation 方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港科技大学（广州）、美团、香港科技大学和新加坡国立大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles open-ended image generation where an agent must improve its tool-use trajectories rather than rely on a single prompt-to-image call.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a method-level design: image generation is treated as tool-orchestrated trajectories, and reusable visual experience is distilled from best-worst trajectory comparisons. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it may inform agentic data distillation for multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GenEvolve represents each generation attempt as a trajectory involving evidence gathering, reference selection, generation-skill invocation, and prompt-reference program composition. Instead of using only scalar image-level rewards, it compares multiple trajectories for the same request, abstracts their best-worst differences into structured visual experience, and feeds that experience to a privileged teacher.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to cover diverse image-generation challenges, tool-use quality, generation quality, and generalization against existing agentic or reward-based generation methods.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from HKUST Guangzhou, Meituan, HKUST, and the National University of Singapore.

recommendation.zh: 可看作图像生成版 trajectory distillation；预训练收益不大，扫一下经验抽象格式即可。

summary.core_problem: 解决多模型、多技能 Agent 中的动态调度问题：不同 LLM 和外部技能各有长处，但现有框架多用单一主模型或固定规则，难以按任务状态组合专家能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 编排方法。它把模型选择和技能调用显式建成序列决策问题，而不是继续扩大单个模型或写静态 workflow；对研究“冻结专家模型 + 轻量策略”的系统形态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Maestro，将异构多模态任务映射到一个分层 model-skill registry 上。框架训练轻量 RL policy，在每一步决定调用哪个冻结专家模型、哪个技能层级，以及是否继续分解或执行任务。方法核心不是更新基座模型，而是学习编排策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明面向异构多模态任务，并强调利用冻结专家模型和两级技能库；未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline、具体 benchmark 或提升幅度。需要正文确认 RL 训练是否有干净的对照实验，以及性能收益是否来自策略学习而非工具库覆盖。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、浙江大学、香港中文大学、南洋理工大学、同济大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses dynamic orchestration in multi-model, multi-skill agents: different LLMs and tools specialize in different regimes, while many existing systems rely on a single controller model or fixed routing logic.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent-orchestration contribution. Its value is in formulating model and skill selection as a sequential decision process over frozen experts, rather than scaling one monolithic model or hand-coding a workflow.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maestro builds a hierarchical model-skill registry and trains a lightweight reinforcement-learning policy to choose which expert model or skill to invoke at each step. The base experts remain frozen; the learned component is the routing and composition policy.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract mentions heterogeneous multimodal tasks and a two-tier skill library, but does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, benchmarks, or quantitative gains. recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 编排思路备查即可；若正文没有强 ablation，收益很可能混在工具库和路由策略里。

paper.title: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have driven growing interest in graphical user interface (GUI) agents, yet their generalization remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale training data spanning diverse real-world applications. Existing datasets rely heavily on costly manual annotations and are typically confined to narrow domains. To address this challenge, we propose Video2GUI, a fully automated framework that extracts grounded GUI interaction trajectories directly f

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 GUI agent 预训练数据不足的问题：真实 GUI 操作轨迹规模小、标注贵、平台覆盖窄，导致模型很难泛化到新的应用、网站和设备环境。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值主要在数据构造方法，而不是模型结构。它把互联网上未标注的 GUI 教程视频转成可训练的多模态 agent 轨迹，提供了一条低人工成本扩展 GUI agent 预训练数据的路线。对多模态预训练研究员有两个启发：一是视频可以作为交互轨迹的弱监督来源；二是 GUI agent 的预训练数据需要同时满足视觉状态、动作、坐标 grounding 和任务意图，而不只是图文配对。
summary.technical_approach: Video2GUI 采用 coarse-to-fine 的数据管线。第一步用视频标题、描述、关键词等 metadata 在 5 亿条视频元信息中做低成本粗筛，先排除和 GUI 操作无关的视频，降低存储和计算压力。第二步用视觉评分模型细筛视频内容，评估画面清晰度、教程完整性和任务相关性。之后从原始视频中抽取任务指令、操作时间戳、动作细节以及动作背后的推理信息，再在对应时间点截取屏幕图像，并把动作精确映射到屏幕坐标。这个设计比直接从视频帧做端到端标注更稳，因为视频压缩和帧间变化会让坐标 grounding 变得不可靠，先定位操作时间再做空间 grounding 可以降低噪声。
summary.experiments: 产出的 WildGUI 覆盖网站、移动端和桌面三类平台，包含 1,500 多个应用和网站、1,270 万条 GUI 操作轨迹、1.245 亿张截图，平均每条轨迹 9.7 个 turn。表格中给出的规模明显大于 MiniWoB++、MIND2WEB、AITW、AndroidControl、GUI-Net 等已有公开数据集。实验部分使用 WildGUI 对 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Mimo-VL 做 continual pre-training，再用人工整理的开源数据做 post-training，并在 GUI grounding、离线 agent benchmark 和在线 agent benchmark 上评估。给出的结论是不同模型架构上都有稳定提升，但当前提供内容没有列出各 benchmark 的具体分数和消融数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，Video2GUI 的筛选和自动标注流程，尤其是视觉评分、时间戳定位和坐标 grounding 的实现细节；第二，WildGUI 的数据统计和平台覆盖，判断它和已有 GUI 数据集的差异；第三，continual pre-training 与 post-training 的训练 recipe 和消融，尤其要确认提升来自规模、数据多样性，还是来自更干净的 action grounding。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可跳过具体 GUI benchmark 细节，把它当作大规模交互数据合成案例来读。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括北京大学多媒体信息处理全国重点实验室、小米 LLM-Core、中国人民大学、香港大学。文中标注部分贡献来自小米 LLM-Core 实习期间。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets the data bottleneck for GUI agents: real GUI interaction trajectories are expensive to annotate, small in scale, and usually limited to narrow platforms, which hurts generalization to unseen applications and environments.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is in scalable data construction rather than model design. The paper treats unlabeled internet tutorial videos as a source of weak supervision for multimodal agent pretraining. For pretraining researchers, the useful point is that GUI data is not just image-text data; it must bind visual states, actions, screen coordinates, task intent, and temporal structure into one trajectory format.
summary_en.technical_approach: Video2GUI uses a coarse-to-fine pipeline. It first filters 500 million video metadata entries using titles, descriptions, and keywords to remove videos unrelated to GUI operations at low cost. It then applies a visual scoring model to assess screen quality, instructional completeness, and task relevance. For selected videos, it extracts task instructions, operation timestamps, action details, and action rationales, samples screenshots at the identified timestamps, and performs spatial grounding to map actions to screen coordinates. This staged design is more robust than direct frame-level annotation because video compression and temporal ambiguity make coordinate grounding noisy.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting WildGUI dataset covers websites, mobile apps, and desktop software, with more than 1,500 applications and websites, 12.7 million trajectories, 124.5 million screenshots, and an average trajectory length of 9.7 turns. The scale is much larger than the listed public GUI datasets such as MiniWoB++, MIND2WEB, AITW, AndroidControl, and GUI-Net. The authors continually pretrain Qwen2.5-VL and Mimo-VL on WildGUI, then post-train on curated open-source GUI data. They report consistent gains on GUI grounding, offline agent benchmarks, and online agent benchmarks across both model families, although the provided content does not include the detailed benchmark scores or ablation numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Focus on the Video2GUI pipeline, especially video filtering, operation timestamp detection, and coordinate grounding. Then check the WildGUI data statistics to understand what kind of diversity is actually added over prior GUI datasets. The most relevant experimental part is the continual-pretraining recipe and ablations, because that determines whether the gains come from scale, diversity, or cleaner grounding. Readers focused on foundation-model pretraining can treat this as a case study in interaction-data synthesis and skip most benchmark-specific details.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Peking University, Xiaomi LLM-Core, Renmin University of China, and The University of Hong Kong. The paper notes that part of the contribution was made during an internship at Xiaomi LLM-Core.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据管线和清洗消融；如果泄漏控制干净，Video-to-trajectory 是 GUI 预训练可复现的放大路径。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and filtering ablations; if leakage control is clean, video-to-trajectory becomes a practical scaling path for GUI-agent pretraining.

paper.title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Existing benchmarks for multimodal memory reasoning largely evaluate systems within pre-assembled contexts, but under-evaluate whether agents can use evidence distributed across independently originated sources. We argue that source-distributed memory composition is an important and under-examined bottleneck in multimodal agent memory, especially when relevant evidence is fragmented across heterogeneous artifacts such as conversations, profiles, screenshots, tables, images, and documents. To add

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态 agent memory benchmark 过度依赖预组装上下文、低估跨独立来源证据拼接能力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。它把“source-distributed memory composition”单独拎出来测，强调真实 agent 需要跨对话、截图、表格、文档、图像等异构来源检索并对齐证据。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但对评估多模态 agent 的记忆瓶颈有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SMMBench，围绕四类能力构建评测：跨源多模态推理、冲突消解、偏好推理、基于记忆的动作预测。核心不是新模型，而是更贴近真实使用场景的数据组织方式：证据分散在多个独立来源，而不是被人工拼成单一上下文。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1877 个样本、264 个来源。摘要说明做了实验比较，但未给出具体参评模型、是否包含闭源强模型、以及不同 memory / retrieval 策略的误差分解。若只想获取信息，重点应看 benchmark 构造原则和错误类型统计，而不是逐项分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a gap in multimodal agent-memory evaluation: existing benchmarks often provide pre-assembled context and under-test whether agents can compose evidence scattered across independently originated sources.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. Its main value is isolating source-distributed memory composition as a distinct bottleneck for multimodal agents. For pretraining researchers, the relevance is modest, but it is useful as an evaluation reference for memory-heavy multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: SMMBench evaluates four capabilities: cross-source multimodal reasoning, conflict resolution, preference reasoning, and memory-grounded action prediction. The novelty is in benchmark construction rather than model design: evidence is distributed across heterogeneous sources such as conversations, screenshots, tables, images, and documents instead of being curated into a single context.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,877 samples grounded in 264 sources. The abstract indicates comparative experiments, but does not specify the participating models, whether frontier closed models are included, or how errors break down across retrieval versus reasoning failures. The most useful parts are likely the benchmark design and failure analysis rather than leaderboard numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and collaborators.

recommendation.zh: 是个评测集，不会直接改你的训练配方；只看任务定义和 error taxonomy，判断自家 agent 是否真在做跨源证据拼接。
recommendation.en: This is a benchmark, not a training-method paper; only read the task design and error taxonomy to check whether your agent truly composes cross-source evidence.

paper.title: FIKA-Bench: From Fine-grained Recognition to Fine-Grained Knowledge Acquisition
paper.abstract: Fine-grained recognition in everyday life is often not a closed-book classification problem: when encountering unfamiliar objects, humans actively search, compare visual details, and verify evidence before deciding. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate visually recognition, leaving this active external knowledge acquisition ability underexplored. We study fine-grained knowledge acquisition, where a system must seek, verify, and use external evidence to answer open-ended fine-grained recognitio

summary.core_problem: 评测 LMM 在细粒度识别中是否能主动获取、验证并使用外部证据，而不是只依赖闭卷视觉识别。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态评测基准：把 fine-grained recognition 从封闭分类扩展到 evidence-grounded knowledge acquisition，更接近真实模型使用流程，也能暴露闭卷记忆和图像泄漏带来的虚高分。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FIKA-Bench，包含 311 个公共来源和真实生活样例；构建时先用前沿闭卷模型过滤可被记住的样本，再审计图像-答案泄漏，并要求答案由已验证外部证据支撑。
summary.experiments: 评测最新 LMM 和 agent 系统，摘要称最佳系统仅达到约 25 分，说明当前模型在细粒度外部证据获取、验证和利用上仍较弱；未给出完整模型列表和指标细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学王选计算机研究所；摘要信息不足以确认知名作者或团队代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LMMs can actively acquire, verify, and use external evidence for fine-grained recognition rather than relying on closed-book visual classification.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal benchmark that reframes fine-grained recognition as evidence-grounded knowledge acquisition, while controlling for memorization and image-answer leakage.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces FIKA-Bench with 311 public-source and real-life instances. The dataset is filtered against frontier closed-book models to remove memorized cases, audited for image-answer leakage, and constrained to questions supported by verified evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate recent LMMs and agent systems. The abstract reports that the best system reaches only about 25 points, indicating weak performance in external evidence seeking, verification, and use. Full model lists and metric details are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking University; no well-known author or representative team track record can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 作为 leakage-aware VLM/agent benchmark 备案即可；样本量小，结论不宜反推到通用多模态预训练。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a leakage-aware VLM/agent benchmark reference; the small sample size makes it unsafe to infer much about general multimodal pretraining.

institutions: Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking University

paper.title: Weblica: Scalable and Reproducible Training Environments for Visual Web Agents
paper.abstract: The web is complex, open-ended, and constantly changing, making it challenging to scale training data for visual web agents. Existing data collection attempts remain limited to offline trajectories for supervised fine-tuning or a handful of simulated environments for RL training, thus failing to capture web diversity. We propose Weblica (Web Replica), a framework for constructing reproducible and scalable web environments. Our framework leverages 1) HTTP-level caching to capture and replay stabl

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决视觉 Web Agent 训练环境难以规模化且难以复现的问题：真实网页多样但不稳定，离线轨迹不能交互，手写模拟环境覆盖面窄，直接连 live web 又受网络延迟、网页变化、bot detection 和超时影响。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更偏 post-train 与 agent RL 基础设施。但它提供了一个有用信号：当多模态 Agent 从 SFT 走向交互式 RL，环境可复现性、任务多样性和局部服务速度会成为训练数据质量的一部分。对视觉语言模型训练来说，纯 screenshot 输入加坐标动作的设定也有参考价值，因为它避免依赖 DOM 或 accessibility tree 这类网页结构标注，泛化假设更接近真实浏览器使用。
summary.technical_approach: Weblica 包含两个互补的环境构建路径。第一是 HTTP-level caching：用 Playwright 记录真实网页交互中的 HTTP 流量，并按归一化 request signature 回放响应。难点是时间戳、session token、动态参数会导致 cache miss；作者使用规则化过滤 URL、header、POST body 中的 volatile 参数，并提供渐进式 fallback matching。规则生成也被部分自动化：先用 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 浏览网站并记录完整流量，再在回放失败处做 fuzzy matching，识别变化参数并生成站点级缓存规则。第二是 LLM-based environment synthesis：基于真实网站和核心网页导航技能生成可交互环境，用来扩展 domain 和 task 覆盖，但会引入 sim-to-real gap。Agent 形式是 POMDP，观测为 1280×720 screenshot 和 URL；动作包括 click、hover、text、key、scroll、stop 等坐标或参数化操作。策略模型基于 Qwen3-VL-Instruct，采用 ReAct 风格，每步生成 reasoning trace 与 action，不使用 set-of-marks、DOM 或 accessibility tree。
summary.experiments: 作者用 Weblica 将 RL 训练扩展到数千个多样化环境和任务，并在 Qwen3-VL 系列上做微调。最强的 Weblica-8B 在 Online-Mind2Web 上达到 39.2% pass@1，步数限制为 30；该结果超过若干使用约 3 倍步数的开源权重模型，并且随 test-time compute 增加继续提升。工作还研究了训练阶段、环境组成、模型尺寸和推理时计算量对性能的影响。给出的数字说明环境规模和交互训练能带来收益，但对预训练研究而言，更应关注数据/环境生成机制和可复现实验设计，而不是单个 Web benchmark 分数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Framework 中的 HTTP caching 与 LLM synthesis 两节，尤其是 request normalization、cache miss 处理、自动规则生成和本地服务机制。训练与评测部分看环境组成、RL 训练流程、模型尺寸 scaling 和 test-time compute 曲线。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体网页任务案例；若关心多模态 Agent post-train，可细看 action space、reward 定义和 Online-Mind2Web 结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses the lack of scalable and reproducible training environments for visual web agents. Real websites are diverse but unstable; offline trajectories do not support interaction; hand-built simulators cover only a few domains; live-web training is brittle because of latency, page drift, bot detection, and timeouts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is closer to post-training and agent RL infrastructure than to base-model pretraining. Its relevance for pretraining researchers is indirect but concrete: for multimodal agents, environment reproducibility, task diversity, and local execution speed become part of the training-data problem. The screenshot-only, coordinate-action setup is also useful because it avoids relying on DOM trees or accessibility structures, which can make models overfit to implementation details rather than visual web use.
summary_en.technical_approach: Weblica builds environments through two mechanisms. The first is HTTP-level caching. Playwright records HTTP traffic from real website interactions, and replay serves cached responses indexed by normalized request signatures. The key engineering issue is volatility: timestamps, session tokens, and dynamic POST parameters can cause cache misses. The system filters such parameters in URLs, headers, and POST bodies, with domain-specific rules and fallback matching. Rule construction is partly automated: a Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct agent browses a site while all traffic is recorded; failed playback requests are fuzzy-matched against the recording to infer which parameters changed; the system then synthesizes site-specific cache rules and responses for non-essential endpoints. The second mechanism is LLM-based environment synthesis, grounded in real websites and core navigation skills such as form submission, login-like flows, and dynamic search. This increases coverage but may introduce a sim-to-real gap. The agent is formulated as a POMDP. Each observation contains a 1280×720 screenshot and the current URL. Actions include coordinate-based click and hover, plus text entry, keys, scrolling, and stop. The policy is a Qwen3-VL-Instruct model using a ReAct-style trace and action at every step, without set-of-marks annotations, DOM access, or accessibility-tree input.
summary_en.experiments: The authors scale RL training to thousands of environments and tasks and fine-tune models from the Qwen3-VL family. The strongest reported Weblica-8B model reaches 39.2% pass@1 on Online-Mind2Web with a 30-step budget. It outperforms several open-weight models that use roughly three times more steps, and performance improves with additional test-time compute. The experiments also examine training stages, environment mixture, model size, and inference-time compute. For base-model researchers, the more useful results are the environment-scaling and reproducibility analyses rather than any single web-navigation benchmark score.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the framework section on HTTP caching and LLM-based synthesis first, especially request normalization, cache-miss handling, automated rule generation, and local serving. Then inspect the training and evaluation sections for environment mixture, RL setup, model-size trends, and test-time compute curves. If the goal is pretraining research, skip most task examples. If the goal is multimodal agent post-training, read the action space, reward definitions, and Online-Mind2Web evaluation more carefully.

recommendation.zh: web Agent训练基础设施的实用方案，只看§3环境构造部分即可，无需读实验细节
recommendation.en: Practical infrastructure for web agent training, only read §3 for environment construction details, skip experiment sections

paper.title: PRISM: Perception Reasoning Interleaved for Sequential Decision Making
paper.abstract: Scaling LLM-based embodied agents from text-only environments to complex multimodal settings remains a major challenge. Recent work identifies a perception-reasoning-decision gap in standalone Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which often overlook task-critical information. In this paper, we introduce PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question-answer (DQA) pipeline. Instead of passively accepting the VLM's description, the LLM critiques it

summary.core_problem: 在具身智能中，将 VLM 作为感知模块、LLM 作为决策模块的松耦合架构，往往导致 VLM 忽略任务关键信息，从而限制了 LLM 在视觉环境中的决策能力。
summary.importance: 提出了一种感知与决策紧密耦合的新范式，通过动态问答机制解决了 VLM 描述不充分的问题，为多模态具身智能体的架构设计提供了有价值的参考，特别是如何利用 LLM 的推理能力来引导 VLM 的感知。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PRISM 框架，包含动态问答（DQA）机制。VLM 先提供初始场景描述，LLM 根据目标对其进行批评，发现信息缺失并向 VLM 提出目标导向的问题。VLM 回答后，LLM 将交互反馈综合成紧凑的、任务驱动的场景描述，最后基于此描述生成动作。这种闭环交互无需人工标注，且允许使用基于文本的 RL 方法进行训练。
summary.experiments: 在 ALFWorld 和 Room-to-Room (R2R) 基准测试中，PRISM 显著优于现有的基于图像的模型。消融实验证明了 DQA 机制在两个基准测试中都能带来一致的性能提升，并验证了生成的问答和描述的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Method 部分关于 DQA 机制的设计，了解 LLM 如何引导 VLM 提取关键信息。可以泛读实验结果，关注 PRISM 与松耦合架构的性能对比。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In embodied AI, loosely coupled architectures using VLMs for perception and LLMs for decision-making often lead VLMs to overlook task-critical information, limiting LLMs' decision-making capabilities in visual environments.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new paradigm tightly coupling perception and decision-making through dynamic question-answering, addressing the inadequacy of VLM descriptions. It offers a valuable reference for multimodal embodied agent architecture, specifically on using LLM reasoning to guide VLM perception.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the PRISM framework with a Dynamic Question-Answering (DQA) mechanism. The VLM provides an initial scene description; the LLM critiques it against the goal, identifies missing information, and queries the VLM. After the VLM answers, the LLM synthesizes the feedback into a compact, task-driven description used for action generation. This closed-loop interaction requires no manual annotation and allows training with text-based RL methods.
summary_en.experiments: PRISM significantly outperforms existing image-based models on ALFWorld and Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmarks. Ablation studies demonstrate consistent performance gains from the DQA mechanism across both benchmarks and validate the effectiveness of the generated questions, answers, and descriptions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section detailing the DQA mechanism to understand how the LLM guides the VLM to extract key information. Skim the experimental results, paying attention to the performance comparison between PRISM and loosely coupled architectures. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态具身Agent架构的有效探索，VLM与LLM闭环交互的设计值得在Agent系统中借鉴。只看方法部分和实验结果即可。
recommendation.en: Useful exploration of embodied multimodal agent architecture; the closed-loop VLM-LLM interaction design is transferable to agent systems. Read method and results only.

paper.title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents
paper.abstract: Deep search has become a crucial capability for frontier multimodal agents, enabling models to solve complex questions through active search, evidence verification, and multi-step reasoning. Despite rapid progress, top-tier multimodal search agents remain difficult to reproduce, largely due to the absence of open high-quality training data, transparent trajectory synthesis pipelines, or detailed training recipes. To this end, we introduce OpenSearch-VL, a fully open-source recipe for training fr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体、也很难复现的问题：如何用开放数据和开放训练流程，把多模态 deep search agent 训练到接近前沿闭源系统的水平。难点不在单轮 VQA，而在长轨迹、多工具、图像证据不完美、检索链条多跳、以及 RL 训练中频繁出现的工具失败。全文围绕三个瓶颈展开：高质量多跳图文搜索数据从哪里来；工具环境如何覆盖真实视觉输入中的预处理需求；长轨迹 agentic RL 遇到中途 fatal failure 时，怎样保留前半段有效学习信号而不过度污染梯度。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接相关性不如纯预训练论文强，但它在 pretrain↔post-train 接口上有实质信息量，尤其适合关注 tool-use、agentic RL、数据合成和多模态训练配方的人。价值主要有三点。第一，它把“搜索能力”拆成了可训练的数据结构，而不是只靠人工标注或闭源轨迹蒸馏，这对后续构造知识密集型多模态训练集有参考意义。第二，它提出的 fatal-aware RL 处理长轨迹失败的方式很工程化，也很贴近真实 agent 训练中的噪声来源。第三，它把视觉预处理工具和检索工具放进同一决策回路，说明多模态 agent 的瓶颈不只是 reasoning，也包括输入清洗和证据可读性。贡献量级在 agent 方向里算扎实，尤其因为数据、代码、模型都计划开放；但如果只从“LLM 预训练新范式”看，它更偏 post-train/agent recipe，而不是基座建模本身。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案由数据、工具、训练三部分组成。数据方面，作者从 Wikipedia hyperlink graph 出发采样多跳实体路径，再把中间实体改写成模糊描述，构造成需要逐步定位实体、验证证据、再继续搜索的图文问答样本。这里的关键不是简单把 wiki 页面转成 QA，而是通过 fuzzy entity rewriting 和过滤机制，尽量避免模型靠一步图像检索或表面匹配走捷径。作者还做了 source-anchor visual grounding，把问题和图像中的可见锚点、页面来源、后续检索链条绑定起来，提升训练轨迹的可执行性。最终形成两个数据集：SearchVL-SFT-36k 用于监督微调，SearchVL-RL-8k 用于 agentic RL。工具环境方面，除了常规 search，还加入 OCR、crop、sharpen、super-resolution、perspective correction 等视觉工具。这样设计的原因很直接：真实图片常常模糊、倾斜、分辨率低，若不先做视觉修复，后续检索查询本身就会失真。训练方面，作者基于 GRPO 做长轨迹多轮工具使用 RL，并针对 fatal failure 设计了两点改动。其一是 fatal-aware token masking：一旦某步工具调用彻底失败，后续无意义 token 不参与优化，避免错误后缀把梯度带偏。其二是 one-sided advantage clamping：保留失败前有价值的推理和动作片段，让部分成功轨迹仍能提供正向学习信号，而不是整条 rollout 作废。这个设计明显是在解决 agent RL 中 credit assignment 粗糙、失败传播过强的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个多模态 deep search benchmark，摘要里明确给出相对 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B agentic baseline 的平均分从 47.8 提升到 61.6，平均增幅 13.8 分。分项提升包括 VDR +13.3、MMSearch +24.5、FVQA +10.2、InfoSeek +16.2，说明收益不局限于单一数据集。模型名显示主力系统是 OpenSearch-VL-30B-A3B，底座应为 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B。全文主张其在若干 benchmark 上可比甚至超过部分闭源商业模型，这一点如果精读时建议核对具体表格中的评测设置和是否使用相同工具预算。更值得看的是消融：数据构造中多跳路径采样、模糊实体改写、过滤策略分别贡献多少；工具集合里视觉预处理工具对低质图像样本的提升有多大；fatal-aware masking 与 one-sided advantage clamping 各自带来多少收益。就摘要和正文前半部分看，作者强调简单丢弃失败轨迹会浪费 pre-failure reasoning，而保留完整失败轨迹又会引入噪声，说明他们的 RL 改动在长轨迹任务上应当有稳定收益。若全文表格完整，建议重点核对成功率、平均工具步数、失败类型分布，以及 RL 前后在不同难度样本上的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇值得精读，但要带着问题读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，明确作者解决的是哪三类瓶颈：数据、工具、RL。然后重点读数据构造章节，尤其是 Wikipedia path sampling、fuzzy entity rewriting、source-anchor grounding 和过滤规则，因为这部分决定了模型学到的是“多跳搜索”还是“模板化检索”。接着读 RL 章节，重点看 fatal-aware token masking 和 one-sided advantage clamping 的公式、伪代码、以及失败轨迹示例。这里最值得深挖的是：他们如何定义 fatal failure，mask 到哪里为止，advantage clamp 是否会引入偏差，以及为什么不用更常见的 trajectory-level filtering。实验部分建议优先看主表、数据消融、工具消融、RL 消融，以及按图像质量或问题类型分组的结果。若时间有限，1 小时可抓住主线；若你做 agent RL 或多模态 post-train，建议花 2 小时把附录里的 prompt、工具接口、奖励设计和失败案例也看掉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a concrete and difficult reproducibility problem: how to train a strong multimodal deep-search agent with an open recipe rather than proprietary data and hidden trajectories. The challenge is not single-turn VQA. It is long-horizon, tool-using search over imperfect visual inputs, multi-hop evidence chains, and reinforcement learning under frequent tool failures. The full paper is organized around three bottlenecks: how to build high-quality multimodal multi-hop search data, how to provide a tool environment that handles real visual noise before retrieval, and how to train with agentic RL when many rollouts become partially invalid after a fatal tool error.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant at the pretrain/post-train interface, especially for researchers interested in tool use, agentic RL, multimodal data construction, and training recipes. Its main value comes from three places. First, it turns search capability into a data-generation problem with explicit structure, rather than relying only on manual annotation or closed trajectory distillation. That is useful for future knowledge-intensive multimodal training sets. Second, the fatal-aware RL design addresses a real failure mode in long-horizon agent training: useful reasoning often exists before a rollout collapses, and standard filtering wastes it. Third, the paper integrates visual preprocessing tools with retrieval tools in one decision loop, which is an important reminder that multimodal agent performance depends not only on reasoning but also on making evidence legible. The contribution is substantial within the agent setting, though it is better viewed as a post-training/agent recipe than as a new foundation-modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach has three components: data, tools, and training. For data, the authors start from the Wikipedia hyperlink graph, sample multi-hop entity paths, and convert them into image-grounded question-answer instances by rewriting intermediate entities into fuzzy descriptions. This is meant to suppress shortcut behavior such as one-hop image lookup or direct string matching. They further add source-anchor visual grounding so that the question, visible image anchors, source pages, and downstream retrieval chain remain executable as a training trajectory. The resulting datasets are SearchVL-SFT-36k for supervised fine-tuning and SearchVL-RL-8k for agentic RL. For tools, the environment includes not only search but also OCR, cropping, sharpening, super-resolution, and perspective correction. That design choice is practical: many real images are blurry, skewed, low-resolution, or cluttered, so retrieval quality depends on visual cleanup before querying external knowledge. For training, the paper builds on GRPO for long-horizon multimodal tool use and introduces two modifications for fatal failures. Fatal-aware token masking removes invalid post-failure suffix tokens from optimization once a tool call irrecoverably fails. One-sided advantage clamping preserves useful pre-failure reasoning and action segments so partially successful rollouts still contribute learning signal. Together, these changes target a common agent-RL problem: coarse credit assignment under cascading failures.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers seven multimodal deep-search benchmarks. The headline result is an average score improvement from 47.8 to 61.6 over a Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B agentic baseline, a gain of 13.8 points. Reported benchmark gains include +13.3 on VDR, +24.5 on MMSearch, +10.2 on FVQA, and +16.2 on InfoSeek. The main model appears to be OpenSearch-VL-30B-A3B built on top of Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B. The paper also claims performance comparable to, and in some cases better than, proprietary commercial systems on several benchmarks; when reading closely, it is worth checking tool budgets and evaluation conditions for those comparisons. The most informative parts are likely the ablations: how much comes from multi-hop path sampling, fuzzy entity rewriting, and filtering in the data pipeline; how much the visual preprocessing tools help on degraded images; and how much each RL component contributes. The paper explicitly argues that discarding failed trajectories wastes useful pre-failure reasoning, while keeping full failed rollouts injects noisy gradients, so the RL modifications are intended to produce stable gains specifically in long-horizon settings. If the full tables are available, the most useful metrics to inspect are success rate, average number of tool steps, failure-type breakdown, and gains by difficulty or image quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a full read, but with a clear agenda. Start with the introduction and method overview to frame the three bottlenecks: data, tools, and RL. Then read the data-construction section carefully, especially Wikipedia path sampling, fuzzy entity rewriting, source-anchor grounding, and filtering rules. That part determines whether the model is learning genuine multi-hop search or just templated retrieval. Next, read the RL section in detail, focusing on the formal definition of fatal failure, the masking boundary, the one-sided advantage clamping rule, and the rollout examples. The key questions are why this is preferable to trajectory-level filtering, what bias the clamping may introduce, and how much useful signal survives after masking. In experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, data ablations, tool ablations, RL ablations, and any breakdown by image quality or question type. About one hour is enough to get the main ideas; if you work on agent RL or multimodal post-training, two hours on the appendix is justified for prompts, tool interfaces, reward design, and failure cases.
