paper.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: We present GLM-5V-Turbo, a step toward native foundation models for multimodal agents. As foundation models are increasingly deployed in real environments, agentic capability depends not only on language reasoning, but also on the ability to perceive, interpret, and act over heterogeneous contexts such as images, videos, webpages, documents, GUIs. GLM-5V-Turbo is built around this objective: multimodal perception is integrated as a core component of reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：如果目标不是做一个“能看图的聊天模型”，而是做一个真正可执行多模态 agent 的基础模型，那么视觉感知、语言推理、工具调用、规划和执行应该怎样在同一个训练体系里被原生整合。论文关心的核心矛盾有两个。第一，多模态能力常常被当作外挂接口接到语言模型上，导致视觉只负责提供局部证据，无法深度参与推理和行动。第二，agent 能力如果直接端到端优化，训练信号稀疏、验证困难、任务定义不稳定，容易学到脆弱策略。GLM-5V-Turbo 试图通过新的视觉编码器、适配多模态输入的 multi-token prediction、深度融合的多模态训练，以及大规模多任务 RL，把“看、想、用工具、执行”放进一个更统一的基础模型框架。
summary.importance: 从基座研究角度，这篇工作的价值不在 benchmark 罗列，而在它展示了一条 native multimodal foundation model 的工程路线。它同时覆盖视觉 tokenizer/encoder、预训练 recipe、语言模型训练目标扩展、SFT 与 RL 的衔接、以及 agent 基础设施。对预训练研究员最有启发的有三点。第一，视觉侧不是简单接一个现成 encoder，而是单独做两阶段预训练，并明确处理表示学习与跨模态对齐的张力。第二，作者把 MTP 从纯文本扩展到多模态，讨论了 image token 应该怎样进入 MTP head，这属于训练目标层面的设计，而不是普通系统技巧。第三，论文强调 agent 能力更适合分层优化，而不是一把梭端到端训练，这对 pretrain 和 post-train 接口很有参考意义。需要注意的是，这篇工作更偏系统化技术报告，预训练细节虽有信息量，但很多结论仍需结合后续公开实验或复现来判断稳健性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有四个关键部分。第一是视觉编码器 CogViT。作者没有直接沿用通用 CLIP/ViT，而是做了两阶段预训练。阶段一是蒸馏式 masked image modeling，用 student ViT 重建被 mask 区域在双教师特征空间中的表示：SigLIP2 提供偏语义的表征，DINOv3 提供偏纹理/局部结构的表征。35% masking ratio，224×224 分辨率，数据配比是 80% 高质量自然图像、10% instruction-following data、10% scientific imagery。这里的设计意图很明确：先把视觉 backbone 的通用感知能力打牢，避免过早被图文对齐目标牵着走。训练上使用 Muon optimizer，并引入 QK-Norm 来抑制注意力 logit 爆炸，说明作者在大规模视觉预训练稳定性上做了针对性处理。阶段二转向 contrastive image-text pretraining，用 SigLIP loss 做图文对齐。升级点包括 NaFlex 可变分辨率输入、64K global batch 的大规模对比训练、以及 8B 中英双语图文语料。这里体现的是先表示、后对齐的路线，而不是从头只做对比学习。

第二是 MMTP，Multimodal Multi-Token Prediction。标准 MTP 在文本里很自然，因为 prefix token 可以直接嵌入后送入 MTP head；但多模态场景下，图像 token 怎么传给 MTP head 并不显然。作者比较了三种方案：直接传视觉 embedding；在 MTP head 里完全屏蔽视觉 token，退化成 text-only MTP；保留视觉位置信息，但把视觉 token 内容替换成共享可学习的 <|image|> token。最终采用第三种。原因是它在优化和系统效率之间更平衡：直接传视觉 embedding 会增加 head 侧负担和不稳定性；完全屏蔽视觉 token 又损失多模态条件信息；共享 special token 则保留“这里有图像”的结构信号和位置信息，同时避免把高维视觉特征直接灌进 MTP head。这个点很值得预训练研究员关注，因为它触及多模态 LM 训练目标如何与基础设施兼容的问题。

第三是多模态训练与深度融合。论文强调 vision-language integration 不是只在 SFT 阶段做，而是贯穿 pre-training 和 supervised fine-tuning。虽然公开内容没有把所有数据配比和 curriculum 细节完全展开，但可以看出作者在追求“视觉参与推理主干”，而不是“视觉先编码成几个 token 再让语言模型自己想办法用”。

第四是 joint RL 与 agent 基础设施。作者在 30 多类任务上做联合强化学习，覆盖 perception、reasoning、agentic capabilities，并配套优化了大规模 multimodal RL 的基础设施。更重要的是，论文明确总结出一个经验：agent 能力往往通过 hierarchical optimization 学得更好，而不是 monolithic end-to-end training。这意味着他们实际训练中很可能把感知、工具使用、规划、执行拆成不同层次或不同阶段优化，而不是只用统一 reward 直接推全链路。
summary.experiments: 视觉侧，CogViT 在 general object recognition、fine-grained understanding、geometric/spatial perception 上给出竞争性结果，论文用 Figure 1 做了汇总展示。虽然这里更像 encoder 报告而非独立论文，但它说明两阶段 recipe 不是只服务某个单一 benchmark。模型整体上，GLM-5V-Turbo 在多模态 agent 相关 benchmark 上给出一组较强结果：ImageMining 30.7，BrowseComp-VL 51.9，MMSearch 72.9，SimpleVQA 78.2；GUI agent 任务上 AndroidWorld 75.7，OSWorld 62.3；Claw 体系评测上 PinchBench 87.0/80.7，ClawEval 57.7/75.0，ZClawBench 57.6。编码方面，多模态 Design2Code 94.8，超过 Claude Opus 4.6；文本代码能力也没有因多模态扩展而明显受损，CC-Backend 22.8、CC-Frontend 68.4、CC-RepoExploration 72.2，甚至超过语言基座 GLM-5-Turbo。对预训练读者更值得看的不是这些绝对分，而是几个设计选择的实验支持：一是 MMTP 三种视觉 token 传递方式的比较，最终为何 <|image|> 占优；二是 CogViT 两阶段预训练是否优于直接图文对齐；三是 joint RL 是否真的带来多任务泛化，而不是只在少数 agent benchmark 上过拟合。若正文给出消融，重点应关注 Muon、QK-Norm、NaFlex、SigLIP loss、大 batch bilingual corpus 这些训练 recipe 对稳定性和迁移性的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 如果从基座预训练角度读，优先看 Model, Training, and Infrastructure 这一节。先抓 CogViT 的两阶段 recipe：为什么先做蒸馏式 MIM，再做对比式图文对齐；双教师 SigLIP2 + DINOv3 分别提供什么；QK-Norm 和 Muon 在这里解决什么训练问题。然后重点看 MMTP 的设计比较，这部分最接近“训练目标创新”，也是全文里最有可迁移性的点。接着再看多模态训练和 joint RL，判断作者所谓 hierarchical optimization 到底落在数据组织、损失设计还是训练阶段划分上。实验部分不必逐个 benchmark 细读，先看能支持设计选择的消融和对比。若只想快速把握主线，30 分钟内读完 CogViT + MMTP + 关键 benchmark 表即可。若要深读，建议额外追问三个问题：第一，MMTP 在多模态下是否真的改善 sample efficiency 或 generation length；第二，视觉 encoder 的独立增强是否会和 LLM 主干对齐产生张力；第三，joint RL 的收益有多少来自任务覆盖面扩大，有多少来自 reward/verification 体系本身更成熟。
summary.authors_note: 智谱 GLM 团队技术报告，围绕 GLM-5V-Turbo 与多模态 agent 训练体系展开。公开文本中未完整列出作者背景细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a broader question than image understanding: if the target is a native multimodal agent rather than a language model with a vision plug-in, how should perception, reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution be integrated into one foundation-model stack? The central tension is that many multimodal systems still treat vision as an auxiliary interface to a language model, which limits how deeply visual evidence participates in reasoning and action. A second tension is optimization: end-to-end agent training is often unstable because rewards are sparse, task definitions are underspecified, and verification is hard. GLM-5V-Turbo addresses this by combining a dedicated vision encoder, a multimodal extension of multi-token prediction, deeply integrated multimodal training, and large-scale joint RL over heterogeneous agent tasks.
summary_en.importance: For a pretraining-oriented reader, the value is not the benchmark spread by itself. The value is that the paper lays out a concrete route toward a native multimodal foundation model. It touches the full stack: visual representation learning, cross-modal alignment, language-model objective design, the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, and multimodal RL infrastructure. Three parts are especially relevant. First, the vision side is not treated as a frozen external encoder; it is pretrained with a deliberate two-stage recipe that separates representation learning from alignment. Second, the paper extends multi-token prediction into the multimodal setting and explicitly studies how image tokens should enter the MTP head. That is a training-objective question, not just a systems trick. Third, the report argues that agentic capability is learned more effectively through hierarchical optimization than through monolithic end-to-end training, which is directly relevant to how pretraining and post-training should be coupled.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There are four main technical components. First, CogViT, a parameter-efficient vision encoder trained in two stages. Stage 1 uses distillation-based masked image modeling. A student ViT reconstructs masked regions in the feature spaces of two teachers: SigLIP2 for semantic representations and DINOv3 for texture and local structure. The setup uses a 35% masking ratio at 224x224 resolution, with a quality-aware data mixture of 80% high-quality natural images, 10% instruction-following data, and 10% scientific imagery. The intent is clear: build a strong visual backbone before forcing it into cross-modal alignment. Training uses the Muon optimizer, and QK-Norm is introduced to stabilize attention by mitigating logit explosion. Stage 2 switches to contrastive image-text pretraining with the SigLIP loss. The main upgrades are variable-resolution NaFlex inputs, a 64K global batch for large-scale contrastive learning, and an 8B bilingual Chinese-English image-text corpus. This is a representation-first, alignment-second recipe rather than pure contrastive training from scratch.

Second, MMTP, or Multimodal Multi-Token Prediction. In text-only MTP, prefix tokens can be passed naturally into the MTP head via token embeddings. In multimodal settings, however, it is unclear how image tokens should be exposed to the MTP head. The paper compares three options: directly passing visual embeddings, masking out visual tokens entirely at the MTP head, or preserving visual positional information while replacing visual content with a shared learnable <|image|> token. GLM-5V-Turbo adopts the third option. The reason is the trade-off between optimization and infrastructure efficiency. Direct visual embeddings make the head heavier and potentially less stable; removing visual tokens entirely loses multimodal conditioning; the shared special token preserves the structural signal that image content exists at certain positions without injecting full visual features into the MTP head. This is one of the most interesting parts of the paper for foundation-model training.

Third, multimodal training is deeply integrated across pretraining and supervised fine-tuning, rather than adding vision only at the instruction-tuning stage. The public text does not expose every data-mixture and curriculum detail, but the intended direction is clear: vision should participate in the model’s reasoning backbone, not merely provide a few side tokens.

Fourth, the paper performs joint reinforcement learning over more than 30 task categories spanning perception, reasoning, and agentic behavior, supported by dedicated multimodal RL infrastructure. The more important takeaway is the training philosophy stated in the report: agentic competence is often learned better through hierarchical optimization than through monolithic end-to-end training. That suggests the system likely decomposes perception, tool use, planning, and execution into different optimization layers or stages rather than relying on a single unified reward over the full chain.
summary_en.experiments: On the vision side, CogViT is reported to achieve competitive results on general object recognition, fine-grained understanding, and geometric or spatial perception, summarized in the paper’s overview figure. On the full model side, GLM-5V-Turbo reports strong results on multimodal agent benchmarks: 30.7 on ImageMining, 51.9 on BrowseComp-VL, 72.9 on MMSearch, and 78.2 on SimpleVQA. On GUI-agent tasks it reaches 75.7 on AndroidWorld and 62.3 on OSWorld. On Claw-based evaluations it reports 87.0/80.7 on PinchBench, 57.7/75.0 on ClawEval, and 57.6 on ZClawBench. For coding, it scores 94.8 on Design2Code, outperforming Claude Opus 4.6, while preserving or improving text-only coding relative to GLM-5-Turbo on CC-Backend, CC-Frontend, and CC-RepoExploration. For a pretraining reader, the most useful evidence is not the absolute benchmark list but the support for specific design choices: the comparison among the three MMTP visual-token interfaces, whether the two-stage CogViT recipe beats direct image-text alignment, and whether joint RL improves broad generalization rather than overfitting a narrow set of agent tasks. If the full report includes ablations, the most informative ones are likely around Muon, QK-Norm, NaFlex, SigLIP loss, and the large bilingual corpus.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the model, training, and infrastructure section first. Start with the CogViT recipe and ask why the paper separates masked-image distillation from image-text alignment. Pay attention to the role of the two teachers, the data mixture, and the stabilization choices such as Muon and QK-Norm. Then focus on MMTP. This is the part closest to a training-objective contribution, and it is the most transferable idea in the report. After that, read the multimodal training and joint RL sections with one question in mind: what exactly does hierarchical optimization mean in their implementation? Is it a curriculum, a task decomposition, a reward decomposition, or a staged training pipeline? In the experiments, prioritize ablations and design comparisons over the benchmark catalog. If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough to read the CogViT section, the MMTP comparison, and the main result tables. For deeper reading, keep three questions in mind: whether MMTP improves sample efficiency or generation behavior in multimodal settings, whether stronger standalone vision pretraining creates alignment tension with the language backbone, and how much of the RL gain comes from broader task coverage versus better reward and verification design.

recommendation.en: Read the training and RL sections; if the report is mostly benchmark stacking, discount it, but the native multimodal-agent recipe is still useful for internal planning.

paper.title: ClawMark: A Living-World Benchmark for Multi-Turn, Multi-Day, Multimodal Coworker Agents
paper.abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly used as persistent coworkers that assist users across multiple working days. During such workflows, the surrounding environment may change independently of the agent: new emails arrive, calendar entries shift, knowledge-base records are updated, and evidence appears across images, scanned PDFs, audio, video, and spreadsheets. Existing benchmarks do not adequately evaluate this setting because they typically run within a single static episode and remain larg

summary.core_problem: 现有智能体基准多基于单会话静态环境、文本输入为主，无法评测长期办公场景下持续协作类智能体的状态追踪、外生环境变化适应、多模态证据整合能力。
summary.importance: 为持久化办公协作类智能体的能力评测提供了标准化可复现的测试框架，其多轮跨天、环境外生变化、无大模型打分的设计，可为通用智能体预训练、对齐阶段的能力迭代提供明确的评测信号。
summary.technical_approach: 构建ClawMark基准，包含100个覆盖13种办公场景的任务，每个任务跨越2-6个模拟工作日，对接5个有状态沙箱服务（文件系统、邮件、日历、知识库、电子表格），回合间会主动引入通知式的公开事件和无通知的静默状态变化，支持原生多模态证据输入，采用1537个确定性Python检查器做规则化打分，避免大模型裁判的偏差。
summary.experiments: 评测7个前沿智能体系统，最高加权得分为75.8，最高严格任务成功率仅20.0。在3轮任务中，6个评测模型的得分在第2天出现下降，Claude Sonnet与GPT的得分差距从第1天的6.5个百分点缩小到第3天的4.0个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第1章现有基准的缺陷分析、第3章基准设计细节、第6章的智能体评测结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks are mostly built on single-session static environments with text-centric inputs, which cannot evaluate the state tracking, exogenous environment change adaptation, and multimodal evidence integration capabilities of persistent collaborative agents in long-term office scenarios.
summary_en.importance: ClawMark provides a standardized and reproducible test framework for evaluating persistent coworker agents. Its design of multi-turn cross-day tasks, exogenous environment changes, and LLM-judge-free scoring can provide clear evaluation signals for capability iteration during general agent pretraining and alignment phases.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ClawMark benchmark contains 100 tasks covering 13 office scenarios. Each task spans 2 to 6 simulated workdays, connected to 5 stateful sandbox services (filesystem, email, calendar, knowledge base, spreadsheet). Announced loud events and unannounced silent state mutations are introduced between turns, with native multimodal evidence input supported. 1537 deterministic Python checkers are used for rule-based scoring to avoid bias from LLM judges.
summary_en.experiments: 7 frontier agent systems are evaluated, with the highest weighted score reaching 75.8 and the highest strict task success rate only 20.0. Among 3-turn tasks, 6 out of 7 evaluated models show performance drop on Day 2, and the score gap between Claude Sonnet and GPT narrows from 6.5 percentage points on Day 1 to 4.0 percentage points on Day 3.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the limitation analysis of existing benchmarks in Section 1 Introduction, benchmark design details in Section 3, and agent evaluation results in Section 6. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 长期状态跟踪的评测设计可参考用于持续预训练的能力验证，仅看基准设计和实验结论部分即可
recommendation.en: The long-term state tracking evaluation design can be referenced for capability verification of continual pretraining, only read the benchmark design and experiment conclusion sections

paper.title: ReCAPA: Hierarchical Predictive Correction to Mitigate Cascading Failures
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action systems follow instructions to execute multi-step tasks in multimodal environments. Recent VLA approaches typically rely on post-hoc correction mechanisms or operate under fixed task decompositions and alignment schemes. However, once an intermediate step is mis-specified, local errors propagate through subsequent steps and eventually accumulate into cascading failures. To mitigate this compounding effect, we propose Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture, a framew

summary.core_problem: 解决 Vision-Language-Action 系统在多步任务中一旦中间步骤偏离，就会层层放大并形成 cascading failures 的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 VLA/agent 方向的训练框架改进，价值在于把纠错从事后修补改成分层预测式校正，并提出误差传播与恢复指标；对基座预训练只有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReCAPA（摘要中也称 Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture），在 action、subgoal、trajectory 三个层级同时做预测与对比式校正。通过 Sinkhorn-based semantic alignment 模块和 score-field 模块约束多层语义一致性，并把预测纠偏信号回传给 action generator 联合训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调在多步 multimodal task 中缓解误差累积，并新增两个指标来量化 error propagation 与 recovery，但未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、提升幅度或与主流 VLA baseline 的完整数字。整体更像任务层系统改进，而非可迁移到 LLM 预训练的 clean setup。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港科技大学（广州）和华南师范大学，属于具身/多模态决策方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses cascading failures in Vision-Language-Action systems, where an early mistake in a multi-step task propagates and compounds over time.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLA/agent training-framework paper. Its main value is shifting from post-hoc correction to hierarchical predictive correction and introducing metrics for error propagation and recovery, with only indirect relevance to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReCAPA, referred to in the abstract as a Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture, performs predictive and contrastive correction at three levels: actions, subgoals, and trajectories. It uses a Sinkhorn-based semantic alignment module and a score-field module to enforce consistency, and jointly updates the action generator during training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved robustness on multi-step multimodal tasks and introduces two new metrics for quantifying propagation and recovery of errors, but does not provide concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or full baseline comparisons. The setup appears more task-system oriented than a clean pretraining study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from HKUST (Guangzhou) and South China Normal University, working in embodied and multimodal decision-making.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 VLA 或层级规划，可看它怎么定义 error propagation 指标；对 LLM pretrain 本身帮助不大，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look only for its error-propagation metrics in VLA; it is unlikely to change how you think about LLM pretraining.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: ProMMSearchAgent: A Generalizable Multimodal Search Agent Trained with Process-Oriented Rewards
paper.abstract: Training multimodal agents via reinforcement learning for knowledge-intensive visual reasoning is fundamentally hindered by the extreme sparsity of outcome-based supervision and the unpredictability of live web environments. To resolve these algorithmic and environmental bottlenecks, we introduce ProMMSearchAgent, establishing a novel Sim-to-Real training paradigm for multimodal search.   We decouple policy learning into a deterministic, local static sandbox. Crucially, to learn effectively with

summary.core_problem: 多模态搜索 agent 的 RL 训练同时受困于结果奖励稀疏和真实网页环境不可控，导致策略难学也难迁移。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent 训练范式与奖励设计：提出 sim-to-real 的多模态搜索训练框架，以及 process-oriented reward 来缓解 outcome-only supervision 的稀疏性。对预训练本身不直接，但对 post-train 阶段如何给 agent 更干净训练信号有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把策略学习放到确定性的本地静态 sandbox 中，避免 live web 的高噪声环境；核心是 introspective process-oriented reward，通过探测模型自身参数知识边界，生成稠密行为元数据，奖励“何时该直接回答、何时该发起图像或文本搜索”的决策，而不是只看最终答对与否。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称本地训练得到的策略可 zero-shot 迁移到 Google Search API，并在多模态搜索任务上超过现有方法；但未给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练 token、基线细节和提升幅度。实验结论更像 agent policy transfer 的证据，而非基座能力提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华为诺亚方舟实验室、华东师范大学等。机构组合说明这更偏 agent/RL 训练研究，而不是基座预训练团队常见的规模化预训练工作。

summary_en.core_problem: RL training for multimodal search agents is bottlenecked by sparse outcome rewards and the instability of live web environments, making policies hard to learn and transfer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in agent-training methodology and reward design: a sim-to-real multimodal search setup plus a process-oriented reward to reduce the sparsity of outcome-only supervision. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to how post-training can provide cleaner learning signals for agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The policy is trained inside a deterministic local static sandbox instead of the live web. The key idea is an introspective process-oriented reward that probes the model's own parametric knowledge boundary and generates dense behavioral metadata, rewarding the decision of when to answer directly versus when to launch multimodal or text search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that a locally trained policy transfers zero-shot to the Google Search API and outperforms prior methods on multimodal search tasks. However, it does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, training scale, baseline details, or exact margins. The evidence is more about agent policy transfer than foundation-model capability.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, East China Normal University, and collaborators. This looks more like an agent/RL training paper than a large-scale foundation-model pretraining effort.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“过程奖励替代结果奖励”这个训练信号设计值得借去看；只读 reward 定义和 sim-to-real setup，别在任务分数上花时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the shift from outcome reward to process reward is the part worth stealing; read the reward design and sim-to-real setup, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: Making Image Editing Easier via Adaptive Task Reformulation with Agentic Executions
paper.abstract: Instruction guided image editing has advanced substantially with recent generative models, yet it still fails to produce reliable results across many seemingly simple cases. We observe that a large portion of these failures stem not from insufficient model capacity, but from poorly formulated editing tasks, such as those involving small targets, implicit spatial relations, or under-specified instructions. In this work, we frame image editing failures as a task formulation problem and propose an

summary.core_problem: 解决指令图像编辑中大量失败并非来自底模能力不足，而是任务表述本身不适合模型执行的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把图像编辑失败重新定义为 task reformulation 问题，并引入 agentic execution 做动态拆解、路由和反馈修正。这对通用 agent 设计有一点方法启发，但仍然是面向图像编辑的窄任务系统。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不改底层编辑模型，而是在输入图像与指令之上增加一个 MLLM agent 层，执行分析、路由、重写任务、分步操作和反馈驱动 refinement，把原始编辑请求转成更容易被底模完成的操作序列。
summary.experiments: 在 ImgEdit、PICA、RePlan 等 benchmark 上，配合 Qwen Image Edit、Nano Banana 等编辑 backbone 取得稳定提升。实验重点是跨编辑底模的兼容性与失败案例修复，而不是 agent 通用能力、训练范式或可扩展性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: It argues that many failures in instruction-guided image editing come not from insufficient model capacity, but from poorly formulated tasks that the model cannot execute reliably.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is to recast editing failures as a task-reformulation problem and solve them with agentic execution. This offers some methodological signal for agent design, but it remains a narrow system for image editing rather than a general foundation-model advance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of changing the underlying editor, the method adds an MLLM agent layer that analyzes the image-instruction pair, routes the request, reformulates it into executable sub-operations, and iteratively refines outputs through feedback.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains on ImgEdit, PICA, and RePlan across editing backbones such as Qwen Image Edit and Nano Banana. The empirical focus is cross-backbone compatibility and failure recovery, not general agent capability, scaling behavior, or training methodology.

recommendation.zh: 有一点 agent taste：先改任务表述再怪模型能力；但场景太窄，只看失败类型拆解和 reformulation pipeline 就够了。
recommendation.en: There is one useful agent lesson here—fix task formulation before blaming model capacity—but the setting is narrow; read only the failure taxonomy and reformulation pipeline.

paper.title: POINTS-Seeker: Towards Training a Multimodal Agentic Search Model from Scratch

summary.core_problem: 核心问题：现有多模态搜索/浏览类Agent大多是在通用LMM上“后挂工具+SFT/RL”得到的，导致agentic行为更像表层技能而非内生能力；同时长链路交互会引发上下文膨胀与“attention dilution / Lost-in-the-Middle”，即使证据已在历史中也难以被模型稳定定位与利用。论文试图回答：能否在“从零训练”的路线中，把搜索式自主探究（ReAct式规划-行动-观察-整合）作为模型形成期的核心能力注入，并在不牺牲证据保真度的前提下解决长时序交互的上下文瓶颈？
summary.importance:
对预训练/持续学习研究的启发主要在两点：
(1) 训练阶段划分的新范式：提出介于通用预训练与任务后训练之间的“Agentic Seeding”阶段，把长轨迹、工具交互、规划推理当作“形成期课程”而非下游技能灌输，属于对预训练课程设计/能力成因的直接探索。
(2) 长上下文与记忆的另类路径：V-Fold用“视觉空间承载历史”替代纯文本压缩/截断，实质是把上下文容量问题转化为多模态表征与对齐问题；这对长上下文建模、记忆外化、以及多模态token预算分配有方法论价值。
但从基座预训练角度，它更偏“多模态agent后训练/课程学习+上下文压缩机制”，不是纯粹的新语言建模目标或scaling law工作；价值在于训练配方与长程交互数据如何塑形能力。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两条主线构成：Agentic Seeding（能力注入）与V-Fold（长程交互抗退化）。
1) Agentic Seeding：作者明确反对仅在成熟LMM上做工具调用SFT/RL的“外挂式”路线，主张在预训练之后、SFT/RL之前插入一个专门阶段，密集喂入长视野推理与ReAct轨迹，使模型在表征层面内化“提出子问题→检索/浏览→读证据→再规划→综合回答”的交互模式。其关键点是数据形态从静态QA/描述转为多步trajectory（含action、observation、history），让模型学习在历史中维护状态、在不确定性下继续探索。
2) 轨迹增强VQA数据：论文在方法章节中定义了交互形式（action/observation/history），并构建“trajectory-augmented VQA”以支撑SFT/RL训练：模型在每步决定调用何种工具或直接回答，工具返回网页URL/标题/片段等观测，历史不断累积。
3) SFT与RL管线：在轨迹数据上进行监督学习以对齐工具协议与多步推理格式，并进一步用RL强化长链路成功率（文中强调其目标是鲁棒自主搜索而非仅格式正确）。
4) V-Fold：针对长链路导致的注意力稀释，提出自适应“折叠”机制：保留最近窗口的交互为高精度文本；将更早的历史通过渲染（rendering）折叠进视觉模态，让模型“看见”历史证据而不是把它们作为大量文本token继续占用上下文。直觉上，这是用VLM的视觉-语言对齐能力来承载压缩后的历史，避免文本侧token冗余导致的检索失败。训练上声称非常省：只需在SFT中加入约5k条渲染轨迹即可让模型学会在部署时使用该折叠策略。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的实验结论与设置要点：
- 模型：POINTS-Seeker-8B。
- 评测：6个基准（MMSearch、MMSearch-Plus、FVQA、SimpleVQA、LiveVQA、BrowseComp-VL）。
- 结论：在上述基准上“持续SOTA”，并显著超过依赖post-hoc fine-tuning的既有多模态搜索agent。
- 关键现象与验证：论文强调长链路交互的性能瓶颈来自attention dilution（类Lost-in-the-Middle），V-Fold用于缓解；并声称仅用约5k渲染轨迹即可学到折叠能力。
注意：你提供的全文内容在实验数值（各benchmark具体分数、提升幅度、RL细节、消融表格）处被截断，无法从当前文本中可靠抽取“具体数字提升/数据规模/训练步数”等硬指标；若补充论文实验章节与表格，可进一步给出逐项对比与消融结论（例如：仅Agentic Seeding vs 仅V-Fold vs 两者结合；不同折叠阈值/窗口大小；不同工具集合；长轨迹长度分桶性能等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟抓主线）：
1) Introduction：重点看作者对“从零训练agentic search”与“post-hoc工具微调”的差异化论证，以及Figure 3(b)关于attention dilution/Lost-in-the-Middle的失败案例。
2) Method 3.2（Agentic Seeding）：关注它在训练阶段划分上的定位（pretrain之后、SFT/RL之前）以及轨迹数据的组织形式（action/observation/history），这部分对“课程学习如何塑形agent能力”最关键。
3) Method 3.6（V-Fold）：重点理解“滑窗保留文本 + 历史渲染进视觉”的双通道表示，以及为何只需少量渲染轨迹就能泛化到部署。
4) Experiments（若你补全全文）：优先找(1)长链路长度分桶曲线/随turn增长的退化图；(2) V-Fold消融与不同压缩策略对比（截断/摘要/检索式记忆 vs V-Fold）；(3) Agentic Seeding是否带来更少的无效工具调用、更高的证据命中率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two coupled failures in multimodal web-search agents: (i) today’s agents are mostly “general LMM + tool-use post-training”, making agentic behavior a thin task layer rather than an intrinsic capability; (ii) long-horizon interactions inflate context and cause attention dilution / Lost-in-the-Middle, where the model misses already-present evidence in the history. The central question is whether we can build a natively agentic multimodal search model “from scratch” by injecting ReAct-style long trajectories during the model’s formative stage, and how to preserve evidence fidelity under long interaction histories without naive truncation/summarization.
summary_en.importance:
For foundation-model pretraining researchers, the contribution is mainly methodological rather than a new LM objective: 
1) A training-stage reframing (“Agentic Seeding”) that sits between pretraining and downstream SFT/RL, treating long-horizon tool-interaction trajectories as a core curriculum to shape representations—useful for thinking about capability formation and continual/curriculum learning.
2) A long-context mitigation route that offloads stale textual history into the visual channel (V-Fold), effectively turning context-length pressure into a multimodal representation/allocation problem. This is relevant to memory externalization and token-budget design in multimodal LMs.
Overall it’s more agentic multimodal training + context management than classic scaling-law/tokenizer work, but it offers concrete ideas on how data form (trajectories) and representation (visualized history) can unlock robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two main components:
1) Agentic Seeding: instead of teaching tool use post-hoc, the authors introduce a dedicated stage after pretraining that densely trains on long-horizon reasoning and ReAct-like trajectories (plan→act/tool-call→observe→update→answer). The model learns to maintain state over an interaction history defined by (query, actions, observations, …), internalizing autonomous inquiry patterns as part of its core behavior.
2) Trajectory-augmented VQA data + SFT/RL pipeline: they formalize actions (tool invocation or final answer), observations (URLs/titles/snippets returned by tools), and interaction history, then perform SFT to learn protocols and multi-step reasoning formats, followed by RL to improve long-horizon success.
3) V-Fold: an adaptive history folding mechanism to combat attention dilution. Recent turns remain as high-fidelity text in a sliding window; older history is rendered into the visual modality so the model can still “see” raw evidence via vision-language alignment without paying large text-token costs. Training is claimed to be lightweight: ~5k rendered trajectories added during SFT are sufficient for the model to generalize the folding behavior at deployment.
summary_en.experiments:
What can be reliably extracted from the provided full-text excerpt:
- Model: POINTS-Seeker-8B.
- Benchmarks: MMSearch, MMSearch-Plus, FVQA, SimpleVQA, LiveVQA, BrowseComp-VL.
- Claims: consistent SOTA across all six, outperforming prior post-hoc tool-augmented agents; V-Fold addresses long-horizon degradation; only ~5k rendered trajectories are needed to learn folding.
However, the excerpt does not include the experimental tables/figures with exact scores, dataset sizes, training budgets, or ablation numbers. With the full Experiments section, the most important details to extract would be: gains attributable to Agentic Seeding vs standard post-training, turn-length robustness curves, and comparisons against truncation/summarization baselines for long histories.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Intro: focus on the argument for “native agentic” training and the attention-dilution failure mode (the Lost-in-the-Middle analogy).
- Method §3.2: Agentic Seeding’s placement in the training recipe and the exact trajectory format (action/observation/history).
- Method §3.6: V-Fold’s dual representation (text window + rendered visual history) and the training-efficiency claim (~5k trajectories).
- Experiments (if available): prioritize long-horizon robustness plots, V-Fold ablations vs truncation/summarization, and evidence-grounding metrics (e.g., evidence hit rate, tool-call efficiency).

recommendation.zh: 建议看训练配方：把 agentic 行为前置成“Agentic Seeding”课程并用 V-Fold 外化历史，可能改变你对长轨迹能力应在何阶段注入的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim for the recipe: an explicit “Agentic Seeding” stage plus V-Fold history externalization may shift your prior on when long-horizon/tool-use behavior should be injected during training.

paper.title: Towards Long-horizon Agentic Multimodal Search

summary.core_problem: 长时程（long-horizon）多模态 deep search 代理在迭代浏览/检索过程中会累积大量异构证据（文本+图像等），直接把视觉内容塞进上下文会导致 token 成本爆炸与噪声累积；而简单丢弃/摘要视觉又会丢关键信号。论文要解决的是：在不牺牲可回溯视觉证据的前提下，如何让多模态搜索代理在 50-100+ turn 的长轨迹中稳定管理与调用视觉信息，并保持可扩展的推理与工具使用能力。
summary.importance: 对“预训练/持续学习”本身不是直接贡献（更偏 agent 框架与后训练数据/工具接口），但对基座模型研究有两点启发：1）把多模态上下文管理从“压缩输入”转为“外部化记忆+按需取回”，为长上下文/记忆机制提供了工程可行的替代路径；2）给出了面向长时程多模态工具使用的轨迹蒸馏与数据合成范式（构造跨模态 multi-hop 查询、收集 teacher 轨迹再微调），可作为后训练数据科学的参考。整体贡献量级：在开放模型的多模态搜索基准上做出明显 SOTA，并展示可扩展到 100 turns 的稳定增益，但其核心创新主要在系统与表示/接口层，而非预训练目标或架构层。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是“文件化视觉表示（file-based visual representation）+ 轻量 UID 代理 + 按需 fetch”的上下文管理机制，目标是解耦 perception（重）与 reasoning/planning（轻）。做法：
1）外部文件系统存储视觉资产：搜索/浏览过程中遇到的图片等不直接进入模型上下文，而是落盘到外部文件系统。
2）UID 文本代理：每个视觉资产映射到唯一文本标识符（UID），上下文中只保留 UID（以及可选的轻量语义，如缩略图/摘要语义），从而把“视觉证据的持久性”从上下文 token 中剥离出去。
3）工具接口重设计：在传统多模态搜索工具之上，增加/改造工具以支持“按需取回与主动感知”，文中明确提出 fetch-image 工具用于在需要细粒度理解时再加载特定视觉内容。
4）渐进式工作流（progressive multimodal search workflow）：先用轻量上下文进行规划与证据管理；当推理链条需要视觉细节时，通过 UID 定位并调用 fetch-image 取回对应图像进行局部理解，再把结论以文本形式回写到上下文。
5）训练数据：提出数据合成管线，构造需要复杂 cross-modal multi-hop 推理的查询；结合开源 deep search queries，用强 teacher 采集高质量轨迹并蒸馏，最终微调 Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B 得到专用代理（文中称 distill 12K trajectories）。
与已有方法差异：不是做“多模态上下文摘要/压缩”，也不是简单丢弃中间图像，而是把视觉证据当作可寻址的外部对象（类似 planning-with-files 思路），上下文只保留可操作的引用与必要语义，从机制上避免 context explosion。
summary.experiments:
论文在四个多模态搜索基准上评测（文中点名 MM-BrowseComp/MMBC 与 MMSearch-Plus 等）。关键数字（来自全文引言给出的结果）：
- 在长时程基准上：MMBC 成功率 22.3，MMSearch-Plus 成功率 32.9。
- 引入该上下文管理策略后可扩展到 100 turns：MMBC 30.1，MMSearch-Plus 34.8（强调在开放模型中 SOTA）。
- 框架可迁移到其他基座：在 Seed-1.8 上，MMSearch-Plus 达到 46.7，显示一定通用性。
- 训练侧：蒸馏/微调对象为 Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B，轨迹规模 12K。
就“预训练研究者关心的实验洞察”而言，论文更像系统/数据驱动：核心证据是长 turn 可扩展性与跨基座泛化；但引言未给出更细的消融数字（例如 UID 语义补充、fetch-image 频率、不同存储/检索策略的对比），若正文有消融应重点核对其对 100-turn 稳定性的贡献来源。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
1）优先看“Long-horizon Multimodal Context Management”章节：理解 UID 代理、外部文件存储、以及如何在对话上下文中记录/引用视觉证据（这是全文最核心的可复用思想）。
2）看工具接口与工作流设计部分：fetch-image 的触发条件、返回格式、以及如何把视觉理解结果回写为可持续推理的文本证据。
3）看数据合成与轨迹蒸馏部分：他们如何构造 cross-modal multi-hop 查询、如何统计“需要更多 tool turns/更高 vision tool 占比”，以及 teacher 轨迹的过滤标准（这对后训练数据科学更有价值）。
4）实验部分重点关注：100-turn 设置的评测协议（是否限制工具预算/上下文长度/失败判定）、与 prior framework（文中提到 RedSearcher）在同一 base model 下的对比是否公平，以及成功率提升主要来自“记忆机制”还是“专门微调数据”。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon multimodal deep-search agents accumulate heterogeneous evidence (text plus images) across many browsing/search turns. Naively injecting visual content into the LLM context causes token blow-up and compounding noise, while dropping or aggressively summarizing images loses critical signals. The paper targets a practical but fundamental question: how to persist, track, and selectively revisit visual evidence over 50–100+ tool-use turns without exploding context length, while keeping reasoning and planning stable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper; it is primarily an agent framework plus post-training data/trajectory distillation. Still, it matters to foundation-model researchers in two ways: (1) it operationalizes an “externalized memory” pattern for multimodal evidence—store heavy perception artifacts outside the context and keep only lightweight references—offering an alternative to long-context scaling and multimodal summarization; (2) it provides a recipe for synthesizing long-horizon cross-modal multi-hop queries and distilling teacher trajectories into a specialized agent, which is directly relevant to data-centric post-training for tool-using models. The contribution is sizable at the system level (open-source SOTA on long-horizon multimodal search and demonstrated scaling to 100 turns), but it does not introduce new pretraining objectives or architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core design is a file-based visual representation with UID proxies and on-demand retrieval, aiming to decouple heavy perception from lightweight planning:
1) Externalize visual assets: images encountered during web browsing/search are saved to an external file system rather than embedded in the prompt.
2) UID-based textual proxies: each visual asset is mapped to a unique textual identifier (UID). The running context retains UIDs (optionally augmented with lightweight semantics such as thumbnail-derived cues), enabling long-horizon bookkeeping at minimal token cost.
3) Tool interface redesign: the agent is equipped with tools that support selective loading of visual content; the paper highlights a dedicated fetch-image tool for active perception when fine-grained understanding is needed.
4) Progressive workflow: plan and accumulate evidence using the lightweight context; only when a reasoning step requires visual detail does the agent resolve a UID via fetch-image, interpret the image, and write back textual conclusions.
5) Training pipeline: a synthesis pipeline creates cross-modal multi-hop queries; combined with existing deep-search queries, a strong teacher generates trajectories that are filtered/distilled (12K trajectories) to fine-tune Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B into a specialized agent.
Key distinction from prior context management: it is neither pure summarization nor heuristic discarding; it treats visual evidence as addressable external objects with explicit references in the prompt, preventing context explosion by construction.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported headline results (from the paper’s main text excerpt):
- On long-horizon benchmarks: 22.3 success rate on MM-BrowseComp (MMBC) and 32.9 on MMSearch-Plus.
- With the proposed context management, the agent scales to 100 turns and reaches 30.1 (MMBC) and 34.8 (MMSearch-Plus), claimed as SOTA among open-source models.
- Generalization to other base models: applying the framework to Seed-1.8 yields 46.7 on MMSearch-Plus.
- Training specifics: fine-tunes Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B using 12K distilled high-quality trajectories.
For deeper takeaways, the most important experimental details to verify in the full paper are the 100-turn evaluation protocol (tool budgets, failure criteria, context limits) and ablations separating gains from (a) the file/UID memory mechanism vs (b) the specialized distilled training data.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the “Long-horizon Multimodal Context Management” section first—this is the reusable core (UID schema, what stays in-context vs offloaded, and how references are maintained).
2) Inspect the tool/interface design and the progressive workflow, especially how fetch-image is triggered and how visual findings are converted into durable textual evidence.
3) Skim the data synthesis + teacher-trajectory distillation pipeline for practical details (query construction, filtering, statistics on tool-turn distribution).
4) In experiments, focus on the 100-turn setting and the controlled comparisons against prior frameworks (e.g., RedSearcher) on the same base model to assess whether improvements come from memory design, training data, or both.

recommendation.zh: 主要看外部化多模态记忆与轨迹蒸馏数据合成流程；它解决的是长轨迹工程可扩展性而非新预训练目标，适合抄作后训练管线。
recommendation.en: Look at the externalized multimodal memory design and the trajectory-distillation data pipeline; it’s about long-horizon engineering scalability, not new pretraining objectives—good to copy into post-training stacks.
